dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.taddṛgdoṣabhiyaikānte guruḥ saṁsthāpya r: tad-dṛg-doṣa-bhiyaikānte guruḥ saṁsthāpya rakṣayā | taṁ rarakṣārbha-buddhyeśaṁ tan-māyā-mohito harim
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.bhūyānnaro haririva naratāpāghadainyahṛt: bhūyān-naro harir-iva nara-tāpāgha-dainya-hṛt | ayam-ity-ākhyayā cakre bālaṁ narahariṁ dvijaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.kṣucchāntirnāsya matto'to dhātrī vājā pa: kṣucchāntir-nāsya matto'to dhātrī vājā payasvinī | mṛgyety-ukte'mbayor-ojau spṛṣṭvārbho'dhyaduhat-payaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.tadbālaceṣṭitaṁ citraṁ saddṛgdoṣabhiyāna: tad-bāla-ceṣṭitaṁ citraṁ sad-dṛg-doṣa-bhiyānayā | sphuṭaṁ nākāri mātraivam-anyad-apy-adbhutāspadam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.vaktuṁ śrotuṁ nāyamajño mūkaścetkathamoṅ: vaktuṁ śrotuṁ nāyamajño mūkaś-cet-katham-oṅkṛtim | śrutvānyoktiṁ brūta iti pitarau moham-āpatuḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.mūko'yaṁ nau śrameṇālaṁ pradoṣe śambhura: mūko'yaṁ nau śrameṇālaṁ pradoṣe śambhur-arcitaḥ| diṣṭyaitat-phalaṁ prāptaṁ saṁskāryo'sau kathaṁ nvataḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.tābhyāmityudite mauñjyāṁ baddhāyāṁ vakṣy: tābhyām-ity-udite mauñjyāṁ baddhāyāṁ vakṣya ity-asau| saṁjñayā darśayat-svarṇaṁ vyakṛṇot-tan-mude'yasaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.tadā sañjātaviśvāso viprānāhūya mādhavaḥ: tadā sañjāta-viśvāso viprānāhūya mādhavaḥ | mudā saṁbhṛta-saṁbhāraḥ sulagne'mum-upānayat
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.susaṁskṛtaḥ kṛtasvastyayano bhukto'mbayā: susaṁskṛtaḥ kṛta-svastyayano bhukto'mbayā saha | gurūpadiṣṭāṁ sāvitrīm-upanīto'yam-ādade
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.praṇamya pitarau prāha viraktaḥ pravrajā: praṇamya pitarau prāha viraktaḥ pravrajāmi bhoḥ| anityād-drāk-śarīrasya tad-ājñāṁ dātum-arhathaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.pratyavāyābhikramānto naiva dhīmati dhīs: pratyavāyābhikramānto naiva dhīmati dhīs-tv-iyam| mama prāg-daihikākṣayyā bhaviṣyanty-ātmajā hi vām
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.ityukte'mbā viṣīdantī tanmāyāmohitā'brav: ity-ukte'mbā viṣīdantī tan-māyā-mohitā'bravīt | eka eva sutas-tvaṁ me kathaṁ yāsi vihāya mām
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.jaihvaupasthyasukhāktānāṁ kramo'yaṁ naiv: jaihvaupasthya-sukhāktānāṁ kramo'yaṁ naiva mādṛśaḥ| prāk-saṁskāra-viraktasya joṣyaiḥ kiṁ me'kayonibhiḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.śrutaśrotavyanirvedaṁ yāsye saṁnyasya bh: śruta-śrotavya-nirvedaṁ yāsye saṁnyasya bho tataḥ| saṁsiddhiḥ sulabhā nātaḥ paraṁ kāryaṁ hi dhīmatā
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.kālo bhrūṇāñchiśūnyūno vṛddhānārtānsukha: kālo bhrūṇāñchiśūnyūno vṛddhān-ārtān-sukha-sthitān | mūḍhān grasaty-api prājñān-niḥśeṣān-amarān-api
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.ya uttamaṁ jñānapātraṁ labdhvā dhāmāgraj: ya uttamaṁ jñāna-pātraṁ labdhvā dhāmāgra-jātijam | nācaraty-ātmanaḥ śreyas-tenātmā vañcito dhruvam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.tasmānnārabdhavighnā me bhava te'mba nam: tasmān-nārabdha-vighnā me bhava te'mba namo'pi te | putro bhaviṣyati dhyānād bhavābdhiṁ me tariṣyasi
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.ityuktvā'darśayattasyai svaṁ rūpaṁ divya: ity-uktvā'darśayat-tasyai svaṁ rūpaṁ divyam-uttamam | sāpy-adabhra-dṛśā dṛṣṭvā tadvittatprāgjanirjagau
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.namaste bhagavandeva prāgdṛṣṭo martukāma: namaste bhagavan-deva prāg-dṛṣṭo martu-kāmayā | kuputrayā mayā sa tvaṁ śrīpādo me'dya gocaraḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.kṛtaṁ matkukṣisaṁbhūta iti lokaviḍambana: kṛtaṁ mat-kukṣi-saṁbhūta iti loka-viḍambanam | aja brahmāṇḍa-kukṣe na ubhayaṁ pāvitaṁ kulam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.satyasaṅkalpa te vighnaṁ mā'stu rūpaṁ st: satya-saṅkalpa te vighnaṁ mā'stu rūpaṁ sthirīkuru | mayīdaṁ cātra bho stheyaṁ yāvat-putro bhaviṣyati
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.tathetyukteśabuddhyā'sau sthitvā tābhyāṁ: tathety-ukteśa-buddhyā'sau sthitvā tābhyāṁ supūjitaḥ| tatra śikṣitavāñchiṣyānviduṣo'pyeṣa veda-vāk
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.jātau dvau te bhaviṣyanti putrau putrī c: jātau dvau te bhaviṣyanti putrau putrī ca sattamāḥ | dehy-ājñāṁ ma iti proktvā tad-ājñaptaḥ pracakrame
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.punardarśanaṁ me'stu sāṁnidhyamamba smṛt: punar-darśanaṁ me'stu sāṁnidhyam-amba smṛtāv-ittham-uktvā yayau tāṁ nivartya
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.yogīśo'pi drāgbadaryāśramaṁ sad draṣṭuṁ: yogīśo'pi drāg-badaryāśramaṁ sad draṣṭuṁ kāśīṁ prāpa veṣān-mumukṣoḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.sa khecaratsahajihva unmanyāvasthayā'tap: sa khecaratsahajihva unmanyāvasthayā'tapat| tapaḥ śvāsocchvāsa-hīnaḥ kāśyāṁ vajrāsana-sthitaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.bhāgīrathyāṁ triṣavaṇamathāplutya sāṣṭāṅ: bhāgīrathyāṁ triṣavaṇam-athāplutya sāṣṭāṅga-yogaṁ yuñjantaṁ taṁ sakala-munayaḥ prekṣya siddhāsana-stham|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.prākśaṁkarācāryamato'pi luptaḥ saṁnyāsa: prāk-śaṁkarācārya-mato'pi luptaḥ saṁnyāsa enaṁ vitanotu tiṣye
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.bhīrūgre sulabhakṣeme kalau saṁnyāsavart: bhīrūgre sulabha-kṣeme kalau saṁnyāsa-vartmanā | adhyātma-paramānandaṁ bhagavan-dātum-arhasi
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.ityāśrutyoktamācāryaṁ vṛtvā kṛṣṇasarasva: ity-āśrutyoktam-ācāryaṁ vṛtvā kṛṣṇasarasvatīm | tataḥ saṁnyāsy-abhūn-nāmnā sa nṛsiṁha-sarasvatī
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.nyastasūtraśikho reje nyastasarvaiṣaṇo v: nyasta-sūtra-śikho reje nyasta-sarvaiṣaṇo vaśī | saṁnyastākhila-saṅkalpaḥ saṁnyāsī nirmamo'dvayaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.saṁnyāsapaddhatiṁ prāha mumukṣubhyo jaga: saṁnyāsa-paddhatiṁ prāha mumukṣubhyo jagad-guruḥ | virajomāñchucirdevīṁ praviṣṭo hāpitaiṣaṇaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.daivabhāvo yogapaṭṭī saṁnyāsī śreyase'rh: daiva-bhāvo yoga-paṭṭī saṁnyāsī śreyase'rhati | gati-jño dhāraṇābhyāsāj-jīvanmucyet-parātma-dṛk
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.brahmībhūtasya gavyātmā vyasuḥ kṣepyo'pk: brahmībhūtasya gavyātmā vyasuḥ kṣepyo'pkriyādi no| ity-uktvā grāhayāmāsa saṁnyāsaṁ svadhikāriṇaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.kārayitvā bahiḥsparśānbāhyānso'nte dṛśaṁ: kārayitvā bahiḥ-sparśān-bāhyān-so'nte dṛśaṁ bhruvoḥ| prāṇāpānau ca khe tulyau yatibhyo yogam-ādiśat
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.prayāge'thaitya saṁnyāsaṁ mādhavabrahmaṇ: prayāge'thaitya saṁnyāsaṁ mādhava-brahmaṇe dadau | vibhus-tattvopadeśaṁ ca nijodbhava-bhuvaṁ yayau
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.yatprasādānnarā muktā advaitāmṛtavarṣiṇa: yat-prasādān-narā muktā advaitāmṛta-varṣiṇaḥ | bhavanty-asya kim-ācāryaiḥ ko'yaṁ kṛṣṇasarasvatī
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.sāṁdīpanivasiṣṭhādyāḥ kṛṣṇarāmādibhirvṛt: sāṁdīpani-vasiṣṭhādyāḥ kṛṣṇa-rāmādibhir-vṛtāḥ| guravo'pi tathā'jena vṛtaḥ kṛṣṇasarasvatī
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.mānuṣyaṁ līlayāsādya sa tadvadvartate na: mānuṣyaṁ līlayāsādya sa tadvad-vartate na cet | varteta saṅkaro loke bhavet-tad-anuvartitaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.śiṣyo viṣṇuḥ pureśasya viṣṇorvidhirabhūd: śiṣyo viṣṇuḥ pureśasya viṣṇor-vidhir-abhūd-vidheḥ| vasiṣṭhas-tasya śāktyo'sya vyāsas-tasya śuko'sya tu
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.tasyeśvaro nṛsiṁho'sya vidyātīrthaṁ tata: tasyeśvaro nṛsiṁho'sya vidyātīrthaṁ tataḥ śivaḥ | tasya bhāgīrathī-tīrthaṁ vidyāraṇyo'sya tasya tu
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.śiṣyo'bhūnmalayānando devatīrthaṁ sarasv: śiṣyo'bhūn-malayānando deva-tīrthaṁ sarasvatī | yādavendro'sya tasyāyaṁ śiṣyaḥ kṛṣṇasarasvatī
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/08_adh.sarve svadīkṣāṅkitākhyā jātāḥ kṛṣṇasaras: sarve sva-dīkṣāṅkitākhyā jātāḥ kṛṣṇasarasvatī | pāraṁparyottamo jñānī vṛddho'to'yaṁ vṛto'munā

dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.bhagavānapi saṁnyāsaṁ pragṛhya svajanust: bhagavān-api saṁnyāsaṁ pragṛhya sva-janu-sthalam | kuto yāto'sya śiṣyāḥ syuḥ ke ke kim-akarot-tataḥ ||1||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.mahīṁ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya pratijñātānusāryaj: mahīṁ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya pratijñātānusāry-ajaḥ | mātaraṁ draṣṭum-āpto hi mātā vandyā yater-api ||2||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.śiṣyā hi bahavo jātā bālaḥ kṛṣṇa upendra: śiṣyā hi bahavo jātā bālaḥ kṛṣṇa upendrakaḥ | jñāna-jyotiḥ sadānando mādhavo'haṁ ca saptamaḥ ||3||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.sarasvatyantasaṁjñāḥ syurete mukhyāstu b: sarasvatyanta-saṁjñāḥ syur-ete mukhyāstu bhūriśaḥ | āsann-anye sa taiḥ sākam-āyayau sva-janu-sthalam ||4||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.pitarau prekṣya bandhūṁśca bhaginīmitarā: pitarau prekṣya bandhūṁś-ca bhaginīm-itarān-api | tatrādade viśvarūpaḥ pūjāṁ pratyālayaṁ kṣaṇāt ||5||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.pitrārcitamamuṁ dṛṣṭvā prāksmṛtyāmbābrav: pitrārcitam-amuṁ dṛṣṭvā prāk-smṛtyāmbābravīt-priya | mṛtyūnmukhīṁ kuputrāṁ māṁ yo'rakṣacchrīpadas-tvayam ||6||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.śrīpāda me tvaṁ na suto'si deva bhavārṇa: śrīpāda me tvaṁ na suto'si deva bhavārṇavād-uddhara mā hare'ja|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.lokānusārī khalu vartase cet sambandhame: lokānusārī khalu vartase cet sambandham-enaṁ smara putra mātuḥ ||8||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.saṁnyāsī yatkule jātastaratyapi tariṣyat: saṁnyāsī yat-kule jātas-taraty-api tariṣyati | kulaikaviṁśatiḥ pitror-durgatāpy-amṛtaṁ labhet ||10||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.jāto'trāyaṁ hi saṁnyāsī bho mātaste'tha: jāto'trāyaṁ hi saṁnyāsī bho mātas-te'tha kiṁ vada | sampat-prajānvitānāṁ vaḥ kāśyāṁ muktir-bhaviṣyati ||11||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.gatirme kāgrataḥ svāminbhavasindhorbibhe: gatir-me kāgrataḥ svāmin-bhava-sindhor-bibhemy-aham | pāpiṣṭhāṁ moddhara hare sad-gurus-tvaṁ hi me prabho ||12||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.patisevanamevaikaṁ tārakaṁ nāparaṁ striy: pati-sevanam-evaikaṁ tārakaṁ nāparaṁ striyāḥ | pātivratyaṁ bhaja tato bhavābdheḥ pāram-eṣyasi ||13||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.dampatyoḥ prākkṛtaṁ vairaṁ tvayā gaurlat: dampatyoḥ prāk-kṛtaṁ vairaṁ tvayā gaur-lattayā hatā | ataḥ patyur-yatitvaṁ te kuṣṭhaṁ cāṅge bhaviṣyataḥ ||14||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.iti śrutvātikhinnābhūttāmāśvāsyāha sadgu: iti śrutvātikhinnābhūt-tām-āśvāsyāha sad-guruḥ | vārdhakye tūbhayaṁ te'stu naśyen-me darśanātkuruk ||15||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.ityuktvā tadanujñātaḥ saśiṣyo gautamīṁ y: ity-uktvā tad-anujñātaḥ saśiṣyo gautamīṁ yayau | yā''nītā gautameneśād go-hatyā-vyapanuttaye ||16||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.tāmetyāplutya bhagavānmuniṁ mādhavasaṁjñ: tām-etyāplutya bhagavān-muniṁ mādhava-saṁjñakam | bhaktaṁ gatānugatān-muktvā stutas-tenāgrato'gamat ||17||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.saśiṣyo'gre vrajandṛṣṭvā gaṅgāyāṁ martum: saśiṣyo'gre vrajan-dṛṣṭvā gaṅgāyāṁ martum-utsukam | vipraṁ gala-śilaṁ kañcid-ādiṣṭais-taṁ kṛpā-nidhiḥ ||18||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.chātrairuddhāritaṁ dīnaṁ śūlarogākulaṁ p: chātrair-uddhāritaṁ dīnaṁ śūla-rogākulaṁ prabhuḥ | dayanīyatamaṁ prāha vidhatse sāhasaṁ kutaḥ ||19||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.prāṇo'nnaṁ jīvanaṁ cānnaṁ layo'nnaṁ jīva: prāṇo'nnaṁ jīvanaṁ cānnaṁ layo'nnaṁ jīvamannamut | udbhavo'nnaṁ kathaṁ stheyam-ṛte'nnāt-tan-mṛtir-varam ||21||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.bhavāntare'tra vā nānnaṁ dattaṁ puṇyaṁ n: bhavāntare'tra vā nānnaṁ dattaṁ puṇyaṁ na vā kṛtam | go-vipra-grāso'pahṛto ninditāḥ pitarau guruḥ ||22||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.neśo'rcito vātithayo hāpitā dhikkṛtā dvi: neśo'rcito vātithayo hāpitā dhik-kṛtā dvijāḥ | miṣṭānnaṁ pitarau tyaktvā sākaṁ bhuktaṁ striyā mayā ||23||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.iti bhātyanyathā nedṛkkaṣṭaṁ bho mayyupa: iti bhāty-anyathā nedṛkkaṣṭaṁ bho mayy-upasthitam | kṛto nānyopakāro bhū-bhāro mogha-bhavo'bhavam ||24||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.mā bhīrdāsye'nnapathyaṁ te divyauṣadhama: mā bhīr-dāsye'nna-pathyaṁ te divyauṣadham-ahaṁ bhiṣak | ity-uktvā virate tasmin-dvija ekaḥ samāyayau ||25||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.martumicchati rugṇo'yaṁ vyathito divyama: martum-icchati rugṇo'yaṁ vyathito divyam-auṣadham | dadmy-asmai tvam-api brahman-pathyaṁ svādv-annam-arpaya ||27||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.māsā pakṣeṇa vālpānnaṁ bhuṅkta ātyantikī: māsā pakṣeṇa vālpānnaṁ bhuṅkta ātyantikīṁ vyathām | sa tad-āpnoty-anna-dānād bhaveddhatyeti bhāti me ||28||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.bhiṣaktamo'smi nāśaṅkyaṁ sāpūpaṁ dehi mā: bhiṣaktamo'smi nāśaṅkyaṁ sāpūpaṁ dehi māṣa-yuk | paramānnaṁ ca pathyaṁ mā bhīr-jāne ruk-pratikriyām ||29||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.tathā kuryāmapi bhavānsaśiṣyo'ṅgīkarotu: tathā kuryām-api bhavān-saśiṣyo'ṅgīkarotu me | bhikṣāṁ gṛhe'smi te śiṣyaḥ prapannaṁ śādhi māṁ guro ||30||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.gurupādodakaṁ tīrthaṁ bhaktyā saṁpūjya m: guru-pādodakaṁ tīrthaṁ bhaktyā saṁpūjya mukti-dam | pītvainohāri sastrīkaḥ śiṣyān-sarvān-apūjayat ||34||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.annaṁ caturvidhaṁ svādu surasaṁ gavyasaṁ: annaṁ catur-vidhaṁ svādu surasaṁ gavya-saṁyutam | prādāt-prakāmaṁ sarvebhyo madhuroktyādareṇa saḥ ||35||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.bhuktvānnaṁ gurupaṅktyāṁ sa bheje rugṇo': bhuktvānnaṁ guru-paṅktyāṁ sa bheje rugṇo'py-anāmayam| nedaṁ citraṁ hi yad-bhaktā ghnanty-udbhava-mahārujam ||36||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.aṅghryabjavandanātte'dya saphalaṁ janmak: aṅghry-abja-vandanāt-te'dya saphalaṁ janma-karma me | pitaronugrahānmuktāstatkṛtārtho'smi nirmalaḥ ||39||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.gaṅgā pāpaṁ vidhustāpaṁ dainyaṁ kalpatar: gaṅgā pāpaṁ vidhus-tāpaṁ dainyaṁ kalpatarur-haret | vāyus-tūlam-ivaitat-te darśanaṁ harati trayam ||40||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.dehi me te'malaṁ dāsyaṁ śraddhopetaṁ kul: dehi me te'malaṁ dāsyaṁ śraddhopetaṁ kulāya ca | yāce'do bhagavann-eko mamādhis-tan-niśāmaya ||42||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.yannighno'smi sa vai hiṁsro yavano hanti: yan-nighno'smi sa vai hiṁsro yavano hanti bhūsuram | pratyabdam-āhvayaty-adya tad-artham-iti śuśruma ||43||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.mā bhīḥ krūramapīdānīṁ yavanaṁ yāhyasaṁś: mā bhīḥ krūram-apīdānīṁ yavanaṁ yāhy-asaṁśayam | mudaiṣyasyarcitastena tāvat-tiṣṭhāmi mā śucaḥ ||44||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.ityākarṇyāpaśaṅkaṁ sa yayau yavanamañjas: ity-ākarṇyāpaśaṅkaṁ sa yayau yavanam-añjasā | śastrair-vipraś-chinattīti bhrānto'raṁ yavanas-tadā ||45||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.taṁ tuṣṭvā vastrabhūṣārthaiḥ prāha gacch: taṁ tuṣṭvā vastra-bhūṣārthaiḥ prāha gaccha sukhaṁ dvija | sāyaṁdevo'pi vītādhir-hṛṣṭaḥ śrī-gurum-āyayau ||46||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.sarpo'pyadyādvirājo'rbhaṁ harervebho gur: sarpo'py-adyād-virājo'rbhaṁ harer-vebho guru-priyam | na kṣamo'pyantako draṣṭuṁ yavanaḥ kim-utālpakaḥ ||47||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.dāso'sīṣṭaṁ labhette me dvyaṣṭābdairdarś: dāso'sīṣṭaṁ labhet-te me dvyaṣṭābdair-darśanaṁ bhavet | dvijety-uktvā vaidyanāthaṁ gatvāntardadha īśvaraḥ ||48||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.īdṛśyo'laukikā līlāḥ kṛtā bhaktividhitsa: īdṛśyo'laukikā līlāḥ kṛtā bhakti-vidhitsayā| bhajeyur-mā katham-api lokā ity-āśayo'sya tu ||49||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.loke pratyupakāritvaṁ samīkṣya bhagavānv: loke pratyupakāritvaṁ samīkṣya bhagavān-vibhuḥ | laukikānanda-janakāṁ camatkṛtim-ihākarot ||50||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.tato'bhyāsācca vairāgyāttaṁ dhyāyanta up: tato'bhyāsāc-ca vairāgyāt-taṁ dhyāyanta upāsate | mahā-prasādo'nenaiva labhante sad-guror-natāḥ ||52||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.aikyajñānaṁ tadā labdhvā mahāvākyena cāt: aikya-jñānaṁ tadā labdhvā mahā-vākyena cātmanoḥ | śāntiṁ vinihitāvidyās-tat-saṁsthāṁ yānti te dhruvām ||53||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.prasannātmānaḥ praśāntā nirbandhā dvaita: prasannātmānaḥ praśāntā nirbandhā dvaita-varjitāḥ| svātmārāmāś-caranty-atra jaḍonmatta-piśācavat ||54||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.sparśekṣākīrtanādīnāṁ sadgurormahimā tvi: sparśekṣā-kīrtanādīnāṁ sad-guror-mahimā tviyān | snehād-dveṣād-bhayād-vāpi dhatte yatra mano'calam ||55||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.tatsārūpyaṁ sa peśaskṛddhyānātkīṭa ivait: tat-sārūpyaṁ sa peśaskṛd-dhyānāt-kīṭa ivaityaram | ity-ādyā mārgaṇopāyā hareḥ syuḥ sulabhā nṛṇām ||56||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.mṛgyo'sau puruṣeṇaiva buddhyādiguṇahetub: mṛgyo'sau puruṣeṇaiva buddhyādi-guṇa-hetubhiḥ | nānumānairato yukta ātmaivātma-guruḥ kila ||57||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.bhūteśo'ntardadhe kasmāttejasvī bhaktava: bhūteśo'ntardadhe kasmāt-tejasvī bhakta-vatsalaḥ | śiṣyās-tasthus-tadā kutra tacchrotuṁ sādaro'smy-aham ||58||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.sarve śiṣyā bhaviṣyāma iti matvātra yānt: sarve śiṣyā bhaviṣyāma iti matvātra yānty-ataḥ | matvā stheyaṁ raha iti chātrān-sad-gurur-abravīt ||59||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.taddattabhuglabdhavidyaḥ snāyāddatvā var: tad-datta-bhug-labdha-vidyaḥ snāyād-datvā varaṁ vratī | anāśramī na tiṣṭheta bhavet-sa pratyavāyyataḥ ||62||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.sthirīkṛtamanāḥ kvāpi tatastiṣṭhansukhī: sthirīkṛta-manāḥ kvāpi tatas-tiṣṭhan-sukhī bhavet | aśaktas-tu mahā-kṣetre hariṁ dhyāyan-vaset-sadā ||69||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.tasmātkṛdhvaṁ svāśramārhaṁ kṛtyaṁ pāto'n: tasmāt-kṛdhvaṁ svāśramārhaṁ kṛtyaṁ pāto'nyathā bhavet | ity-uktvānyān-prerayitvā gṛhebhyo'jo'bravīd-yatīn ||70||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.kāśī prayāgo gayā ca śrīraṅgaḥ puruṣotta: kāśī prayāgo gayā ca śrīraṅgaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | śrīśailo naimiṣāraṇyaṁ kurukṣetraṁ badary-api ||71||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.gokarṇaḥ śaṅkhakarṇaśca kāñcyayodhyā ca: gokarṇaḥ śaṅkhakarṇaś-ca kāñcyayodhyā ca gokulam | mathurā dvāravatī māyāvaṁtikā karavīra-pūḥ ||72||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.gaṅgāsarasvatyarkotthā vipāṭpauṣṇī marud: gaṅgā-sarasvaty-arkotthā vipāṭ-pauṣṇī marudvṛdhā | vitastāsiknyanekāsyā candrabhāgā payasvinī ||74||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.pracaranti sadā tāstu svarṇadīsnānapuṇya: pracaranti sadā tāstu svarṇadī-snāna-puṇyadāḥ | kṛdhvaṁ snānādi vidhivat-sarvatrātra saraḥsv-api ||78||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.grīṣme rajasvalā nadyo yaddine'mbu navaṁ: grīṣme rajasvalā nadyo yad-dine'mbu navaṁ tadā | daśāhaṁ narte tīrasthaiḥ snānaṁ mukhyāsu tu tryaham ||79||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.dvyarātramapi kūpādau caritvaivaṁ tato'k: dvyarātram-api kūpādau caritvaivaṁ tato'khilāḥ | śrīśailaṁ bahudhānye'bde yāta yāsyāmy-ahaṁ hyapi ||80||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.(kṣepakau)yadvarjunābhyāṁ vidyogau prāha: (kṣepakau)yadvarjunābhyāṁ vidyogau prāhaiṣa prāg-yathā tathā| guhyau me prāha te śiṣya vinīta kathayāmi te ||82||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/09_adh.ityuktvā praṇatāyoce siddhaḥ śiṣyāya sat: ity-uktvā praṇatāyoce siddhaḥ śiṣyāya sattamaḥ | yābhyāṁ paraṁ pumān-yāti svānando vaiṣṇavaṁ padam ||83||

dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.śiṣyāṁstu tīrthayātrāyai prerayitvā svay: śiṣyāṁs-tu tīrtha-yātrāyai prerayitvā svayaṁ kuha| uvāsa bhagavān-brūhi śrotum-icchāmi sādaram
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.tatraityaiko dvijo mando namaskṛtyābravī: tatraityaiko dvijo mando namaskṛtyābravīd-gurum | prapadye bhagavaṁs-tvāṁ me mokṣopāyam-upādiśa
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.mayā tu siddhaye kaṣṭaṁ bhūryakāri tathā: mayā tu siddhaye kaṣṭaṁ bhūryakāri tathāpi me | nāptā siddhir-nopalabdhaḥ sanmārga-prāpako guruḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.kathaṁ guruṁ vinā vatsa siddhaye kena yo: kathaṁ guruṁ vinā vatsa siddhaye kena yojitaḥ | kasyājñayā kṛtaṁ kaṣṭam-ity-ākarṇya dvijo'bravīt
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.siddhyai mayā guruḥ kaścicchrutaścaṇḍaḥ: siddhyai mayā guruḥ kaścicchrutaś-caṇḍaḥ sa tu prabho | sevārthī pīḍayāmāsa tatas-tyaktaḥ sa vai mayā
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.hantāsādhu kṛtaṁ dhiktvāṁ gacchetaḥ satv: hantāsādhu kṛtaṁ dhik-tvāṁ gacchetaḥ satvaraṁ yataḥ | guru-drohy-āsyāvaloko na bhadrāya kathaṁcana
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.kathaṁ jñeyaḥ kathaṁ sevyo gurustanme va: kathaṁ jñeyaḥ kathaṁ sevyo gurus-tan-me vadākhilam | ajānatā guru-drohaḥ kṛto'to moddhara prabho
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.etadarthaṁ purā vṛttaṁ śṛṇu dhaumyābhidh: etad-arthaṁ purā vṛttaṁ śṛṇu dhaumyābhidho muniḥ | dvāpare'bhūt trayaś-chātrā āsan-tasyāṅga tatparāḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.baidāruṇopamanvyākhyāḥ sevādharmasuśikṣi: baidāruṇopamanvyākhyāḥ sevā-dharma-suśikṣitāḥ | teṣāṁ parīkṣituṁ bhāvaṁ guruḥ prāha dayārdra-dhīḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.macchāleye'mbvabhāvo'sti jīvetsasyamataḥ: macchāleye'mbvabhāvo'sti jīvet-sasyam-ataḥ kutaḥ | gatvā vaḥ kopi yatnena kṣetram-ambv-ānayatvaram
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.śrutvaivamaruṇo'hrāya gatvā kṣetrasamīpa: śrutvaivam-aruṇo'hrāya gatvā kṣetra-samīpataḥ | jalam-ānīya yatnena palvalāt-kṣetram-unnatam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.dṛṣṭvā'karotkṣetratulyaṁ vārivāraṇamāśu: dṛṣṭvā'karot-kṣetra-tulyaṁ vāri-vāraṇam-āśu tat | jala-pravāhaḥ sahasā kṣetrād-anyatra niryayau
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.nyasto'pi pāṣāṇacayaḥ sthātuṁ tatra śaśā: nyasto'pi pāṣāṇa-cayaḥ sthātuṁ tatra śaśāka no | manye kṣetre jalābhāvād gurur-mā dhik-kariṣyati
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.gurvarthamatra martavyamiti matvobhayatr: gurv-artham-atra martavyam-iti matvobhayatra saḥ | svāṅgaṁ nidhāyopariṣṭāj-jalaiḥ kṣetram-apūrayat
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.kṛpayā parayotthāpya bhaktiṁ jñātvā sa t: kṛpayā parayotthāpya bhaktiṁ jñātvā sa tatkṣaṇam | tasmin-prasannaḥ sambhūya svīyaṁ sāmyaṁ vyadhān-muniḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.vidyāvinayasaṁpanno bhūtvā saṁtoṣya sadg: vidyā-vinaya-saṁpanno bhūtvā saṁtoṣya sad-gurum | tad-ājñayā yayau dhāma svam-arcyo'bhavad-atra saḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.tato baidaṁ guruḥ prāha sasyaṁ me śiṣya: tato baidaṁ guruḥ prāha sasyaṁ me śiṣya sarvataḥ | rakṣayitvānu dhānyaṁ tad-yatnāt-sarvaṁ samānaya
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.ājñā pramāṇamityuktvā paśupakṣinivāraṇai: ājñā pramāṇam-ity-uktvā paśu-pakṣi-nivāraṇaiḥ | sasyaṁ rarakṣa paścāt-tacchitvā dhānyaṁ sa nirmame
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.śaśaṁsa gurave nyasto dhānyarāśirmayā gu: śaśaṁsa gurave nyasto dhānya-rāśir-mayā guro | kṣetre'trānetum-ekaṁ me śakaṭaṁ dehi sarṣabham
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.tacchrutvā śakaṭaṁ tasmai sa lulāyena yo: tacchrutvā śakaṭaṁ tasmai sa lulāyena yojitam | pradadau sa tam-ādāya nītvā vinyasya cākhilān
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.śālīnāharadardhādhvaṁ tatra paṅke sakāsa: śālīn-āharad-ardhādhvaṁ tatra paṅke sakāsaraḥ | saṁlagno'bhūt-svayaṁ so'tha sva-kaṇṭhe'yojayad-yugam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.salulāyaḥ sa śiṣyastu tatra bhārātirekat: salulāyaḥ sa śiṣyas-tu tatra bhārātirekataḥ | papāta tatra sahasā dhaumyaḥ prāpa yadṛcchayā
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.tatkarma prekṣya ghoraṁ taṁ mocayitvā pr: tat-karma prekṣya ghoraṁ taṁ mocayitvā prasanna-dhīḥ | varaṁ tasmai dadau yena sa paratrātra cottamaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.athopamanyumāhaiṣa gāścāraya sadetyatha: athopamanyum-āhaiṣa gāś-cāraya sadetyatha | katikālaṁ tadā cakre svalpa-bhuk-kṣudhito'bhavat
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.vane viprālayānprekṣya svaṁ pupoṣānnayāc: vane viprālayān-prekṣya svaṁ pupoṣānna-yācñayā | puṣṭo'si katham-ity-ukto guruṇā tan-nyavedayat
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.tanme dehīti guruṇā bhāṣitaḥ sa tathākar: tanme dehīti guruṇā bhāṣitaḥ sa tathākarot | sa paścād-yācñayārakṣat-svaṁ tad-vedāpi vai muniḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.dvivāramarpayetyūce sacchiṣyo'pi tathāka: dvivāram-arpayety-ūce sacchiṣyo'pi tathākarot | pītvā rarakṣa gā dugdhaṁ vatsa-pītāvaśeṣakam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.tajjñātvā dhībhraṁśabhiyā vārito guruṇā: taj-jñātvā dhī-bhraṁśa-bhiyā vārito guruṇā vane | arka-kṣīraṁ dadhau pātuṁ tat-tasyākṣṇoḥ papāta ha
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.sa papātāndhavad gāvo yayurgehaṁ gurusta: sa papātāndhavad gāvo yayur-gehaṁ gurus-tadā | anveṣya taṁ tathā dṛṣṭvā taṁ prāha stuhi re'śvinau
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.so'śvistavāddṛṣṭimāpa guruṇā taduparyapi: so'śvi-stavād-dṛṣṭim-āpa guruṇā tad-upary-api | kṛpā kṛtā tena so'pi kṛtakṛtyo'bhavad-drutam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.tacchiṣyā api tattulyā babhūvuḥ śṛṇu sād: tacchiṣyā api tat-tulyā babhūvuḥ śṛṇu sādaram | uddālako'sya śiṣyaḥ sansatre'hīnadahadbahūn
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.atastameva śaraṇaṁ sarvabhāvena gaccha b: atas-tam-eva śaraṇaṁ sarva-bhāvena gaccha bhoḥ | tat-prasādāt-parāṁ śāntiṁ mokṣaṁ prāpsyasi durlabham
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.yujyate bhinnadhātvaikyaṁ na muktāyāstat: yujyate bhinna-dhātvaikyaṁ na muktāyās-tathā hṛdaḥ | tad-buddhi-bhinnaṁ na yāsye'taḥ prāṇāṁs-tyakṣyāmi te'grataḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.iti tanniścayaṁ jñātvā ke vinyasya karaṁ: iti tan-niścayaṁ jñātvā ke vinyasya karaṁ guruḥ | tāpa-dagdhāśubhasyāsya prāhāṅga sva-guruṁ smara
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.dvijo'pi svaguruṁ smṛtvā tatsvarūpamiva: dvijo'pi sva-guruṁ smṛtvā tat-svarūpam-iva prabhum | dadarśa śrī-guruṁ premṇā tuṣṭāva sa mud-aśru-yuk
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.tamāha prāñjaliṁ vipraṁ śrīgurustvaṁ yat: tamāha prāñjaliṁ vipraṁ śrī-gurus-tvaṁ yathākramam | laghu nistīrya karmaughaṁ parāṁ saṁsiddhim-āpsyasi
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.tvayā vyāloki rūpaṁ me yattadbhaktyā sma: tvayā vyāloki rūpaṁ me yat-tad-bhaktyā smaran-kriyāḥ | mad-arthaṁ itsadāsaktaḥ kurvan-siddhim-upaiṣyasi
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/10_adh.iti dvijaṁ taṁ nijarūpadarśanāt sudurlab: iti dvijaṁ taṁ nija-rūpa-darśanāt sudurlabha-svātma-sukhānvitaṁ prabhuḥ|

dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.ka āgataśchātajihvaḥ kathaṁ bhagavatoddh: ka āgataś-chāta-jihvaḥ kathaṁ bhagavatoddhṛtaḥ | tat-kathāmṛtam-āsvādya tṛṣṇā me'tīva vardhate ||1||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.karavīre sudhīputro jāto'jñastaṁ jagurbu: karavīre sudhī-putro jāto'jñas-taṁ jagur-budhāḥ | vipuccha-śṛṅgo gaus-tvaṁ gobhāgyaṁ nāttaṁ tṛṇaṁ tu yat ||2||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.vidyānidhirhartṛlabhyaḥ sa śiṣyārpita ed: vidyā-nidhir-hartṛlabhyaḥ sa śiṣyārpita edhate | śreṣṭheṣv-arcyaṁ karoty-ūnaṁ kvāpy-asvaṁ ca dhanānvitam ||3||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.sukhe strīvāvane'mbeva sakheva kvāpi tāt: sukhe strīvāvane'mbeva sakheva kvāpi tātavat | hite bodhe ca guruvad-vidyā dhik-tvām-avidya re ||4||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.iti nirbhartsitastrasto bhillavāṭīṁ yaya: iti nirbhartsitas-trasto bhilla-vāṭīṁ yayau sa tu | prāyopaviṣṭo'naśana ānarca bhuvaneśvarīm ||5||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.datvā'labdhaprasādo'syai jihvāṁ chettuṁ: datvā'labdha-prasādo'syai jihvāṁ chettuṁ kamudyataḥ | svapne devy-āha taṁ daṇḍī kṛṣṇā-tīre'sti taṁ bhaja ||6||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.iti śrutvā duḥkhito'pi dhṛtyāgatya sa sa: iti śrutvā duḥkhito'pi dhṛtyāgatya sa sad-gurum | nanāmāśrūttagātrastanmūrdhnyadhācchrīguruḥ karam ||7||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.sparśe'yo'pi yathā hema haṁsaḥ kāko'pi m: sparśe'yo'pi yathā hema haṁsaḥ kāko'pi mānase | yathā vidvāṁs-tathābhūt-sa sujihvaḥ sparśanād-vibhoḥ ||8||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.gurvājñayā gṛhaṁ gatvā siddhiṁ prāpobhay: gurv-ājñayā gṛhaṁ gatvā siddhiṁ prāpobhayīṁ dvijaḥ | bhagavāṁs-tata utthāya dakṣiṇābhimukho yayau ||10||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.sarasvatī śivā bhadrā kumbhī bhogavatīty: sarasvatī śivā bhadrā kumbhī bhogavatīty-amūḥ | kṛṣṇāveṇyoḥ saṁgatās-tat-saṁgamas-tūttamottamaḥ ||12||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.sthalaṁ kurupurākhyaṁ tatkurukṣetrādhipu: sthalaṁ kurupurākhyaṁ tat-kurukṣetrādhi-puṇyadam | sākṣāt-prayāgo'yam-agre kāśyāḥ śreṣṭhaṁ mahā-sthalam ||13||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.svaryāti nā tapaḥsnāyī saṁgate'tra sitās: svar-yāti nā tapaḥ-snāyī saṁgate'tra sitāsite | tīrthāny-avāk-pravāhe'tra mahāghaghnāni koṭiśaḥ ||15||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.sadvidyāḍhyāmarapuraṁ prāṅnirīkṣyaitya t: sad-vidyāḍhyāmara-puraṁ prāṅ-nirīkṣyaitya tatra saḥ | svācāraṁ vaidikaṁ dīnaṁ prabhur-bhikṣāṁ sma yācate ||17||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.bhikṣāvṛttestadā sādhvī sāttvikasya kuṭu: bhikṣā-vṛttes-tadā sādhvī sāttvikasya kuṭumbinī | annābhāvād-dadau śākam-ātitheyī tu bhikṣave ||18||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.bhaktyārpitamapi prāśya śākaṁ saṁtṛpta ī: bhaktyārpitam-api prāśya śākaṁ saṁtṛpta īśvaraḥ | tatra śāka-latāṁ dṛṣṭvā tām-utpāṭyāśramaṁ yayau ||19||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.tadā strīrduḥkhitā prāha yogakṣemakarī k: tadā strīr-duḥkhitā prāha yoga-kṣema-karī kutaḥ | unmūlitā latā naiva bhikṣā-śāṭhyaṁ mayā kṛtam ||20||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.tāṁ bhartoce maunamehi na ko'pi sukhaduḥ: tāṁ bhartoce maunam-ehi na ko'pi sukha-duḥkhadaḥ | lokāḥ sva-karma-sūtrotā vṛthāhaṅkāra-saṁśritāḥ ||21||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.īśādhīnaṁ jagatsarvaṁ yenāptavyaṁ tu yat: īśādhīnaṁ jagat-sarvaṁ yenāptavyaṁ tu yat-tataḥ | ko'pi neśo'nyathā kartum-āyuś-cānnaṁ sa yacchati ||22||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.ityāśvāsya vadhūṁ vipro mūlamutkhāya tat: ity-āśvāsya vadhūṁ vipro mūlam-utkhāya tatra saḥ | artha-pūrṇaṁ ghaṭaṁ lebhe sad-guroḥ saṁprasādataḥ ||24||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.sabhāryo'tha dvijo gatvā śaśaṁsa gurave: sabhāryo'tha dvijo gatvā śaśaṁsa gurave tu tat | sa prāha dampatī gopyam-idaṁ śrīr-nānyathā dhruvā ||25||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.aiśvaryaputrapautrāḍhyau saṁbhūyātra nir: aiśvarya-putra-pautrāḍhyau saṁbhūyātra nirāmayau | mokṣaṁ gamiṣyatho nūnaṁ gantavyaṁ sukham-ālayam ||26||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.bhikṣāvṛttiḥ prabhoḥ kasmātkalpadruma ud: bhikṣā-vṛttiḥ prabhoḥ kasmāt-kalpadruma uduṁbaraḥ | sati pūjyatame'śvatthe kuto bhagavatā śritaḥ ||27||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.pakkānnabhikṣuko bhikṣuriti śrutamataṁ p: pakkānna-bhikṣuko bhikṣur-iti śrutamataṁ prabhuḥ | bhikṣuḥ sanlīlayā bheje śambhu-vṛttir-iyaṁ punaḥ ||28||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.nakhā nṛsiṁhāvatāre viṣārtā daityadāraṇā: nakhā nṛsiṁhāvatāre viṣārtā daitya-dāraṇāt | śāntā audumbaraiḥ so'tha prītyānena sadāśritaḥ ||29||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.yatra kvāpyeṣa kalpadrurbhūyāttāpāghadai: yatra kvāpy-eṣa kalpadrur-bhūyāt-tāpāgha-dainya-hṛt | kāma-do'haṁ śriyātrāsam-iti tasmai varo'rpitaḥ ||30||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.viśvātmā yatra tatraiva vedatīrthāmarā a: viśvātmā yatra tatraiva veda-tīrthāmarā api | santy-udumbara evātra kalpadrur-bhuvi nāparaḥ ||31||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.tasmādudumbaratale bhikṣāṁ kutrāpi viśva: tasmād-udumbara-tale bhikṣāṁ kutrāpi viśva-bhṛt | akṛtvā kāma-rūpābhir-yoginībhiḥ sthito'rcitaḥ ||32||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.ajñānāvṛtaviprāstadajñātvocuḥ parasparam: ajñānāvṛta-viprās-tad-ajñātvocuḥ parasparam | kathaṁ jīvaty-akṛtvāyaṁ bhikṣāṁ mṛgyaṁ tad-adya hi ||33||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.itthaṁ vicārya tasthuste madhyāhne yogim: itthaṁ vicārya tasthus-te madhyāhne yogi-māyayā | trastā grāmaṁ yayuḥ ko'pi jñātuṁ śakyo'sya ceṣṭitam ||34||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.śrīguruṁ draṣṭumāgatya bhāviko bhaktibhā: śrī-guruṁ draṣṭum-āgatya bhāviko bhakti-bhāvanam | gaṅgānujākhya-bhakto'tra dṛṣṭavān citram-ekadā ||35||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.jalapūrṇā'pi kṛṣṇādānmārgaṁ tenāgamatpra: jala-pūrṇā'pi kṛṣṇādānmārgaṁ tenāgamat-prabhuḥ | dadarśānvetya bhakto'pi purīṁ divyām-ivāntare ||36||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.nīrājito yoginībhī ratnasiṁhāsanasthitaḥ: nīrājito yoginībhī ratna-siṁhāsana-sthitaḥ | svarcitaḥ prekṣya taṁ devaḥ prāha ko'sy-āgataḥ kutaḥ ||37||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.gaṅgānujābhidho'haṁ tvāmatratyo draṣṭuma: gaṅgānujābhidho'haṁ tvām-atratyo draṣṭum-anvagām | bhavān-parātmā sarveśo daivān-me'dyātra gocaraḥ ||38||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.tvanmāyāmohitātmānas tvāṁ viduḥ kevalaṁ: tvan-māyā-mohitātmānas tvāṁ viduḥ kevalaṁ naram | saṁsāra-sāgare'pāre te'to majjanti netare ||39||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.iti premṇā stutastasmai hṛdyaṁ datveśvar: iti premṇā stutas-tasmai hṛdyaṁ datveśvaro'bravīt | mayi saty-atra yad-dṛṣṭaṁ nākhyeyaṁ kasyacit-tvayā ||40||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.ityukto guruṇā hṛṣṭo bhaktaḥ kṣetraṁ sva: ity-ukto guruṇā hṛṣṭo bhaktaḥ kṣetraṁ svam-etya saḥ | lebhe'sambhāvya-sasyardhiṁ loke śraiṣṭhyaṁ ca saṁvidam ||41||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.sa etya nityamānarca guruṁ prāhaikadā gu: sa etya nityam-ānarca guruṁ prāhaikadā guro | kāśyāṁ tu tristhalī-yātrā varetyāhurna vedmi tām ||42||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.prayāgaḥ saṁgamaḥ kāśīyaṁ gayā karavīrap: prayāgaḥ saṁgamaḥ kāśīyaṁ gayā karavīra-pūḥ | darśayāmīdam-etadvat tristhalaṁ te drutaṁ param ||43||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.ityuktvā dhārayitvā svapāduke tristhalīṁ: ity-uktvā dhārayitvā sva-pāduke tristhalīṁ tvimām | prayāga-kāśyau gayāṁ ca darśayitvāgamat-kṣaṇāt ||44||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.tamāha tristhalī tveṣā darśitānyāpi tādṛ: tamāha tristhalī tveṣā darśitānyāpi tādṛśī | sāmyaṁ jñātvobhayor-atra svācārān-muktim-eṣyasi ||45||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.iti yogīśavākyaṁ sa śrutvā jñātvā'sya ce: iti yogīśa-vākyaṁ sa śrutvā jñātvā'sya ceṣṭitam | tad-dhyānāt-karma-bandhaṁ drāk chitvā mukto babhūva ha ||46||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.vṛddho'tra mahimā santa āyāsyantītare'py: vṛddho'tra mahimā santa āyāsyantītare'pyataḥ | gantavyaṁ kvāpi na stheyaṁ sākṣād-atrety-amaṁsta saḥ ||47||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.no hitvādya kva yāsīti vilapantīḥ sa yog: no hitvādya kva yāsīti vilapantīḥ sa yoginīḥ | āśvāsyoce'tra tiṣṭhāmi loka-dṛṣṭyā gamiṣya it ||48||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.amareśo'nnapūrṇātra vighneśo yuṣmadādaya: amareśo'nnapūrṇātra vighneśo yuṣmad-ādayaḥ | bhakteṣṭa-dā mayā'pyatra stheyaṁ vas-tuṣṭaye sadā ||49||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.itaḥ prabhṛtyadaḥ kṣetraṁ suprasiddhaṁ b: itaḥ prabhṛty-adaḥ kṣetraṁ suprasiddhaṁ bhaviṣyati | bahu-loka-nivāso'tra yāsyantyatra janāḥ sukham ||50||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.putraṁ vandhyā'bhayaṁ trasto niḥsvaḥ sva: putraṁ vandhyā'bhayaṁ trasto niḥsvaḥ svaṁ rogy-anāmayam | mumukṣuḥ sad-gatiṁ yad-yad-yasyeṣṭaṁ sa labhet-sadā ||52||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/11_adh.so'bhīṣṭaṁ tviti tāḥ prabhāṣya sa yayau: so'bhīṣṭaṁ tviti tāḥ prabhāṣya sa yayau bhīmā-taṭaṁ yogi-rāṭ ||55||

dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.gate'pi bhagavatyaṅga kṛṣṇāveṇītaṭāśra: gate'pi  bhagavaty-aṅga  kṛṣṇāveṇī-taṭāśramāt | tasmāt-tatraiva bhajatāṁ kārya-siddhiḥ kuto vada
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.gatisthityāsanasvapnā na kadāpi cidātman: gati-sthity-āsana-svapnā na kadāpi cid-ātmani | līleyaṁ mānuṣī tasya narānukṛti-kāraṇaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.bhāvyate'jo bhāvanayā yadvattadvadvibh: bhāvyate'jo  bhāvanayā  yadvat-tadvad-vibhāty-asau | evaṁ  yad-bhāvanātredṛk tādṛg-jāgarti tatra saḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.yoginīvaradānādi yairyairgaṅgānujācchrut: yoginī-vara-dānādi yair-yair-gaṅgānujācchrutam | te te bhaktyābhajaṁs-tatra taṁ sa tat-kāmado'bhavat
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.śṛṇvevaṁ sati tatratyā mṛtāpatyatvaduḥkh: śṛṇvevaṁ sati tatratyā mṛtāpatyatva-duḥkhitā | kācid dvija-satī viprān-svasty-arthaṁ śaraṇaṁ yayau
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.prapannāṁ prekṣya tāṁ dīnāṁ nijabhaktivi: prapannāṁ prekṣya tāṁ dīnāṁ nija-bhakti-vidhitsayā | deva-prerita-dhīḥ  kaścit-tadaivaṁ  bhūsuro'bravīt
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.mṛtāpatyatvadoṣāṁstu śṛṇu sādhvi purārji: mṛtāpatyatva-doṣāṁs-tu śṛṇu sādhvi purārjitān | mṛtāpatyatvādi-doṣāḥ  prāyaśaḥ  preta-hetavaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.brahmahā bhrūṇahā vā'pi goghno'śvaghno'p: brahmahā bhrūṇahā vā'pi goghno'śvaghno'parārthahṛt | brahma-svāt-svarṇahā pāpī labhej-janmāntare tvidam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.lohāśmadārucūrṇāni prayatnājjarayetpumān: lohāśma-dāru-cūrṇāni prayatnāj-jarayet-pumān | brahma-svaṁ  triṣu  lokeṣu  kaḥ kathaṁ jarayiṣyati
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.hṛtasvārthābhilāṣeṇa cenmṛto brāhmaṇaḥ s: hṛta-svārthābhilāṣeṇa cen-mṛto brāhmaṇaḥ sa tu | gatvā piśācatāṁ svārthī sadā syāddhartṛ-vaṁśahā
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.tvayā bhavāntare sādhvi hṛtaṁ śaunakagot: tvayā bhavāntare sādhvi hṛtaṁ śaunaka-gotriṇaḥ | dravyaṁ viprasya so'rbhāṁs-te bhūtvā preto nihanty-uta
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.bhogādeva kṣayaḥ sādhvi nānyathārabdhaka: bhogād-eva kṣayaḥ sādhvi nānyathārabdha-karmaṇaḥ | tasmāt-prārabdhaja-phalaṁ bhuṅkṣva ko'tra nivārakaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.tacchrutvā karṇaśūlābhaṁ trastacittā'bra: tacchrutvā karṇa-śūlābhaṁ trasta-cittā'bravīd dvijam | bho  brahman-mānugṛhṇīṣva mukty-upāyam-upādiśa
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.pretaurdhvadehikaṁ karma prāyaścittapu: pretaurdhvadehikaṁ  karma  prāyaścitta-puraḥsaram | kārayitvāṅga  bhartrā  tvaṁ  māsa-mātraṁ  vrataṁ  cara
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.kṛṣṇāpañcanadīyoge snātvā śrīgurupāduk: kṛṣṇā-pañcanadī-yoge  snātvā  śrī-guru-pādukām | udumbaraṁ  cāṣṭa-tīrtha-snāna-pūrvaṁ  samarcaya
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.brāhmaṇānbhojayitvātha śatadravyaṁ dvi: brāhmaṇān-bhojayitvātha  śata-dravyaṁ  dvijātaye | dehi śaunaka-gotrāya śuddhis-tenaiva te  sati
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.śatadravyaṁ kuto labhyaṁ māsamātraṁ karo: śata-dravyaṁ kuto labhyaṁ māsa-mātraṁ karomy-aham | sad-guror-arcanaṁ bhaktyā sa māṁ pāyāddhayāddhariḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.iti niścitya sā patyā yathānirdiṣṭamācar: iti niścitya sā patyā yathānirdiṣṭam-ācarat | dina-trayāntare  svapne  tasyā vipra-piśācakaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.brāhmaṇīṁ bhīṣayitvā tāṁ yayāce dravya: brāhmaṇīṁ bhīṣayitvā tāṁ  yayāce  dravyam-ātmanaḥ | bhītodumbara-mūle  sā  dadarśa  śrī-guruṁ harim
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.tāṁ ca taṁ tādṛśaṁ dṛṣṭvā piśācaṁ prāha: tāṁ ca taṁ tādṛśaṁ dṛṣṭvā piśācaṁ prāha sad-guruḥ | kas-tvaṁ  piśāca-rūpeṇa  satīṁ khedayase'dhama
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.yatīndra tvayyanarho'yaṁ pakṣapāto'ham: yatīndra  tvayy-anarho'yaṁ  pakṣapāto'ham-ātmanaḥ | anayā'pahṛtaṁ dravyaṁ yācituṁ hīdṛśo'bhavam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.anena te kathaṁ mokṣo bahvamaṅgalayo: anena  te  kathaṁ  mokṣo  bahv-amaṅgala-yonitaḥ | yenāpyate sad-gatis-tacchṛṇu tena hitaṁ  bhavet
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.yonyantare hṛtārtho'sti kiṁtvatra phalab: yony-antare hṛtārtho'sti kiṁtv-atra phala-bhāginī | prāptā daridra-vaṁśe'sau labhyate'taḥ kuto dhanam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.atastayā kārayitvā śaktyā karmaurdhvadeh: atas-tayā kārayitvā śaktyā karmaurdhvadehikam | tvad-gotrāya yathālabhyaṁ dāpayitvā  dhanaṁ khalu
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.viprāya preta kasmaicittato mokṣaṁ dadām: viprāya preta kasmaicit-tato mokṣaṁ dadāmi te | nedaṁ tvāṁ rocate cettāṁ rakṣāmi  svecchayācara
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.devadeva kṛtārtho'smi tvatpādābjaviloc: deva-deva  kṛtārtho'smi  tvat-pādābja-vilocanāt | mamādya niṣkṛtir-jātā yathecchasi tathā kuru
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.evaṁ tanniścayaṁ jñātvā brāhmaṇīṁ pr: evaṁ  tan-niścayaṁ  jñātvā  brāhmaṇīṁ  prāha  sad-guruḥ | saṁvādo nau śrutaḥ sādhvi tathā nirvyājam-ācara
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.tenāsau sadgatiṁ yāyādvaṁśavṛddhiśca: tenāsau  sad-gatiṁ  yāyād-vaṁśa-vṛddhiś-ca  te  bhavet | uktvaivaṁ   dhyāna-gamyo'bhūddharir-buddhā'bhavat-satī
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.patye śaśaṁsa tatsarvaṁ tathaivācīkara: patye śaśaṁsa tat-sarvaṁ   tathaivācīkarat-kriyām | tayā  preto  gatiṁ  lebhe  sāpy-apāpā babhūva ha
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.apare'hani tatsvapne phale vinyasya c: apare'hani  tat-svapne  phale  vinyasya cāṁśuke | tāmāha bhojayitvā'jo viprān-bhuṅkṣva phaletv-iti
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.prabuddhāpi phale dṛṣṭvā bhojayitvā dvij: prabuddhāpi phale dṛṣṭvā bhojayitvā dvijān phale | kāntena  sākaṁ  bubhuje  tato'bhūd-garbhiṇī satī
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.kāle dattaprasādena sūryācandramas: kāle    datta-prasādena    sūryācandramasāv-iva | putrāv-asūta vipro'pi jāta-karmādikaṁ vyadhāt
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.tato'ṣṭame'bde jyeṣṭhasya vratabandhaṁ c: tato'ṣṭame'bde jyeṣṭhasya vrata-bandhaṁ cikīrṣuṇā | sambhārāḥ  saṁbhṛtāḥ  pitrā  tadādbhutam-ivābhavat
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.akasmātsannipātena jyeṣṭhaputro mamāra: akasmāt-sannipātena jyeṣṭha-putro mamāra   hi | uccai  ruroda  tan-mātā  korastāḍanapūrvakam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.bhojanāvasaro'yaṁ te bhuktvā rantuṁ c: bhojanāvasaro'yaṁ te  bhuktvā  rantuṁ  carāṅgaṇe | vayasyā  āhvayanti  tvām-uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha  mā  svapa
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.tvaṁ nottiṣṭhasi cetprāṇāṁstyakṣyāmyagre: tvaṁ nottiṣṭhasi cet-prāṇāṁs-tyakṣyāmy-agre tavādhunā | jātā  ye  pañca-putrā  me  teṣāṁ  tvaṁ  prāṇavan-mama
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.mṛte tvayi mariṣye me yataḥ prāṇo'si kev: mṛte tvayi mariṣye me yataḥ prāṇo'si kevalam | re  dohada-prabhṛty-adya  yāvad-duḥkhaṁ  na   dāpitam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.dharmo'yaṁ te na vārdhakye trātā nau put: dharmo'yaṁ te na vārdhakye trātā nau putra ko vada| evaṁ  tad-ruditaṁ  śrutvā  tatratyā  ūcur-etya  tām
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.kiṁ śocasi vṛthā bhīru mṛtyurdevarṣidāna: kiṁ śocasi vṛthā bhīru mṛtyur-devarṣi-dānavān | na  vismarati  kāle'pi  manuṣyāṇāṁ tu kā kathā
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.avatārā ye'vatīrṇāste'pi kālavaśaṁ gatā: avatārā ye'vatīrṇās-te'pi kāla-vaśaṁ  gatāḥ | evaṁ sati vṛthā śokaṁ tvaṁ mā kuru vicāraya
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.aho bata piśācotthaṁ dūrīkṛtya bhayaṁ hi: aho bata piśācotthaṁ dūrīkṛtya bhayaṁ hi me | yena  devena yadattaṁ phalaṁ tad-viphalaṁ katham
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.yadi tasya mṛṣā vākyaṁ taṁ bhajanti kuto: yadi tasya mṛṣā vākyaṁ taṁ bhajanti kuto'pare |  bibhīṣaṇa-dhruva-mukhair-mantavyaṁ  taddṛtaṁ  katham
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.lokāntare nayāmyetāṁ tatkīrtiṁ sūnunā sa: lokāntare nayāmy-etāṁ tat-kīrtiṁ sūnunā saha | evaṁ  ruditvā  saṁskartuṁ  na  dadau  śavam-aṅganā
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.grāme tu bhojanābhāvāllokāstrastāstadait: grāme tu bhojanābhāvāl-lokās-trastās-tadaitya hi | yadṛcchayā'bravīd-vāgmī jaṭilas-tāpasaḥ satīm
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.kiṁ śocasi mudhā sādhvi śokasyāviṣayaṁ s: kiṁ śocasi mudhā sādhvi śokasyāviṣayaṁ sutam | sutas-tavaiṣa deho  vā jīvo vā brūhi sārataḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.tvagraktamāṁsāsthimayo deho'yaṁ pura: tvag-rakta-māṁsāsthi-mayo   deho'yaṁ   puratas-tava | jīvo'jaḥ sarvago'nantaḥ kotra śug-viṣayo vada
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.kālakarmaguṇotpannaṁ jaganmāyāmayaṁ: kāla-karma-guṇotpannaṁ   jagan-māyāmayaṁ   tvidam | kathaṁ dhruvaṁ hi mantavyaṁ yathā  karmaindrajālikam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.tvayā dhruvā mateyaṁ cedda pūrvā: tvayā   dhruvā   mateyaṁ   cedda   pūrvāparodbhave | kasya tvaṁ jananī strīr-vā ke vā sambandhinas-tava
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.janmamṛtyū kālavaśādalaṅghyau dinarātriv: janma-mṛtyū kāla-vaśād-alaṅghyau dina-rātrivat | śarīriṇo'ṅge  bālyādi  yathā dehāntaraṁ tathā
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.guruprasādādyatato bhramo'yaṁ līyate'c: guru-prasādād-yatato  bhramo'yaṁ  līyate'cirāt | tenarte  mṛtyave kalpyo jāto vai januṣe mṛtaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.nāryato'parihārye'rthe na tvaṁ śocitu: nāryato'parihārye'rthe  na  tvaṁ  śocitum-arhasi | mṛtaḥ śucā punar-naiti nāpy-upāyāntarāyutaiḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.na vedāntārthatattvādi rocate yena me: na vedāntārtha-tattvādi  rocate  yena  me'rpitam | suphalaṁ tat-kuto yātaṁ viśvastavyaḥ sa kair-bhuvi
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.yatra tvayā varo labdhastatra gatvā sa: yatra  tvayā  varo labdhas-tatra gatvā savistaram | varadaṁ paripṛcchedaṁ yāsye'laṁ vistareṇa bhoḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.tacchrutvā śavamādāya sadgurorāśramaṁ: tacchrutvā  śavam-ādāya  sad-guror-āśramaṁ  yayau | tatra pādukayoḥ śīrṣaṁ tāḍayāmāsa bhāminī
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.evaṁ niśīthādāsāyaṁ śuśoca na dadau ś: evaṁ  niśīthādāsāyaṁ  śuśoca  na dadau śavam | saṁskartuṁ svālayaṁ viprā jagmus-tatraiva dampatī
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.tato niśīthe suṣvāpa sādhvī svapne dadar: tato niśīthe suṣvāpa sādhvī svapne dadarśa sā | śrī-guruṁ prāha so'py-enāṁ kiṁ mayāpakṛtaṁ hi te
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.prāṇo nāmaiṣa vāyuḥ sa bahiryāto muhurma: prāṇo nāmaiṣa vāyuḥ sa bahir-yāto muhur-mayā | ānīya   pūrvavanyastastyajātaḥ   śucam-aṅgane
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.iti dṛṣṭvā vinidrā'bhūd dadarśotthitamāt: iti dṛṣṭvā vinidrā'bhūd dadarśotthitam-ātmajam | harṣa-śokānvitā sādhvī premṇā bhartāram-āhvayat
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.so'pyutthāyātmajaṁ dṛṣṭvā rudantaṁ kṣutt: so'py-utthāyātmajaṁ dṛṣṭvā rudantaṁ kṣut-tṛḍākulam | mantravat trir-avaghrāya mūrdhy-astauṣīt-parātparam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.atrāntare prātarabhūd dagdhuṁ prāpuḥ śav: atrāntare prātar-abhūd dagdhuṁ prāpuḥ śavaṁ dvijāḥ | te jīvantaṁ sutaṁ dṛṣṭvā sarvaṁ śrutvā'stuvan-harim
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.dampatī tu tataḥ snātvā prapūjyeśaṁ suvi: dampatī tu tataḥ snātvā prapūjyeśaṁ suvistarāt | nīrājyābhyarcya  bhūdevān-jagmatur-nija-mandiram
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/12_adh.tatrā'śrāntaṁ sa jāgarti śrīnṛsiṁhasar: tatrā'śrāntaṁ sa  jāgarti  śrī-nṛsiṁhasarasvatī | adya kālāntare'py-evaṁ na nidrāty-anyavat-kalau

dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.āsādya bhagavānbhīmāṁ tataḥ kimakarotpra: āsādya bhagavān-bhīmāṁ tataḥ kim-akarot-prabhuḥ | śraddhānāya me śaṁsa durgrahaṁ tasya ceṣṭitam ||1||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.sthitvātra guptabhāvena tatratyabrāhmaṇā: sthitvātra gupta-bhāvena tatratya-brāhmaṇālayam | gatvā bhikṣāṁ yayāce'sau bhaktoddharaṇa-hetave ||3||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.ekadā dīnaviprasya gehe cyutaradāṁ vaśām: ekadā dīna-viprasya gehe cyutaradāṁ vaśām | mahiṣīṁ prekṣya sa prāha brāhmaṇīṁ dehi me payaḥ ||6||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.mṛṣā mā vada tāṁ dugdhvā kṣīraṁ dehīti b: mṛṣā mā vada tāṁ dugdhvā kṣīraṁ dehīti bhāṣitā | guruṇāpi vaśāṁ dugdhvā kāṣṭha-pātre'labhat-payaḥ ||8||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.vismitā sārpayattasmai koṣṇaṁ kṛtvā payo: vismitā sārpayat-tasmai koṣṇaṁ kṛtvā payo mudā | pītvā kṣīraṁ yayau premṇā śrī-guruḥ saṁgamaṁ drutam ||9||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.anyedyurbhāravāhārthaṁ vaśāmāhartumāgatā: anyedyur-bhāra-vāhārthaṁ vaśām-āhartum-āgatāḥ | kṛṣīvalāḥ prekṣya dohaṁ śaśaṁsur-drāṅ nṛpāya tat ||11||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.nṛpo'pyākarṇya viprāttañcaturaṅgabalānvi: nṛpo'py-ākarṇya viprāt-tañ-caturaṅga-balānvitaḥ | gurv-arthaṁ rāja-cihnāni gṛhītvā saṅgamaṁ yayau ||12||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.tametya praṇipatyoce daṇḍavadgadgadākṣar: tam-etya praṇipatyoce daṇḍavad-gadgadākṣaraḥ | pulakāṅkita-deho rāḍ dīnaṁ mām-pāhi kiṅkaram ||13||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.bhavānmāyānaro bhikṣurnaivāsti parameśva: bhavān-māyā-naro bhikṣur-naivāsti parameśvara | hitvāraṇya-vihāraṁ bho pāvanaṁ kuru me puram ||15||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.itthaṁ śrutvā sakāruṇyamudāraṁ vākyamacy: itthaṁ śrutvā sakāruṇyam-udāraṁ vākyam-acyutaḥ | tathety-uktvā''yayau premṇā puraṁ pāvana-pāvanaḥ ||16||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.vedaghoṣaṁ dvijāścakrurmāgadhāḥ stotramu: veda-ghoṣaṁ dvijāś-cakrur-māgadhāḥ stotram-uttamam | jaya-ghoṣaṁ tathāpy-anya evaṁ gopuram-āgataḥ ||18||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.guruḥ pratyakpathaṁ puryā etvā'śvatthe b: guruḥ pratyak-pathaṁ puryā etvā'śvatthe bhayaṅkaram | sa brahmarākṣasaṁ śakraṁ dadarśātīndriyaḥ prabhuḥ ||19||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.taddarśanānnarādbhūtvā praśānto hyavaruh: taddarśanānnarādbhūtvā praśānto hy-avaruhya saḥ | guruṁ natvoddhara hare kuyoner-mety-uvāca tam ||20||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.karastanmūrdhni vinyasto guruṇāthābhavan: karas-tan-mūrdhni vinyasto guruṇāthābhavan-nṛvat | tamāha saṁgama-snānācchīghraṁ mukto bhaviṣyasi ||21||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.iti śrutvā namaskṛtya guruṁ snātvā sa sa: iti śrutvā namaskṛtya guruṁ snātvā sa saṁgame | vihāya bhautikaṁ kāyaṁ mumuce karma-bandhanāt ||22||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.dṛṣṭvedaṁ rāḍabhiṣṭūya tasmā āmreḍitokti: dṛṣṭvedaṁ rāḍ-abhiṣṭūya tasmā āmreḍitoktibhiḥ | puraṁ nītvā sumaṭhikāṁ nirmāyāsmā upānayat ||23||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.āhnikaṁ saṁgame bhikṣāṁ grāme nivasatiṁ: āhnikaṁ saṁgame bhikṣāṁ grāme nivasatiṁ maṭhe | sa kṛtvā bhakta-vātsalyād-rāṇ-nighno bhagavān-abhūt ||25||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.tajjñātvāśeṣahṛtsaṁsthaḥ sarvasākṣī jaga: taj-jñātvāśeṣa-hṛt-saṁsthaḥ sarva-sākṣī jagat-prabhuḥ | bhūpaṁ prāhādya gantavyaṁ nindakārdana-hetave ||27||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.supālake tūpaveśya nṛpacihnaiḥ pariṣkṛta: supālake tūpaveśya nṛpa-cihnaiḥ pariṣkṛtam | śrī-guruṁ kumasī-grāmaṁ ninye rāḍ yatra bhāratī ||29||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.nṛsiṁhadhyānaniṣṭho'pi sa tadā yogimāyay: nṛsiṁha-dhyāna-niṣṭho'pi sa tadā yogi-māyayā | sambhūya cañcala-manā ājahre stotum-īśvaram ||30||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.suprasanna nṛsiṁheśa dayābdhe bhaktabhāv: suprasanna nṛsiṁheśa dayābdhe bhakta-bhāvana | kasmāt-te'dya na sāmīpyaṁ dhyāne stoṣye dayasva bhoḥ ||31||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.stutvaivaṁ sa nadītīre dhyānājjñātvā sth: stutvaivaṁ sa nadī-tīre dhyānāj-jñātvā sthitaṁ vibhum | trasta-citto'bhyagād draṣṭum-acintyāvyakta-vigraham ||32||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.tamāha durnirīkṣyaṁ me rūpaṁ divyadṛśāpi: tamāha durnirīkṣyaṁ me rūpaṁ divya-dṛśāpi te | darśitaṁ dhyāna-hṛṣṭena dhāmātho paśya laukikam ||43||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.kāyena manasā vācā kevalairindriyairapi: kāyena manasā vācā kevalair-indriyair-api | asatkṛto'si viśvātman-mayā tvāṁ kṣāmaye'dya tat ||45||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi kṛtakāryo'smi da: dhanyo'smy-anugṛhīto'smi kṛta-kāryo'smi darśanāt | rūpaṁ purā'rjunāyedaṁ darśitaṁ me'dya tat-punaḥ ||46||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.hare'vidyāpravāhe māṁ majjantaṁ jñānanau: hare'vidyāpravāhe māṁ majjantaṁ jñāna-naukayā | kṛpā-marut-saṁgatayā svātma-rūpa-taṭaṁ naya ||47||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/13_adh.kṣaṇātsasainyabhūpena sākametya maṭhaṁ p: kṣaṇāt-sasainya-bhūpena sākam-etya maṭhaṁ prabhuḥ | karma-mārgaṁ tatāneśaś-cikīrṣur-loka-saṁgraham ||49||

dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.jñānayoga iyānuktaḥ siddhyai saṁnyāsasat: jñāna-yoga iyān-uktaḥ siddhyai saṁnyāsa-sat-pathaḥ| kuto bhagavatā paścāt-karma-yogaḥ prakāśitaḥ ||1||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.avidyāghātakaṁ karma tadutthaṁ kathamity: avidyā-ghātakaṁ karma tad-utthaṁ katham-ity-amum| chindhi me saṁśaya-granthim bhagavac-caritāsinā ||2||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.karkaṭīṁ tadbhavā ghnanti yathā mṛtkṣāla: karkaṭīṁ tad-bhavā ghnanti yathā mṛt-kṣālanaṁ mṛdā | tathā'vidyā ca karmāpi karmaṇaiva vilīyate ||3||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.prakṛtyutthaguṇaiḥ ko'pi jātvakarmā na t: prakṛty-uttha-guṇaiḥ ko'pi jātv-akarmā na tat-phale | sakto'jño'sakta idvidvānasyedaṁ loka-saṁgrahe ||5||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.ahaṁ yathānutiṣṭhāmi lokastadanugo bhave: ahaṁ yathānutiṣṭhāmi lokas-tad-anugo bhavet | nedaṁ sādhv-iti matvā'jaḥ karma-yogaṁ jagau prabhuḥ ||6||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.karmayogamayaṁ tasya ceṣṭitaṁ śṛṇu sādar: karma-yogamayaṁ tasya ceṣṭitaṁ śṛṇu sādaram | yacchutvā bhava-sambandhaṁ chitvā yāti paraṁ padam ||7||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.brahmadhrugyavano rājā kaściddhiṁsro'bha: brahmadhrugyavano rājā kaściddhiṁsro'bhavat-khalaḥ | sadasyāhūya viprān-sa svāgre vedān-apāṭhayat ||8||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.vedānpaṭhanti ye sārthāstebhyo dāsye dha: vedān-paṭhanti ye sārthās-tebhyo dāsye dhanaṁ bahu | ity-ākarṇya tad-uktaṁ ye rai-lubdhās-te tathā'bhajan ||9||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.evaṁ satyekadā viprau vaidikāvetya durvi: evaṁ saty-ekadā viprau vaidikāvetya durvidhau | mattau tam-ūcatū rājan veda-śāstra-vidau sva it ||11||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.asmattulyau na kau kvāpi tvannighnāścedi: asmat-tulyau na kau kvāpi tvan-nighnāś-ced-ihānaya | śrutvedaṁ svāśritebhyo rāṭ śaśaṁsocuḥ khalaṁ hi te ||12||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.na yānti saṁmukhe ke'pi tayostattau sama: na yānti saṁmukhe ke'pi tayos-tat-tau samarcaya | rājāpy-ānarca tau viprau gajāv-ārohya bhūṣitau ||13||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.vidyāpariśramo vādaṁ vinā na saphalo'sti: vidyā-pariśramo vādaṁ vinā na saphalo'sti nau | tad-ājñāpaya gacchāvo gāṁ jetuṁ viduṣo dvijān ||15||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.vāvadūkatayā mithyā dvijāṁstarjayatoḥ sa: vāvadūkatayā mithyā dvijāṁs-tarjayatoḥ sadā| vivādaṁ tyājitaiḥ prājñair-jayo'bhūd-viśadas-tayoḥ ||17||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.trivikramaṁ trayījñaṁ tau śrutvāgatyocat: trivikramaṁ trayījñaṁ tau śrutvāgatyocatuḥ kuru | ced-veda-jño'si vādaṁ nau dehi vā jayapatramit ||18||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.vedajñāstvādṛśāḥ pūjyā dvijau nāhaṁ tath: veda-jñās-tvādṛśāḥ pūjyā dvijau nāhaṁ tathāvidhaḥ | yatau jayājaya-same jite kiṁ vāṁ bhaved-iha ||19||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.paśyemānyamitāni tvaṁ patraṁ dehīti bhāṣ: paśyemāny-amitāni tvaṁ patraṁ dehīti bhāṣitaḥ | tābhyāṁ dāsye guror-agra ity-uktvā śrī-guruṁ yayau ||20||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.tau mattau svāsanārūḍhau mūḍhau tamanuja: tau mattau svāsanārūḍhau mūḍhau tam-anujagmatuḥ | maṭhe śrī-gurum-āsādya tamas-tauṣīt trivikramaḥ ||21||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.stutvaivamāditaḥ sarvaṁ śaśaṁsāgamakāraṇ: stutvaivam-āditaḥ sarvaṁ śaśaṁsāgama-kāraṇam | tau prāha gurur-apy-āptau sādhyam-etena kiṁ dvijau ||24||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.rājñājñaptau dvijānjetumāvāṁ vidvattamau: rājñājñaptau dvijān-jetum-āvāṁ vidvattamau bhuvi | atrānītāvanenobhau bhikṣū kiṁ veda-pāragau ||25||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.garveṇaiva praṇaṣṭāḥ syū rākṣasā asurā d: garveṇaiva praṇaṣṭāḥ syū rākṣasā asurā dvijau | anādīn-kṛtsnaśo'nantān-ko'pi vedān-na veda re ||26||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.brahmacaryāśrame vedānpaṭhituṁ prāktapo': brahmacaryāśrame vedān-paṭhituṁ prāk-tapo'tapat | bharadvājo vidhiḥ prītas-tasmai vedān-adarśayat ||27||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.dṛṣṭvā bhāsvadvedarāśīn śaṅkito'bhūdṛṣir: dṛṣṭvā bhāsvad-veda-rāśīn śaṅkito'bhūd-ṛṣir-dadau | trīn-muṣṭīn-ṛṣaye'dyāpi paṭhyamāno na pāragaḥ ||28||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.pailo vaiśampāyanaśca jaiminiśca sumantu: pailo vaiśampāyanaś-ca jaiminiś-ca sumantukaḥ | ṛg-yajuḥ-sāmātharvākhyā aśikṣanta śrutīḥ kramāt ||29||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.gururvyāso hariḥ sākṣāttato'tra prasṛtā: gurur-vyāso hariḥ sākṣāt-tato'tra prasṛtā śrutiḥ | paṭhitāḥ katicid-vedā āyuṣmadbhir-yugāntare ||30||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.svarṇo'trigotrajo gāyatracchando brāhmad: svarṇo'tri-gotrajo gāyatracchando brāhma-daivataḥ | dvyaratni-mātro dīrghākṣa ṛgvedo vyakta-kandharaḥ ||33||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.śākalā bāṣkalā tasyāḥ sāṁkhyāyanyāśvalāy: śākalā bāṣkalā tasyāḥ sāṁkhyāyany-āśvalāyani | māṇḍūkyetthaṁ pañca śākhā aṣṭau vikṛtayas-tv-ṛcaḥ ||34||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.niruktaṁ vyākṛtirjyotiśchandaḥ śikṣā ca: niruktaṁ vyākṛtir-jyotiś-chandaḥ śikṣā ca kalpakaḥ | asyemāni ṣaḍaṅgāni vettīmaṁ ko'dya kṛtsnaśaḥ ||35||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.pañcāratnimito'rkābhaḥ kapālī kṛśadīrgha: pañcāratni-mito'rkābhaḥ kapālī kṛśa-dīrghakaḥ | yajurvedo dhanur-vedaḥ kṣatreṣṭho'syopaveda ut ||36||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.pariśiṣṭānyupāṅgāni ṣaḍevaiṣa iyān tataḥ: pariśiṣṭāny-upāṅgāni ṣaḍ-evaiṣa iyān tataḥ | kṣamī dāntaḥ śuciḥ sragvī carmī daṇḍī tṛtīyakaḥ ||38||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.hatā naṣṭāścāpi śiṣṭā navāṣṭau ca bhido': hatā naṣṭāś-cāpi śiṣṭā navāṣṭau ca bhido'sya tu | sāmāṅgopāṅga-bhedena kaḥ pumān-vedituṁ kṣamaḥ ||40||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.baijānagotrajo'nuṣṭupchandā eṣaindradaiv: baijāna-gotrajo'nuṣṭup-chandā eṣaindra-daivataḥ | navāsya bhedāḥ saṁpūrṇāḥ kalpāḥ pañcātra vetti kaḥ ||42||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.sarvasvadakṣiṇā bhūpairdattāpi brāhmaṇai: sarvasva-dakṣiṇā bhūpair-dattāpi brāhmaṇaiḥ purā | nāttā kṛto'dris-tṛṇavat susattvāc-cādrivat-tṛṇam ||46||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.vaśasarvāmarāste'pi tadā svalpajñamānina: vaśasarvāmarāste'pi tadā svalpajña-māninaḥ | yuvāṁ bhraṣṭau bhraṣṭa-mantrau svalpajñau prājña-māninau ||47||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.naitāvacchrotumāptau svo vivādaṁ kuru ce: naitāvacchrotum-āptau svo vivādaṁ kuru cenna vām | tacchaktir-jaya-patraṁ nau yuvābhyāṁ dīyatām-iti ||49||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.tathetyuktvodvīkṣya yāntamānayitvāntyaja: tathety-uktvodvīkṣya yāntam-ānayitvāntyajaṁ prabhuḥ | lekhā ullikhya saptābhyutkrāmayantam-avācayat ||50||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.prācīnasaptajanmajño rekhāsparśanato'bha: prācīna-sapta-janmajño rekhā-sparśanato'bhavat | ādyāṁ gatvāsmi buraḍo mātaṁga iti bhāṣitam ||51||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.dvitīyāṁ tu kirātottho rāvaṇākhya itīrit: dvitīyāṁ tu kirātottho rāvaṇākhya itīritam | tṛtīyāṁ ca nadī-tīra-stho gāṅgeya itīritam ||52||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.caturthīṁ vai kṛṣipaṭuḥ śūdro'smītyabhib: caturthīṁ vai kṛṣi-paṭuḥ śūdro'smītyabhibhāṣitam | pañcamīṁ somadattākhyo vaiśyo'smīty-uditaṁ tataḥ ||53||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.ṣaṣṭhīṁ govardhanākhyo'haṁ kṣatraḥ śūra: ṣaṣṭhīṁ govardhanākhyo'haṁ kṣatraḥ śūra itīritam | saptamīṁ veda-śāstra-jño brāhmaṇo'smīti bhāṣitam ||54||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.tadāsya mantritaṁ bhasma kṣiptvāṅge prab: tadāsya mantritaṁ bhasma kṣiptvāṅge prabhur-āha tam | ced-veda-jño'si viprau drāg-vivādena parājahi ||55||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.iti śrutveśavākyaṁ tau pratyāhitadhiyau: iti śrutveśa-vākyaṁ tau pratyāhita-dhiyau bhiyā | kampitau śrī-guruṁ gatvā viprau śaraṇam-ūcatuḥ ||56||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.brahmadviṣau svaḥ pāpiṣṭhau duṣṭasaṅgāhi: brahma-dviṣau svaḥ pāpiṣṭhau duṣṭa-saṅgāhita-bhramau | mūḍhau nau durgatiṁ yāntau samuddhartuṁ hare'rhasi ||57||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.mlecchāgre paṭhitā vedā dhikkṛtā brāhmaṇ: mlecchāgre paṭhitā vedā dhik-kṛtā brāhmaṇā yatiḥ | tat-karma-paripākārthaṁ rākṣasau drāg-bhaviṣyathaḥ ||58||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.ityuktau guruṇā gatvā bhīmāṁ snātvā mṛtā: ity-uktau guruṇā gatvā bhīmāṁ snātvā mṛtāv-ubhau | rākṣasau guru-vākyāt-tau bhūtvā tatraiva tasthatuḥ ||60||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.tatra yāndvādaśābdānte dvijo vismṛtavānm: tatra yān-dvādaśābdānte dvijo vismṛtavān-manum | tasmai śaśaṁsatus-taṁ tau tadā muktau svar-īyatuḥ ||61||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.svadharmamutsṛjya madena ye dvijān gurūn: svadharmam-utsṛjya madena ye dvijān gurūn-dviṣantaḥ khalu rākṣasā vane|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/14_adh.bhavanti pāpo'pi yadānutāpitaḥ kaniṣṭhaś: bhavanti pāpo'pi yadānutāpitaḥ kaniṣṭha-śikṣo bhavati dvijāviva ||62||

dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.prasādātsadgurorjñānī bhūtvāha patito ha: prasādāt-sad-guror-jñānī bhūtvāha patito harim| brāhmaṇasyāpi me kasmād-adhaḥpāto'bhavaddhare ||2||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.khalaḥ kanyāśvagokretā gṛhagrāmavanāgnid: khalaḥ kanyāśva-go-kretā gṛha-grāma-vanāgni-daḥ| tyakta-śrāddhaḥ parānnāśīḥ kālāptātithi-hāpakaḥ ||5||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.svapuṇyaparapāpāsyo dambhādyaiḥ sattvada: sva-puṇya-para-pāpāsyo dambhādyaiḥ sattva-darśakaḥ| khala-hiṁsra-steyi-saṅgī ghātajño jāraṇādi-kṛt ||8||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.jñānaṁ vinā cikitsāśī karmabhraṣṭo'nyatā: jñānaṁ vinā cikitsāśī karma-bhraṣṭo'nya-tāpa-kṛt| ity-ādyāḥ pretya narakaṁ bhuktvā caṇḍāla-yonigāḥ ||9||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.adatveśaṁ kapilagodugdhapo'tiniṣiddhabhu: adatveśaṁ kapila-go-dugdha-po'tiniṣiddha-bhuk| pratigrahī parājīva-jīvī sandhyā-śāyī kuvāk ||11||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.ityādyā brāhmaṇāste'pi pūrvavatsaṁbhavan: ity-ādyā brāhmaṇās-te'pi pūrvavat-saṁbhavanti hi| jīva-jāti-mitāḥ santi narakā ekaviṁśatiḥ ||12||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.teṣu śreṣṭhā jīvapāpavipākā antakālaye|: teṣu śreṣṭhā jīva-pāpa-vipākā antakālaye| teṣv-antakaḥ kṣipaty-etān-pāpinaḥ pāpa-bhuktaye ||13||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.tyaktvā puṣṭamapīha varṣma kaluṣī yānyāt: tyaktvā puṣṭam-apīha varṣma kaluṣī yānyātanāṅgena tṛṭ- | kṣucchītoṣṇa-supīḍito yama-carair-baddho'yane durgame ||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.mūrchan tarjanatāḍanādibhirasanvai vaita: mūrchan tarjana-tāḍanādibhirasanvai vaitariṇy-ardito | bhuṅkte yāmyam-avāpya-rāṣṭram-avaśas-tāṁ yātanāṁ nārakīm ||14||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.tato yonyantare yāti bhuktaduḥkho'pyaghā: tato yony-antare yāti bhukta-duḥkho'py-aghāṁśataḥ| prāyaśo vāsanā-bhūmno bhūta-preta-piśācatām ||15||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.uṣṭro'rthahṛdvanacaraḥ phalapatrārthahṛd: uṣṭro'rtha-hṛd-vanacaraḥ phala-patrārtha-hṛd-bhavet| madhu daṁśaḥ palaṁ gṛdhro'nnam-ākhuś-cātako jalam ||17||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.gandhān chucchundarī dhānyaṁ śalabho'lir: gandhān chucchundarī dhānyaṁ śalabho'lir-viṣaṁ tathā| kṛmiḥ kīṭaḥ pataṅgaḥ syāt svarṇaṁ hṛtvā tṛṇaṁ paśuḥ ||18||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.kāko nirmantrabhuggṛdhro mitradhrugdāmbh: kāko nirmantra-bhug-gṛdhro mitra-dhrug-dāmbhiko bakaḥ| ity-ādyā bahuśo yonīr-bhuktvā rugṇā bhavanty-atha ||19||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.hṛdrogī parahṛdbhettā gurutyāgī mahāmayī: hṛd-rogī para-hṛd-bhettā guru-tyāgī mahāmayī| kṣayī tu brahmahā kuṣṭhī svarṇa-hṛt-pustakāpahā ||20||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.devārthahṛtpāṇḍurogī rogāḥ sarve'tra pāp: devārtha-hṛt-pāṇḍu-rogī rogāḥ sarve'tra pāpataḥ| para-stry-āliṅganāj-janma śataṁ śvā tad-bhagekṣakaḥ ||23||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.andho bandhvaṅganābhogī gardabho'hiśca d: andho bandhv-aṅganā-bhogī gardabho'hiś-ca durdhiyā| para-stry-āliṅganān-nūnaṁ hṛd-rogī hy-aṣṭadhā ratiḥ ||24||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.iti saṁvādamākarṇya guruṁ prāha trivikra: iti saṁvādam-ākarṇya guruṁ prāha trivikramaḥ| jñānād-vā'jñānato jātaṁ kathaṁ pāpaṁ praṇaśyati ||26||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.paścāttāpena saṁśuddhiḥ prāyaścittādibhi: paścāttāpena saṁśuddhiḥ prāyaścittādibhiḥ punaḥ| sadasyuccārya pāpaṁ svaṁ brahma-daṇḍaṁ nidhāya ca ||27||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.sabhyājñayā kṣaurapūrvaṁ kṛtapāpānusārat: sabhyājñayā kṣaura-pūrvaṁ kṛta-pāpānusārataḥ| kṛcchrābdādi carecchaktyā'śakto go'rghādinā'śaṭhaḥ ||28||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.svalpaṁ tīrthe daśasnānād dviśatāsvāyama: svalpaṁ tīrthe daśa-snānād dviśatāsvāyamairagham| svarṇa-dānāt-praṇaśyeta sad-guror-darśanān-mahat ||29||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.tryahaṁ divā tryahaṁ sāyaṁ tryahamadyāda: tryahaṁ divā tryahaṁ sāyaṁ tryaham-adyād-ayācitam| nādyāt tryahaṁ kāya-kṛcchro'yuta-gāyatrikā-japāt ||30||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.trisuparṇaṁ nāciketamaghamarṣaṇavaiṣṇave: trisuparṇaṁ nāciketam-aghamarṣaṇa-vaiṣṇave| māsa-mātraṁ japet-svalpe ṣaṇmāsaṁ ca mahatyaghe ||37||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.cāndrāyaṇaṁ caredgrāsānekaikaṁ vardhayet: cāndrāyaṇaṁ cared-grāsān-ekaikaṁ vardhayet-site| pakṣe'nyake hrāsayet-taiḥ śuci-gavyāśanena ca ||38||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.gomūtraṁ gomayaṁ kṣīraṁ dadhyājyaṁ sakuś: gomūtraṁ gomayaṁ kṣīraṁ dadhy-ājyaṁ sakuśodakam| militvā mantravaddhutvā pibet-sarvāgha-śāntaye ||39||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.prāyaścittāni cīrṇāni duṣṭaṁ hariparāṅmu: prāyaścittāni cīrṇāni duṣṭaṁ hari-parāṅmukham| nadīva saurabhāṇḍaṁ na niṣpunanti kathañcana ||41||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.iti trivikramaṁ proktvā patitaṁ prāha sa: iti trivikramaṁ proktvā patitaṁ prāha sad-guruḥ| prāṅ-mātāpitṛ-saṁtyāgāl-labdhā caṇḍālatā'tra te ||42||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.māsamātraṁ nadīsnānāt pretya vipro bhavi: māsa-mātraṁ nadī-snānāt pretya vipro bhaviṣyasi| prāhāntyajo yojaya māṁ tvad-dṛk-pūtaṁ dvijātiṣu ||43||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.bhūtvāpi patitādvṛddho dehaste'saṁskṛto': bhūtvāpi patitād-vṛddho dehas-te'saṁskṛto'śuciḥ| vadanti patitaṁ na tvām-anyat-proktaṁ kathaṁ tvayā ||44||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.viśvāmitraḥ purā kṣatro devarṣitvaṁ tapo: viśvāmitraḥ purā kṣatro devarṣitvaṁ tapo-balāt| devān-yayāce proktaṁ tair-vasiṣṭhāt-svīkuruṣva tat ||45||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.vasiṣṭhenāpi hīnatvānna dattaṁ tatsutānc: vasiṣṭhenāpi hīnatvān-na dattaṁ tat-sutānchatam| hatvā taṁ hantu-kāmo'bhūcchaṅkito brahma-hatyayā ||46||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.tadājñayā tapastaptaṁ tattu menakayā hṛt: tad-ājñayā tapas-taptaṁ tattu menakayā hṛtam| viśvāmitraḥ punas-taptvā dagdhāṅgo'bhūd-ṛṣīśvaraḥ ||47||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.tasmādbhavāntare te'stu brahmatvaṁ gacch: tasmād-bhavāntare te'stu brahmatvaṁ gaccha te'stu śam ||48||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.patito'pi kṛpādṛṣṭyā pāvitaḥ snānamātrat: patito'pi kṛpā-dṛṣṭyā pāvitaḥ snāna-mātrataḥ| kathaṁ sa pūrvavaj-jāto bhagavan-chindhi saṁśayam ||52||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.kṣiptaṁ bhasmārpitaṁ jñānaṁ vinaṣṭaṁ kṣā: kṣiptaṁ bhasmārpitaṁ jñānaṁ vinaṣṭaṁ kṣālanāt-tu tat| iyān bhasma-prabhāvaḥ prāg-vāmadevo mahā-muniḥ ||53||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.prāk śrīmatto'smi rāṭ kāmī brāhmaṇādyant: prāk śrīmatto'smi rāṭ kāmī brāhmaṇādy-anta-jāti-jāḥ |bhuktāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ striyo'lpāś-ca sahaikaikām-anantaśaḥ ||55||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.haṭhāddānādinānīya bhuktā madrāṣṭrasaṁst: haṭhād-dānādinānīya bhuktā mad-rāṣṭra-saṁsthitāḥ | narā rāṣṭrāntaraṁ jagmuḥ sastrīkā doṣa-kātarāḥ ||56||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.tato rugṇasya me rājyamākrāntaṁ śatrubhi: tato rugṇasya me rājyam-ākrāntaṁ śatrubhis-tataḥ | kṛcchrātpretya mayā bhuktā pitṛbhiḥ saha durgatiḥ ||57||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.preto vyāghraścājagaraḥ sālāvṛka u sūkar: preto vyāghraś-cājagaraḥ sālāvṛka u sūkaraḥ| śaraṭhaḥ śvā kroṣṭu-mṛgau kukkuṭaḥ kapi-cillakau ||58||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.nakulaḥ kāka ṛkṣaśca kukkuṭaḥ khara otuk: nakulaḥ kāka ṛkṣaś-ca kukkuṭaḥ khara otukaḥ | bhekaḥ kūrmo matsya ākhur-ghūko hastīha rākṣasaḥ ||59||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.etā yonīrmayā bhuktāḥ kṛcchrātkṣuttṛṭpra: etā yonīr-mayā bhuktāḥ kṛcchrāt-kṣut-tṛṭ-prapīḍitaḥ | tvām-attum-āgaman sadyaḥ śānto jāto'smy-adaḥ katham ||60||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.aṅge bhasmāsti tatsparśājjñānaṁ jātaṁ ta: aṅge bhasmāsti tat-sparśāj-jñānaṁ jātaṁ tavāditaḥ | tan-māhātmyam-idaṁ yattu sadā prītyā śivo dadhau ||61||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.asūnjahau tadā prāptānyāmyāndūtānnivārya: asūn-jahau tadā prāptān-yāmyān-dūtān-nivārya tam | bhasma-dagdha-malaṁ śaivā dūtā ninyuḥ śivāntikam ||63||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.evaṁ cedbhasmamāhātmyaṁ tatsvīkartuṁ sam: evaṁ ced-bhasma-māhātmyaṁ tat-svīkartuṁ samutsahe | tan-nirmāṇa-prakāraṁ me śaṁsa dhāryaṁ kathaṁ ca tat ||64||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.prāgbrahmabhyo'rpitā vārtā vāpyādyā nirj: prāg-brahmabhyo'rpitā vārtā vāpyādyā nirjala-sthale| racitās-tat-phalaṁ tvetat-pāpānte tava darśanam ||65||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.darśanātparihṛtyāghaṁ bhuktvā śaṁ vidhiv: darśanāt-parihṛtyāghaṁ bhuktvā śaṁ vidhivad-dhṛteḥ | bhasmanaḥ puruṣo'ddhāya jīvan-mukto bhavaty-alam ||68||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.yajñotthaṁ vā karīṣotthamagnirityādimant: yajñotthaṁ vā karīṣottham-agnir-ityādi-mantritam | dhāryaṁ tryāyuṣam-ity-etair-aṅgulībhiḥ pratisthalam ||69||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.bhaktyājñenāpi taddhāryaṁ tārakaṁ nāpara: bhaktyājñenāpi tad-dhāryaṁ tārakaṁ nāparaṁ hyataḥ | para-strī-go-nindako'san kṣetra-hṛt-para-pīḍakaḥ ||72||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.gṛhadāhī mṛṣāvādī khalo vedarasakrayī |: gṛha-dāhī mṛṣā-vādī khalo veda-rasa-krayī | nīcāc-ca duṣpratigrāhī vṛṣalī-vidhavādi-gaḥ ||73||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.jñānājñānakṛtā'ghopi muktaḥ syādbhasmadh: jñānājñāna-kṛtā'ghopi muktaḥ syād-bhasma-dhāraṇāt | bhasma-tripuṇḍra-rudrākṣaiḥ svaḥ pūjyo nā pum-artha-daiḥ ||74||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.svarādilokaṁ nītvānte śaive sthāpayati d: svarādi-lokaṁ nītvānte śaive sthāpayati dhruvam | sanatkumāra sulabhaṁ tārakaṁ bhasma-dhāraṇam ||76||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.rākṣaso'pi tadādāya bhasmāṅge vidhivadda: rākṣaso'pi tad-ādāya bhasmāṅge vidhivad-dadhau | tadaiva rākṣasīṁ hitvā tanuṁ mukto'bhavat-kṣaṇāt ||78||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.tadaivāsaṁ vimānaṁ sa tenāgāttatkṣaṇādiv: tadaivāsaṁ vimānaṁ sa tenāgāt-tatkṣaṇādivam | tasmān-mune bhasma-śaktiṁ jñātvāṅge dhehi mucyase ||79||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.evaṁ gurūktaṁ hyabhigṛhya hṛṣṭo bhaktyop: evaṁ gurūktaṁ hy-abhigṛhya hṛṣṭo bhaktyopasaṁgṛhya tam-ājñayāgāt |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.trivikramo'nye'pi hi tatpramāṇaṁ matvott: trivikramo'nye'pi hi tat-pramāṇaṁ matvottamaṁ cerur-atho tathaiva ||80||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/15_adh.evaṁ kriyāvipāko'yamīdṛkśrutibhayaṅkarā: evaṁ kriyā-vipāko'yam-īdṛk-śruti-bhayaṅkarā | daṇḍa-dhṛg-yātanā tasmācchreya eva sadācaret ||81||

dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.namaste brūhi caritaṁ hareradbhutakarmaṇ: namaste brūhi caritaṁ harer-adbhuta-karmaṇaḥ | śṛṇvato'pi na me tṛptir-amṛtaṁ pibato yathā ||1||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.satpṛṣṭaṁ vatsa dhanyo'si bhavābdhirlīla: sat-pṛṣṭaṁ vatsa dhanyo'si bhavābdhir-līlayā jitaḥ | cittaṁ te caritair-viddhaṁ hares-tenāsmi toṣitaḥ ||2||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.ko brūyādbhagavallīlāṁ kati citrāṇi vacm: ko brūyād-bhagaval-līlāṁ kati citrāṇi vacmi te | mūko brūte prekṣate'ndho mṛto jīvati yad-dṛśā ||3||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.śṛṇveko māhure vipro gopīnātho dhanī mṛt: śṛṇveko māhure vipro gopīnātho dhanī mṛtāḥ | tat-putrā bahavo'thaiko jīvito datta-sevayā ||4||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.sarūpau surūpau svayormanyamānau viyogaṁ: sarūpau surūpau svayor-manyamānau viyogaṁ kuyogaṁ kṣaṇaṁ dharma-dakṣau|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.ubhau tau smarantau sadā'nyo'nyabhadraṁ: ubhau tau smarantau sadā'nyo'nyabhadraṁ na tandrā na nidrā pati-premṇi sādhvyāḥ ||7||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.lepo'tyuṣṇa ivānilo'nalasamaḥ śītāṁśuruṣ: lepo'tyuṣṇa ivānilo'nala-samaḥ śītāṁśur-uṣṇāṁśuvacchayyā vṛścikavat-sumasrag-ahivad-bhūṣāḥ samāḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.vāṅmādhuryamapi pradīpanasadṛksvādvannam: vāṅ-mādhuryam-api pradīpana-sadṛk-svādvannam-apy-utkaṭu preṣṭhe tv-antarite kṣaṇaṁ dṛḍhatarāṁ sādhvyā abhūt-sarvadā ||8||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.bhuṅkte yathānnaṁ sa satī tathānnaṁ śete: bhuṅkte yathānnaṁ sa satī tathānnaṁ śete'pi yāvat-sa satī tu tāvat|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.kṛśo'pi yadvatsa satī tu tadvat chāyāpar: kṛśo'pi yadvat-sa satī tu tadvat chāyā-parevāsya pativratā'bhūt ||10||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.vaidyo'ntike tasya kugandhaśaṅkayā na yā: vaidyo'ntike tasya kugandha-śaṅkayā na yāti sādhvī sumanā na taṁ jahau|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.dvijaṁ rujārtaṁ ca tathāvidhāṁ vadhūṁ ta: dvijaṁ rujārtaṁ ca tathāvidhāṁ vadhūṁ tayor-na śekuḥ pitarau nirīkṣitum|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.nivāritā tairapi sā pativratā na taṁ jah: nivāritā tair-api sā pativratā na taṁ jahāv-aryamaṇaṁ prabhā yathā ||13||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.prāgvairataḥ kaṣṭamidaṁ mayārpitaṁ dhṛty: prāg-vairataḥ kaṣṭam-idaṁ mayārpitaṁ dhṛtyā pitaḥ sāttvikayāmba jīvitum|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.sādhvarhathaste sati pūrvavairyahaṁ tanm: sādhv-arhathas-te sati pūrva-vairyahaṁ tanmāṁ vihāyāśu pitur-gṛhaṁ vraja ||14||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.jīvo'sya sādhuvapuṣo'sti bhavānviyukte j: jīvo'sya sādhu-vapuṣo'sti bhavān-viyukte jīve tanor-nanu bhavet-khalu jīva-hatyā ||15||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.sadā madāsyaṁ śaśiśāli kālimā kuto yato: sadā madāsyaṁ śaśi-śāli kālimā kuto yato bhaidhata evam-eva te|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.akī sukhī yatra bhavatyavatyaghāt tamīśa: akī sukhī yatra bhavaty-avaty-aghāt tam-īśam-īḍe sa tu deva-devataḥ ||16||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.namo namo vāṁ śvaśurau mayā śruto guruḥ: namo namo vāṁ śvaśurau mayā śruto guruḥ sa gandharva-pure'sti tārakaḥ|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.asupriyo'nāmayameti bhāti me sahāmunā yā: asupriyo'nāmayam-eti bhāti me sahāmunā yāsya u rocate'pi vām ||17||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.tāvūcatuḥ kvāpi tava śrameṇa samrājñi jī: tāv-ūcatuḥ kvāpi tava śrameṇa samrājñi jīveta sa tatra gaccha|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.krānte'yanetho katicicchanaiḥ śanairmṛty: krānte'yanetho katicicchanaiḥ śanair-mṛtyuṁ dhavo'gāt-sa tadaiva daivataḥ|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.kālātyayaṁ mā kuru kurvathāhnikamuttiṣṭh: kālātyayaṁ mā kuru kurvathāhnikam-uttiṣṭha śeṣe kati nātha vipra-rāṭ|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.kasmānna me dāsyasi vallabhottaraṁ preṣṭ: kasmān-na me dāsyasi vallabhottaraṁ preṣṭhaṁ nu kiṁ te vacanaṁ vyalaṅghyam ||21||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.prāṇāḥ kva yātāśca manaḥ kva te gataṁ dr: prāṇāḥ kva yātāś-ca manaḥ kva te gataṁ drāk-tān-parāvartaya jīvituṁ ciram|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.liptaḥ svamātāpitṛdārahatyayā bhaviṣyasi: liptaḥ sva-mātāpitṛ-dāra-hatyayā bhaviṣyasi tvaṁ na tathā karoṣi cet ||22||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.udvāhitāṁ kvaiṣi vihāya māṁ priyāṁ putrā: udvāhitāṁ kvaiṣi vihāya māṁ priyāṁ putrān-anutpādya kathanvṛṇoddhṛtiḥ|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.sthātavyamīśa kva kathaṁ na bhāṣitaṁ kat: sthātavyam-īśa kva kathaṁ na bhāṣitaṁ kathaṁ vrajeyaṁ sadanaṁ guroś-ca vaḥ ||23||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.kiṁ te śilāḍhye śayanaṁ kupṛṣṭhe suptaḥ: kiṁ te śilāḍhye śayanaṁ kupṛṣṭhe suptaḥ pṛthaṅ-nartum-ṛte'dya kiṁ tat ||25||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.nakro'psu yadvattṛṣitaṁ yathā druḥ śrānt: nakro'psu yadvat-tṛṣitaṁ yathā druḥ śrāntaṁ yathā gāṁ tṛṇa-gāṁ ca hiṁsraḥ|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.prāsāda īśekṣakamunnihanti jātaṁ tathā m: prāsāda īśekṣakam-unnihanti jātaṁ tathā me guru-darśanāpteḥ ||26||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.rukśāntiśaktiryadi te na gamyatāmiti tva: ruk-śānti-śaktir-yadi te na gamyatām-iti tvayokte katamo'rdituṁ kṣamaḥ ||27||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.tvayā kṛtaṁ sādhu yaśo divaṁ te vahāmi b: tvayā kṛtaṁ sādhu yaśo divaṁ te vahāmi bhartrā saha gauri-mātaḥ|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.māṅgalyatantuṁ ca niśāṁ ca kuṅkumaṁ hart: māṅgalya-tantuṁ ca niśāṁ ca kuṅkumaṁ hartuṁ mahāṁś-cora ihāgataḥ kutaḥ|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.saubhāgyanaurme bhavasindhusaṁsthitā sā: saubhāgya-naur-me bhava-sindhu-saṁsthitā sā kāla-mīnena kathaṁ nu carvitā ||29||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.pratyaṅgamālambya ruroda mohataḥ sādhvī: pratyaṅgam-ālambya ruroda mohataḥ sādhvī tadā kaścana sādhur-āyayau ||30||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.rudrākṣabhūṣo bhasitāktadehaḥ śūlī babhā: rudrākṣa-bhūṣo bhasitākta-dehaḥ śūlī babhāṣe jaṭilaḥ sa sādhvīm|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.bāle śucā naiti mṛtaḥ kutastvaṁ mudhocca: bāle śucā naiti mṛtaḥ kutas-tvaṁ mudhoccakai rodiṣi tiṣṭha tūṣṇīm ||31||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.mṛtyurna keṣāṁ viṣayo'pi devāngrasatyasa: mṛtyur-na keṣāṁ viṣayo'pi devān-grasaty-asau cāparihārya eva|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.dvau vyaikyamabdhau ca yathendhanaikyaṁ: dvau vyaikyam-abdhau ca yathendhanaikyaṁ bhava-pravāhe'pi tathā dhavādiḥ ||32||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.sambandha eṣāṁ niyato mataścet prāgjanma: sambandha eṣāṁ niyato mataś-cet prāg-janmani tvaṁ vada kasya kā vā|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.bhavodbhavaḥ karmata eva karma bhavodbha: bhavodbhavaḥ karmata eva karma bhavodbhavaṁ tūbhayam-ajña-bhāvāt|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.dhīreṇa yenobhayameva kṛttaṁ tattvāsinā: dhīreṇa yenobhayam-eva kṛttaṁ tattvāsinā tasya na vai bhramo'yam ||36||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.tatkāla eṣaiva yadā pramādato yātā nṛyon: tatkāla eṣaiva yadā pramādato yātā nṛ-yonis-tu punar-na tat-kathā ||39||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.vindhyotkarṣabhiyaitya tadgurumagastyaṁ: vindhyotkarṣa-bhiyaitya tad-gurum-agastyaṁ tad-vadhūṁ nirjaraiḥ | sākaṁ deva-gurur-jagau sati ramā sāvitry-umārundhatī ||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.ityādyā api sādhvya uttamatamā tāsāṁ tva: ity-ādyā api sādhvya uttamatamā tāsāṁ tvam-evāsy-aho | chāyevāniśam-īśa-sevana-parā tvan-nighnam-etaj-jagat ||42||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.bhaktyā chāyeva yāśrāntaṁ svabhartṛparic: bhaktyā chāyeva yāśrāntaṁ sva-bhartṛ-paricāriṇī | patir-eva vrataṁ yasyā akhaṇḍaṁ sā pativratā ||43||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.pādāmbu tīrthamucchiṣṭaṁ prasādo devatār: pādāmbu tīrtham-ucchiṣṭaṁ prasādo devatārcanam | tat-sevā bhūṣaṇaṁ toṣo dharmo'nujñānupālanam ||44||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.kāryaṁ nājñāṁ vinā kiñcid dūrātstheyaṁ s: kāryaṁ nājñāṁ vinā kiñcid dūrāt-stheyaṁ sthite priye | suptotthitāt-prāg-utthāya sevyo'śrāntaṁ patir-mudā ||46||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.tasmai datveṣṭamāplutya gṛhasaṁmārjinādi: tasmai datveṣṭam-āplutya gṛha-saṁmārjinādikam | datveśāyeṣṭa-saṁbhārā deyāḥ svādu ca bhojanam ||47||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.kruddhaścetprārthanīyo na gantavyaṁ para: kruddhaś-cet-prārthanīyo na gantavyaṁ para-sadmani | nājñāṁ vinā guror-gehe na vaktavyaṁ sadetaraiḥ ||48||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.mandaṁ śvaśrvādisāmīpye vaktavyaṁ sandha: mandaṁ śvaśrvādi-sāmīpye vaktavyaṁ sandhayeśituḥ | iṣṭaṁ dehīti no vācyaṁ vaktavyaṁ para-vaktrataḥ ||49||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.svīkāryaṁ vastrabhūṣādi bhartrā dattaṁ y: svīkāryaṁ vastra-bhūṣādi bhartrā dattaṁ yadṛcchayā | na nindyo durbhago dīno duḥśīlo'pi śivopamaḥ ||50||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.na kāryaṁ svairiṇīsakhyaṁ svānāṁ pārthak: na kāryaṁ svairiṇī-sakhyaṁ svānāṁ pārthakyam-apy-uta | dhāryāḥ saubhāgyopacārā na bhūṣāḥ proṣite priye ||51||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.supte'smincchayanaṁ kāryaṁ noccāryaṁ pat: supte'smincchayanaṁ kāryaṁ noccāryaṁ pati-nāma ca | bhoktuṁ nānyatra gantavyaṁ yācñā kāryā na kutracit ||54||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.vaiṣamye'pi sukhaṁ kalpyaṁ kalpyeśe duḥk: vaiṣamye'pi sukhaṁ kalpyaṁ kalpyeśe duḥkhite na mut | tyājyam-uccāsanaṁ līlā dhavādy-agre hasas-tathā ||55||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.prativādācchunī bharturulūkī guruvarjanā: prativādācchunī bhartur-ulūkī guru-varjanāt | patiṁ vinā svādu-bhuktyā varāholūka-yonigā ||56||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.mūkā roṣoktyā vyāghrī syāt kṛtatāḍanabhā: mūkā roṣoktyā vyāghrī syāt kṛta-tāḍana-bhāṣiṇī | sapatnī-vairataḥ strī syād durbhagā jāragā kṛmiḥ ||57||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.patyau mṛte'nugantavyaṁ stheyaṁ vā vidha: patyau mṛte'nugantavyaṁ stheyaṁ vā vidhavāvṛṣe | śavābhāve garbhiṇītve'lpe'rbhe vaidhavya-pālanam ||58||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.śiraso vapanaṁ kāryaṁ bhuvi śayyā sakṛdb: śiraso vapanaṁ kāryaṁ bhuvi śayyā sakṛd-bhujiḥ | varjyās-tāmbūla-gandhādi subhogā maṁgalāplutiḥ ||59||
