dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.tyājyāḥ saubhāgyopacārā dhāryaṁ gaurāṁśu: tyājyāḥ saubhāgyopacārā dhāryaṁ gaurāṁśukaṁ sadā | rādha-māghorjeṣu kāryaṁ snāna-dāna-vratādikam ||60||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.śaktau cāndrāyaṇaṁ kāryaṁ bhojyaṁ vājyap: śaktau cāndrāyaṇaṁ kāryaṁ bhojyaṁ vājya-phalādikam | yat-priyaṁ sati patyau tad-deyaṁ viprāya bhaktitaḥ ||61||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.māsavrataṁ ca kalpoktaṁ kāryaṁ yadyattu: māsa-vrataṁ ca kalpoktaṁ kāryaṁ yad-yat-tu varjitam | deyaṁ viprāya coṣṇāmbu toṣaṇīyas-tu tairthikaḥ ||62||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.putre tadājñayā stheyaṁ sampūjyaḥ pativa: putre tad-ājñayā stheyaṁ sampūjyaḥ pativaddhariḥ | guru-go'tithi-saddviprāḥ pūjyās-tyājyaṁ kubhojanam ||63||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.harilīlāratiḥ kāryā'putrayā pitṛtarpaṇam: hari-līlā-ratiḥ kāryā'putrayā pitṛ-tarpaṇam | gopyaṁ śīlaṁ svakaiḥ sārdhaṁ tad-vaiguṇyād-adho-gatiḥ ||64||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.etaddharmāśrayātsādhvī durgatisthamapi p: etad-dharmāśrayāt-sādhvī durgatistham-api priyam | prasahyoddhṛtya cillīva sarpaṁ svar-viśati dhruvam ||65||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.lopāmudre tvattato'sau satīdharmo'tra tā: lopāmudre tvattato'sau satī-dharmo'tra tārakaḥ | evaṁ jīvokta-dharmas-te mayoktaḥ svecchayācara ||66||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.bhevārkaṁ patimanvehi rocate'nugamo yadi: bhevārkaṁ patim-anvehi rocate'nugamo yadi | svar-yāti gauravādyena proddhṛtyeśaṁ yamād-api ||67||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.rūpalāvaṇyasaṁpannāḥ striyaḥ santi gṛhe: rūpa-lāvaṇya-saṁpannāḥ striyaḥ santi gṛhe gṛhe | tābhiḥ kiṁ kāryam-ekaiva sādhvī trikula-pāvanī ||69||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.kṣamāvāto'rko'gnirbibheti svatrāso'syā b: kṣamāvāto'rko'gnirbibheti sva-trāso'syā bhaved-iti | tiṣṭhanti praṇatā devāḥ sva-pada-cyuti-śaṅkayā ||70||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.sādhvyā iyānprabhāvo'sti dhanyaiṣā pitṛt: sādhvyā iyān-prabhāvo'sti dhanyaiṣā pitṛ-tārakā | dhig-duḥśīlām-adhaḥ-śete yā ciraṁ trikulaiḥ samam ||71||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.vaidhavyapālanaṁ kaṣṭaṁ tāruṇyādyatra gh: vaidhavya-pālanaṁ kaṣṭaṁ tāruṇyād-yatra ghātakam | prītir-dhavānugamane nūnaṁ me vardhate guro ||72||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.kālo'jayyo'maraiścāpi durdharaḥ sadguruṁ: kālo'jayyo'maraiś-cāpi durdharaḥ sad-guruṁ vinā | guru-darśana-kāmāptā dūrāt tat tvaṁ samācara ||74||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.snātvā pītāmbaraṁ dhṛtvā prāyaścittapura: snātvā pītāmbaraṁ dhṛtvā prāyaścitta-puraḥsaram | saubhāgya-vāyanāny-aṅga sapatnīka-dvijebhya it ||75||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.datvā śrutyorgale cemān badhvākṣānbhasma: datvā śrutyor-gale cemān badhvākṣān-bhasma mastake | liptvāṅgaṁ guru-pādādbhiḥ prokṣyeśam-anuyāhy-ayi ||76||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.prāhānugānyāta gṛhamumeśau pitarau mama: prāhānugānyāta gṛham-umeśau pitarau mama | yāsye tatrātra harṣāt-svar-iti vācyaṁ gurūn-prati ||78||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.ityuktvā nīyamānasya patyuragnikarāgrata: ity-uktvā nīyamānasya patyur-agni-karāgrataḥ | gacchantī mantharomeva reje mudrūpiṇī satī ||79||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.bhartṛsaukhyānabhijñeyaṁ ṣoḍaśābdātisuṁd: bhartṛ-saukhyānabhijñeyaṁ ṣoḍaśābdātisuṁdarī | kuloddhartrī sudhanyeti stūyamānā janair-yayau ||80||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.śmaśānametya saṁskṛtya kuṇḍe'gniṁ vāyanā: śmaśānam-etya saṁskṛtya kuṇḍe'gniṁ vāyanādibhiḥ | suvāsinīs-toṣayitvā sasmāra guru-bhāṣitam ||81||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.liptvāṅge bhasma badhvākṣān patyurviprāj: liptvāṅge bhasma badhvākṣān patyur-viprājñayā gurum | draṣṭu-kāmā yayau sādhvī saṁgamaṁ taṁ stuvanty-ajam ||82||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.dātā sarveśvarastvaṁ śaraṇamapi satāṁ tr: dātā sarveśvaras-tvaṁ śaraṇam-api satāṁ tryātmako viśva-sarga-sthity-antānāṁ nidānaṁ tata-biruda-cayaḥ śrī-haris-tvaṁ dayābdhiḥ |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.mṛto jīvito rugṇa ārogyamāpto gataḥ śarm: mṛto jīvito rugṇa ārogyam-āpto gataḥ śarma bhīto'pi dīno'rtha-yuktaḥ|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.gataḥ prājñatāmajña īśa prabhāvāttavāhaṁ: gataḥ prājñatām-ajña īśa prabhāvāt-tavāhaṁ dhavāḍhyādya sāyujyam-eṣye ||84||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.uddhartukāmāpi samaṁ dhavena javena sāga: uddhartu-kāmāpi samaṁ dhavena javena sāgatya hariṁ nanāma ||85||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.āyāntīṁ praṇatāṁ devastvaṁ saubhāgyavatī: āyāntīṁ praṇatāṁ devas-tvaṁ saubhāgyavatī bhava | aṣṭa-putrā punaś-ceti bhagavān-prīta āha tām ||86||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.tacchrutvā cakitā lokāḥ śaśaṁsuḥ sarvamā: tacchrutvā cakitā lokāḥ śaśaṁsuḥ sarvam-āditaḥ | prabhuḥ prāha na me vākyaṁ moghaṁ śavam-ihānaya ||87||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.atrāntare dvijā etya raudryānarcurguruṁ: atrāntare dvijā etya raudryānarcurguruṁ tadā | ānītaṁ śavam-udvīkṣya sudhā-dṛṣṭyā sva-saṁnidhau ||88||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.tadā harṣāśrupūrṇākṣī lajjitaṁ vismitaṁ: tadā harṣāśru-pūrṇākṣī lajjitaṁ vismitaṁ patim | premṇā śaśaṁsa tat-sarvam-ūcatuḥ prāñjalī ubhau ||90||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.āvāṁ svo durdhiyau pāpau bhavatsmṛtiparā: āvāṁ svo durdhiyau pāpau bhavat-smṛti-parāṅmukhau | tathāpi tvaṁ dayā-sindho saccidānanda haṁsi no ||91||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.jagadguro viśvamūrte paramātmantrāhi viś: jagad-guro viśva-mūrte paramātman-trāhi viśva-pa | viśva-sākṣin-viśva-saṁstha sarvānanda-nidhe hare ||92||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.kartā'kartā'nyathākartā tvamevāsi pumart: kartā'kartā'nyathā-kartā tvam-evāsi pum-artha-daḥ | āvābhyām-aparāddhaṁ tat kṣāmaye tvādya kārtsnyataḥ ||93||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.evaṁ tau bahuśo natvā praṇatīścakraturmu: evaṁ tau bahuśo natvā praṇatīś-cakratur-mudā | tac-citraṁ prekṣya loko'pi tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ||94||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.tatraiko dhūrta āheśaṁ ke'sti brahmalipi: tatraiko dhūrta āheśaṁ ke'sti brahma-lipir-na vā | nālpo mṛtyur-mahān-eṣa sāsti cej-jīvitaḥ kutaḥ ||95||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.dhātrātra likhitaṁ triṁśadāyureṣyabhave: dhātrātra likhitaṁ triṁśadāyureṣyabhave śatam | yācñayaiṣyaṁ śataṁ tvatra gṛhītvā vyastam-ācaram ||96||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.dampatī prāha bhagavānāyuṣmantau nirāmay: dampatī prāha bhagavān-āyuṣmantau nirāmayau | suputra-dhana-kīrtyāḍhyau loka-vandyau bhaviṣyataḥ ||98||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.śrutvā gurorgāṁ pramudānvitāvubhau snātv: śrutvā guror-gāṁ pramudānvitāv-ubhau snātvā guroś-cakratur-arcanaṁ tadā|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/16_adh.astaṁ gato'rko'pyaja āhnikīṁ kriyāṁ kṛtv: astaṁ gato'rko'pyaja āhnikīṁ kriyāṁ kṛtvā maṭhaṁ sarva-janaiḥ sahāyayau ||99||

dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.na svairiṇīyaṁ sādhvyeva liṅgaṁ tatra pr: na svairiṇīyaṁ sādhvy-eva liṅgaṁ tatra pramā khalu |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.ahaṁ tryahaṁ satītvena bhaje tvāṁ sarvab: ahaṁ tryahaṁ satītvena bhaje tvāṁ sarva-bhāvataḥ ||14||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.tacchrutvā bhāvi me sūnormune śaṁseti pṛ: tacchrutvā bhāvi me sūnor-mune śaṁseti pṛcchate |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.sraṣṭrā sṛṣṭau jagadvṛddhyai dharmādharm: sraṣṭrā sṛṣṭau jagad-vṛddhyai dharmādharmau tayoḥ patī |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.viprā yatra paṭhantyetaṁ kāmādyāḥ sakalā: viprā yatra paṭhanty-etaṁ kāmādyāḥ sakalā na tam |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.matto'bhaktirjapati cetsa pāpī śādhi taṁ: matto'bhaktir-japati cetsa pāpī śādhi taṁ bhṛśam ||30||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.śivadūtaiḥ sadūtaḥ sa parābhūto yamaṁ ya: śiva-dūtaiḥ sadūtaḥ sa parābhūto yamaṁ yayau ||38||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.niyataṁ kartumudyukte mayi yūyaṁ kva vig: niyataṁ kartum-udyukte mayi yūyaṁ kva vighna-dāḥ ||39||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.dṛṣṭaṁ mayedaṁ te putrastrātaḥ śāktyena: dṛṣṭaṁ mayedaṁ te putras-trātaḥ śāktyena bhūpate ||41||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.sa prāha tanmanau vyājādbhraṁśite vo jay: sa prāha tan-manau vyājād-bhraṁśite vo jayo dhruvaḥ |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.ityuktvā sa kacaṁ prāha svasutaṁ gaccha: ity-uktvā sa kacaṁ prāha sva-sutaṁ gaccha re kavim |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.taṁ jaghnurdevayānyāha śukraṁ nāpnaḥ kut: taṁ jaghnur-devayāny-āha śukraṁ nāpnaḥ kutaḥ priyaḥ ||53||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.daduḥ śukrāya pramādāt sa papau daityava: daduḥ śukrāya pramādāt sa papau daitya-vatsalaḥ ||57||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.daityaiḥ kṣiptaḥ sa matkukṣau tadānayana: daityaiḥ kṣiptaḥ sa mat-kukṣau tad-ānayanato hi me |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.mṛtyurbhavenna ko veda divyaṁ mantraṁ hi: mṛtyur-bhaven-na ko veda divyaṁ mantraṁ hi māṁ vinā ||59||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.kanyoce tāta me mantramupādiśa ca jīvaya: kanyoce tāta me mantram-upādiśa ca jīvaya |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.ghnanti māṁ tadgṛhaṁ yāsye madarthe bhav: ghnanti māṁ tad-gṛhaṁ yāsye mad-arthe bhavato'pyakam ||63||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.sā vidyāṁ vismaretyenaṁ śaśāpāpi sa tāṁ: sā vidyāṁ vismarety-enaṁ śaśāpāpi sa tāṁ nṛpaḥ |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.upoṣya naktaṁ bhuktvā vā bhaktyāsminna k: upoṣya naktaṁ bhuktvā vā bhaktyāsmin-na kṣaṇaṁ svapet |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.putrābhāvātsa taṁ rājā mene saṁsthāpya p: putrābhāvāt-sa taṁ rājā mene saṁsthāpya putravat ||80||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.pitarau śvaśurau gatvā tadūcustata etya: pitarau śvaśurau gatvā tad-ūcus-tata etya te ||81||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.anveṣyāpi na taṁ prāpuḥ śokaṁ cakrustadā: anveṣyāpi na taṁ prāpuḥ śokaṁ cakrus-tadākhilāḥ |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.vāsukiḥ prāha taṁ kastvaṁ kasya bhakto's: vāsukiḥ prāha taṁ kas-tvaṁ kasya bhakto'si me vada ||86||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.kālindyāṁ patitastvatra kenānīto na vedm: kālindyāṁ patitas-tv-atra kenānīto na vedmi tat |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.daivādvo darśanaṁ jātaṁ saphalaṁ janma k: daivād-vo darśanaṁ jātaṁ saphalaṁ janma karma me ||88||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.dattvā'hyaśvau manovegau gamayāmāsa tau: dattvā'hy-aśvau mano-vegau gamayāmāsa tau sa tu ||92||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/17_adh.ko'yaṁ dhūrto'si yakṣo vā bhāti vā svapn: ko'yaṁ dhūrto'si yakṣo vā bhāti vā svapna-hṛd-bhramaḥ ||97||

dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.nidritaṁ mohatamyāṁ me mano'haṅkāraghūrṇ: nidritaṁ mohatamyāṁ me mano'haṅkāra-ghūrṇitam | bodhārkodaya-buddhaṁ tat pātum-aicchat-kathāmṛtam ||1||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.vatsa viṣṇau prabuddho'si yattṛptiḥ śṛṇv: vatsa viṣṇau prabuddho'si yat-tṛptiḥ śṛṇvato'pi no | manye tvayi prasādo'sti śrīmad-bhagavato hareḥ ||2||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.śṛṇveko brāhmaṇastatra tyaktānyānnaprati: śṛṇveko brāhmaṇas-tatra tyaktānyānna-pratigrahaḥ | daivāptabhugṛtī śānto'saktaḥ karma-paro gṛhī ||3||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.tatstrīḥ kṛtyeva sastrīkāḥ svādu bhuktvā: tat-strīḥ kṛtyeva sastrīkāḥ svādu bhuktvānya-sadmani| labhante svaṁśukārthāṁstad dṛṣṭvā patim-agarhayat ||4||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.bhoktuṁ bhartrā sahāhūtā dhaninaikena sa: bhoktuṁ bhartrā sahāhūtā dhaninaikena saikadā | patyā'kruṭkāmalobhena niṣiddhaityāvadad-gurum ||5||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.tacchrutvāhūya taṁ gaccha bhoktuṁ vadhve: tacchrutvāhūya taṁ gaccha bhoktuṁ vadhvetyajo'bravīt | sa prāha niyamaṁ hitvā tathā kurve tvad-ājñayā ||7||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.ityuktvāgāttayā bhoktuṁ śvakroḍocchiṣṭap: ity-uktvāgāt-tayā bhoktuṁ śva-kroḍocchiṣṭa-pākataḥ | bhuñjantī dadate'nnaṁ sā dṛṣṭvā patye śaśaṁsa tat ||8||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.utthāyobhau tataḥ khinnau guruṁ prāpya t: utthāyobhau tataḥ khinnau guruṁ prāpya tad-ūcatuḥ | sa prāhāṅgādya labdhaṁ te strīḥ parānna-sukhaṁ param ||9||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.soce'dya cchalito bhartā kṣantavyo mantu: soce'dya cchalito bhartā kṣantavyo mantur-adya me | tāmāha śrī-gurur-itaḥ patyanujñānugā bhava ||10||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.niṣṭhā'nyathā kṛtā me'dya duṣṭayāghaṁ ka: niṣṭhā'nyathā kṛtā me'dya duṣṭayāghaṁ kathaṁ vrajet | janma-prabhṛty-adya yāvan nedṛkpāpaṁ mayā kṛtam ||11||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.mā bhīstvayyeṣa doṣo na duścittaṁ na kul: mā bhīs-tvayy-eṣa doṣo na duścittaṁ na kula-striyaḥ | kāryaṁ sātaḥ paraṁ necchet tathāttuṁ kvāpi naihyataḥ ||12||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.kadācidyasya kasyāpi karmābhāva upasthit: kadācid-yasya kasyāpi karmābhāva upasthite | dvijābhāvāt-tu bhoktavyaṁ tatra doṣo'nyathā bhavet ||13||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.parānnaṁ kasya bhoktavyaṁ kasmingehe na: parānnaṁ kasya bhoktavyaṁ kasmingehe na kutra vā | kasmād-dānaṁ gṛhītavyaṁ niṣiddhaṁ cāpi śaṁsa me ||14||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.hūtyāṅghrijasya ca tathā khalu māsapuṇya: hūtyāṅghrijasya ca tathā khalu māsa-puṇyaṁ darśe parānna-grahaṇād-apayāti bhoktuḥ ||16||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.grāhyaṁ ca dānamapi sajjanato grahe sat: grāhyaṁ ca dānam-api sajjanato grahe sat kṣetrādike na na kuhāpy-atinindya-dānam ||17||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.uttamaṁ yajñaśiṣṭānnaṁ dīkṣitabrahmiṇora: uttamaṁ yajña-śiṣṭānnaṁ dīkṣita-brahmiṇor-api | svārthaṁ paktaṁ kvāpi nādyādyādyajñārpitaṁ śubham ||18||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.tasmād dvijācāramamuṁ nirāśīs tvaṁ kartu: tasmād dvijācāram-amuṁ nirāśīs tvaṁ kartum-arhasy-ubhayārthadaṁ vai ||20||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.devadeva jagannātha dayābdhe bhagavanpra: deva-deva jagannātha dayābdhe bhagavan-prabho | sad-guro sarvam-ācāraṁ vaktum-arhasi me hare ||21||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.vistṛto'bdhivadācāro munīnāmapi durgraha: vistṛto'bdhivad-ācāro munīnām-api durgrahaḥ | tasmāt-sāraṁ sad-gatidaṁ vakṣye śāktyādi-saṁmatam ||22||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.sattā daivīsampadetal lakṣaṇo dharma ucy: sattā daivī-sampad-etal lakṣaṇo dharma ucyate | śraiṣṭhyaṁ karmāpyate tasmāt-tato jñānaṁ tato'mṛtam ||25||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.śrutismṛtipurāṇāni dharmamūlaṁ śrutirvar: śruti-smṛti-purāṇāni dharma-mūlaṁ śrutir-varā | tadvaire dvau vṛṣau śrutyor-dvaidhe smṛtyostu laukikaḥ ||26||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.varṇāśramavibhāgokto deśakālocito vṛṣaḥ: varṇāśrama-vibhāgokto deśa-kālocito vṛṣaḥ | laukiko'pi catur-varṇaiḥ sevanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ ||27||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.svanuṣṭhitādanyadharmād viguṇopi svako v: svanuṣṭhitād-anya-dharmād viguṇopi svako varaḥ | sva-gṛhyokto'viruddho'pi smārto grāhyo dvijātibhiḥ ||28||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.nityaṁ naimittikaṁ karma nātīyātkāmyamai: nityaṁ naimittikaṁ karma nātīyāt-kāmyam-aicchikam | tat-tyāgī kvāpi na sukhī brahmībhūtam-ṛte bhavet ||29||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.bhajetsalakṣaṇaṁ dharmaṁ śraddhābhaktiyu: bhajet-salakṣaṇaṁ dharmaṁ śraddhā-bhakti-yuto naraḥ | brāhmaṇas-tu viśeṣeṇa yato'smai śraiṣṭhyam-arpitam ||31||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.vaidikāṁ tāntrikāṁ miśrāmādyāṁ vaikāṁ ca: vaidikāṁ tāntrikāṁ miśrām-ādyāṁ vaikāṁ caret-kriyām | vimalaḥ sumukha-snāto dvir-ācānto gurūktimān ||33||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.pīṭhastho'ntarjānukaraḥ prakuryātkarma s: pīṭha-stho'ntarjānu-karaḥ prakuryāt-karma sat-sthale | upoṣito vinā naiśaṁ kuryād-yajña-japārcanam ||35||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.doṣo nauṣadhagavyekṣvap phalatāmbūlabhak: doṣo nauṣadhagavyekṣvap phala-tāmbūla-bhakṣaṇe | karma saṁkalpya kāryaṁ sampūrṇatāsyeśvarārpaṇāt ||36||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.dyunaktaṁ prāgudagvaktro homāde'gnyādisa: dyunaktaṁ prāg-udag-vaktro homāde'gnyādi-saṁmukhaḥ | saumyaindracaiśānyanuktāyāṁ dakṣāṅgaṁ copavītatā ||37||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.āsīnatvaṁ madhyapāṭho devatīrthamanuktak: āsīnatvaṁ madhya-pāṭho deva-tīrtham-anuktake | nivītaṁ kaṇṭha-lambyārṣaṁ dakṣāṁsa-sthaṁ tu pitryakam ||38||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.prācīnāvītamanyāṁsasthaṁ sūtraṁ tūpavīta: prācīnāvītam-anyāṁsa-sthaṁ sūtraṁ tūpavītakam | bhraṣṭaṁ vā truṭitaṁ sūtraṁ tyaktvā daddhyānnavaṁ vidheḥ ||39||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.trighnīkṛtya tripadyā ṣaṇṇavatisvakaronm: trighnīkṛtya tripadyā ṣaṇṇavati-svakaronmitam | tūlādi-sūtraṁ punas-trir-āvṛtya nava-sūtrakam ||40||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.kṛtvā trirāvṛtaṁ granthiṁ datvā kājaśivā: kṛtvā trir-āvṛtaṁ granthiṁ datvā kājaśivānnaraman | prokṣyāb-liṅgaiḥ paṅkti-vāraṁ sāvitryā dhehi mantravat ||41||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.mantrā gaustulasī nīce'santaḥ san śodhit: mantrā gaus-tulasī nīce'santaḥ san śodhito dvijaḥ| soṅkārān sarvadā home svāhāntān-vāma-hasta-hṛt||43||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.dūrvāmauñjastṛṇaṁ darbhā varṣāmāsvīkṛtāḥ: dūrvāmauñjastṛṇaṁ darbhā varṣāmāsvīkṛtāḥ śubhāḥ | mūlato brahma-viṣṇv-īśā darbhe sarve'bhito'marāḥ ||46||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.karmottarāntaṁ prāksaṁsthaṁ vyastaṁ vā p: karmottarāntaṁ prāk-saṁsthaṁ vyastaṁ vā pitryam-agnigam | yāmyantaṁ tadvad-āsyaṁ ca jñeyo'ṅge vāmataḥ kramaḥ ||47||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.brāhme muhūrta utthāya gaṇeśabrahmaviṣṇa: brāhme muhūrta utthāya gaṇeśabrahmaviṣṇavajān | devān-natvā gurūn-kheṭān-gāṁ sacchlokāṁśca saṁsmaret ||51||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.grāmādbahistu nairṛtyāṁ saddrumbvadhvādi: grāmād-bahis-tu nairṛtyāṁ saddrumbvadhvādi varjite | sthalembu dūrāt-saṁsthāpya yatanāsākṣivāk tṛṇe ||52||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.udaṅmukho'nyathā naktamāsīno vastramasta: udaṅ-mukho'nyathā naktam-āsīno vastra-mastakaḥ | ārṣa-sūtraṁ dakṣa-karṇe kṛtvā mūtra-viśau tyajet ||53||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.bhikṣurvratī trikālaṁ na ciraṇṭī śirasā: bhikṣur-vratī trikālaṁ na ciraṇṭī śirasā sadā | śītaiḥ śītāpsampuṭitoṣṇakairvābliṅgamantritaiḥ ||59||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.snātvā loḍyāmbvambumantraiḥ svamunmājyāg: snātvā loḍyāmbv-ambu-mantraiḥ svamunmājyāghamarṣaṇam | kṛtvā snātvā tarpayitvā jale devān-ṛṣīn-pitṝn||63||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.niṣpīḍyodagdaśaṁ vāsaḥ śodhitāṅgo gṛhaṁ: niṣpīḍyodag-daśaṁ vāsaḥ śodhitāṅgo gṛhaṁ vrajet | sravatyātmā sarandhro'taḥ prātaḥ-snānaṁ viśodhanam ||64||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.trisaptadvādaśāhaṁ cet sandhyāsnānāgniva: trisapta-dvādaśāhaṁ cet sandhyā-snānāgni-varjitaḥ | dvijo'pi śūdro'śaktaścen māntrādy-anyatamaṁ caret ||65||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.snātvā mṛdbhasma hutvāṅge dhāryamabhyarc: snātvā mṛd-bhasma hutvāṅge dhāryam-abhyarcya candanam | keśavādyair-dvādaśabhiḥ site pakṣe'site paraiḥ ||68||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.mṛdgandhitilakairaṅkyā bhasmapuṇḍraiḥ ṣa: mṛd-gandhi-tilakair-aṅkyā bhasma-puṇḍraiḥ ṣaḍarṇataḥ | mṛtāśauce na gandhānna māṅgalye bhasma dhārayet ||70||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.muktāṅguṣṭhālpagokarṇākṛtihastena kaṁ tr: muktāṅguṣṭhālpa-gokarṇākṛti-hastena kaṁ tribhiḥ | keśavādyaiḥ prāśya hastau dvābhyāṁ prakṣālya cādharau ||73||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.dvābhyāṁ prokṣyāsyamekaikāt karaṁ pādau: dvābhyāṁ prokṣyāsyam-ekaikāt karaṁ pādau śiro'paraiḥ | āsyaṁ nāsekṣiṇī karṇau nābhiṁ hṛtke bhujau spṛśet ||74||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.nāsāṁ sāṅguṣṭhatarjanyāṅguṣṭhenāsyaṁ ca: nāsāṁ sāṅguṣṭha-tarjanyāṅguṣṭhenāsyaṁ ca dṛk-śrutī | sānāmikena sālpena nābhiṁ kara-talāgrataḥ ||75||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.hṛdbāhūkaṁ ca sarvābhiḥ spṛśedācamanaṁ t: hṛdbāhūkaṁ ca sarvābhiḥ spṛśed-ācamanaṁ tvidam | tribhiḥ pītvā śuddha-pāṇiḥ spṛśet-karṇam-asaṁbhave ||76||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.prākpare karmasandhyāsu supte vāsodhṛtau: prāk-pare karma-sandhyāsu supte vāso-dhṛtau kṣute | kāsa-śvāsāgamādānādhyayanāśuddha-bhāṣaṇe ||78||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.śmaśānacatvāragatau pacchauce svā'nyayoḥ: śmaśāna-catvāra-gatau pacchauce svā'nyayoḥ kṛte | ācāmeddhīna-saṁbhāṣe strī-śūdrocchiṣṭa-bhāṣaṇe ||79||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.raktāśrupāte'suyāme jalottāre'bhivādane: raktāśru-pāte'suyāme jalottāre'bhivādane | ucchiṣṭa-sparśe'pāne ca yāte karṇaṁ spṛśet-tu vā ||80||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.vinā saṁdhyāvandanena nādhikāro'nyakarma: vinā saṁdhyāvandanena nādhikāro'nya-karmasu | samyag-brahmātra dhyāyanti viprāḥ sandhyā tataḥ smṛtā ||82||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.bhāḍhyā bhahīnārkayuktā tūttamā madhyamā: bhāḍhyā bhahīnārkayuktā tūttamā madhyamādhamā | prātaḥ-saṁdhyā'parā tadvat sārkākonā ca bhānvitā ||83||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.dhṛtvānāmikāṅguṣṭhair yativarṇī ca pañca: dhṛtvānāmikāṅguṣṭhair yativarṇī ca pañcabhiḥ | anyo nāsāṁ śanair-vāyuṁ savyayāpūrya śaktitaḥ ||85||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.praṇavavyāhṛtīḥ sapta gāyatrīṁ śirasā sa: praṇava-vyāhṛtīḥ sapta gāyatrīṁ śirasā saha | trir-japan-kumbhitaṁ mandaṁ dakṣa-nāḍyā virecayet ||86||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.kāryo'nyathāsuyāmānyo mūlabandho'tra sat: kāryo'nyathāsuyāmānyo mūla-bandho'tra sattamaḥ | jālandharoḍḍiyāṇākhyau kumbhake recake hitau||87||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.prāṇāyāmo'ghanighno'yaṁ kāryaḥ sarveṣu k: prāṇāyāmo'gha-nighno'yaṁ kāryaḥ sarveṣu karmasu | grāmād-bahiḥ syād-dviguṇaṁ nadyāṁ śata-guṇaṁ phalam ||88||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.tīrthe sahasraṁ sandhyāyāmanantaṁ sāndhy: tīrthe sahasraṁ sandhyāyām-anantaṁ sāndhya-karmajam | bahiḥ-saṁdhyā surā-pānānṛtoktyādyagha-hāriṇī ||89||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.varāntairnāntaiḥ sathāntaiḥ kramātke pād: varāntair-nāntaiḥ sathāntaiḥ kramāt-ke pādayor-hṛdi | āpohiṣṭheti pacchopaḥ prātar-madhyandine niśi ||91||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.sūryaścāpaḥ punantvagniśceti prāśya hyup: sūryaś-cāpaḥ punantv-agniś-ceti prāśya hy-upaspṛśet | soṅkāra-vyāhṛty-oṅkāra-yug-devy-apsūktato dvijaḥ ||92||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.mārjayetpratimaṁtraṁ ke ṛtaṁ ceti tṛcānt: mārjayet-pratimaṁtraṁ ke ṛtaṁ ceti tṛcāntare | niḥśvāsyāghanaraṁ smṛtvā dakṣa-nāsā-puṭena taṁ ||93||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.bahirniḥsārya haste'psu patitaṁ nāvaloki: bahir-niḥsārya haste'psu patitaṁ nāvalokitam | kṣiptvā kṣitau vāma-bhāga ācamyāp-pūritāñjaliḥ||94||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.asāvādityo brahmeti dhyātvāsicya pradakṣ: asāv-ādityo brahmeti dhyātvāsicya pradakṣiṇam | parītyācāmen-madhyāhne nato'rghyaṁ haṁsa ityṛcā ||96||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.upaviśya kṣamāṁ prārthya bhūtānyutsārya: upaviśya kṣamāṁ prārthya bhūtāny-utsārya bhāvayet | yathāṅgam-ātmany-ātmānaṁ devyā tad-rūpam-eka-dhīḥ ||100||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.ārṣadaivatachandāṁsi smarannakṣarapūrvak: ārṣa-daivata-chandāṁsi smarann-akṣara-pūrvakān | nyāsān-kṛtvā'khilā mudrāḥ pradarśya manu-devatām ||101||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.tāṁ bālāṁ bālādityeti tribhirdhyānaistri: tāṁ bālāṁ bālādityeti tribhir-dhyānais-trikālataḥ | dhyātvā cāgaccha varada iti tiṣṭhan-samāhitaḥ ||102||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.matrakārau manastrāṇau tadyogānmantra uc: matrakārau manas-trāṇau tad-yogān-mantra ucyate | janma-viccheda-pāpa-ghnau japakārau tu tad-yujā ||104||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.prokto japo hi yajño'yaṁ sarvayajñeṣu tū: prokto japo hi yajño'yaṁ sarva-yajñeṣu tūttamaḥ | vāciko'san-mānasaḥ san rahasyo madhyamo japaḥ||105||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.yatirjapetṣaḍoṅkārāṁ sahasraṁ cāṣṭayukśa: yatir-japet-ṣaḍ-oṅkārāṁ sahasraṁ cāṣṭa-yuk-śatam | anyo'ṣṭāviṁśatiṁ paṅktiṁ nārthārthaṁ tāṁ japed-dvijaḥ ||108||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.maitraiḥ saurairupasthāya vāruṇaiśca kra: maitraiḥ saurair-upasthāya vāruṇaiś-ca kramāt-sadā | jātavedase tacchaṁyos trir-namo brahmaṇe iti ||109||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.karmasthāgnyādihastāntadvatsvayaṁ cālpak: karmasthāgnyādihastāntadvatsvayaṁ cālpakānkagat | udvāhordhvaṁ caret-sāyaṁ prātar-aupāsanaṁ svayam ||113||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.jvālāyāṁ samidhaṁ hutvā prātaḥ sūryāya c: jvālāyāṁ samidhaṁ hutvā prātaḥ sūryāya cāgnaye | sāyaṁ tūṣṇīṁ tūbhayatra dvitīyāṁ juhuyāt-tataḥ ||115||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.upatiṣṭhetsvarcitāgniḥ sūryāgnimanubhiḥ: upatiṣṭhet-svarcitāgniḥ sūryāgni-manubhiḥ kramāt | kāyābhyāṁ tūbhayatrātra ṣaṣṭi-dhānya-mitāhutiḥ ||116||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.nātīyādbrāhmaṇo yajñān nityamāsikavārṣik: nātīyād-brāhmaṇo yajñān nitya-māsika-vārṣikān | nāhotīyāddinā dānaṁ śaktyā dadyāt kim-apy-uta ||118||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.bhagavantaṁ hariṁ viṣṇuṁ saṁsmaretsarvad: bhagavantaṁ hariṁ viṣṇuṁ saṁsmaret-sarvadā'sakṛt | saṁskṛte sārāre cchatre sve gṛhe nivased-gṛhī ||119||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.bhūḥ pūtāpyupaliptā cet punarlepena śudd: bhūḥ pūtāpyupaliptā cet punar-lepena śuddhyati | tan-nityaṁ vāstūpalimpet pretādyo'liptake'sti hi ||120||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.sthāpyaṁ gavyaṁ tilāścarma maṇiśrīkhaṇḍa: sthāpyaṁ gavyaṁ tilāś-carma maṇi-śrīkhaṇḍa-dhenavaḥ | trisandhye'rcyo'maraḥ prātar-vistarāc-candanādinā ||122||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.madhyāhne niśidīpairvā govajjanmānyathā: madhyāhne niśi-dīpair-vā govaj-janmānyathā dvija | gurvarkāgnyambvaṣṭhadhārcā go-viprānyatamārcanam ||123||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.kuryāttiṣye'jasāmīpyaṁ śāligrāme tamapyu: kuryāt-tiṣye'jasāmīpyaṁ śāligrāme tam-apy-uta | gurv-ājñayā bhaktimān-yaṁ pūjayet-sa prasīdati ||124||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.saṁbhārānupaviśyāgre devasyāppūritaṁ gha: saṁbhārān-upaviśyāgre devasyāp-pūritaṁ ghaṭam | dakṣa-bhāge nidhāyābjaṁ prapūjya prokṣya tat-sthalam ||127||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.dhyātvāñjalau sumagatāṁ vibhāvyārcāgatāṁ: dhyātvāñjalau suma-gatāṁ vibhāvyārcā-gatāṁ tataḥ | prakalpyārcāṁ deva-rūpāṁ sākṣān-matvā tato'rcayet ||131||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.saṁbhave satyāpluvādau dadyātpañcāmṛtāni: saṁbhave satyāpluvādau dadyāt-pañcāmṛtāni ca | bhūṣāḥ subhogā gandhordhvamaśane'traṁ catur-vidham ||134||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.ghaṇṭānādaṁ caredādau snāne dhūpapradīpa: ghaṇṭā-nādaṁ cared-ādau snāne dhūpa-pradīpayoḥ | dadyād-ācamanaṁ snāne naivedye vastra-sūtrayoḥ ||136||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.jalaṁ pratyupacāraṁ ca śaṅkhāmbvīśaṁ vin: jalaṁ pratyupacāraṁ ca śaṅkhāmbvīśaṁ vināplutau | svārāmāraṇya-krayāptaṁ puṣpaṁ sanmadhyamaṁ tvasat ||137||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.tadcchetāraktakṛṣṇaṁ varjyaṁ paryuṣitaṁ: tadcchetāraktakṛṣṇaṁ varjyaṁ paryuṣitaṁ sumam | sacchidraṁ jantu-yuk śīrṇaṁ kīṭādy-āttaṁ svayaṁ cyutam ||138||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.nārcyo gaṇeśastulasyā dūrvayāryeśvaro'si: nārcyo gaṇeśas-tulasyā dūrvayāryeśvaro'sitaiḥ | raktaiḥ ketaka-nimbādyair bilvaṁ śveta-sumaṁ priyam ||141||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.dūrvā gaṇeśasya viṣṇos tulasītyādi sarva: dūrvā gaṇeśasya viṣṇos tulasīty-ādi sarvaśaḥ | jñātvā puṣpāṇi deyāni śraddhayā deva-tuṣṭaye ||142||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.hutvā puṁsūktena datvā puṣpāṇi prārthaye: hutvā puṁsūktena datvā puṣpāṇi prārthayed-dhariḥ| mantraṁ japed-yathāśakti bhaktyā tad-vrata-hṛd-dvijaḥ ||143||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.dvijadevāṅghryabjatīrthaṁ peyaṁ dhāryaṁ: dvija-devāṅghry-abja-tīrthaṁ peyaṁ dhāryaṁ ca mūrdhani | caturdhādhyayanaṁ kuryāt-svavṛttyā poṣya-poṣaṇam ||144||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.svavṛttyā jīvanābhāvād gurvāpadyanyavārt: sva-vṛttyā jīvanābhāvād gurv-āpady-anya-vārtayā | jīvetānindyayā naiva hīna-vṛttyā kuṭumby-api ||145||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.kṛtasandhyaḥ kṛtopastho jānusthasakuśāñj: kṛta-sandhyaḥ kṛtopastho jānu-stha-sakuśāñjaliḥ | soṅkāra-vyāhṛtiṁ devīṁ rodasīdṛttadṛgjapet ||146||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.tāṁ paccho'rdhacaśaḥ sarvā vedānsāṅgānsv: tāṁ paccho'rdhacaśaḥ sarvā vedān-sāṅgān-sva-śaktitaḥ | tiṣṭhann-āsīno vrajan-vānadhyāye'lpaṁ japet-tataḥ ||147||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.trirnamo brahmaṇa iti tarpayetsākṣatāñja: trir-namo brahmaṇa iti tarpayet-sākṣatāñjaliḥ | devān-ṛṣīn tilaiḥ pitṝn sva-gṛhyokta-vidhānataḥ ||148||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.yajñādivarjyamāśauce karma mānasikaṁ car: yajñādi-varjyam-āśauce karma mānasikaṁ caret | yamāgni-pitṛ-bhe nandā śukrārkāhe janur-dine ||149||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.māṅgalye'bdatadardhārdhaṁ vivāhavratacau: māṅgalye'bda-tad-ardhārdhaṁ vivāha-vrata-caulataḥ | tilair-naimittikam-ṛte tarpayen-na gṛhe tu na ||150||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.bhīṣmaṁ māghasitāṣṭamyāṁ dīpālyāṁ tarpay: bhīṣmaṁ māgha-sitāṣṭamyāṁ dīpālyāṁ tarpayed-yamam | nityair-naimittikaiḥ śrāddhaiḥ sat-putraḥ putratāṁ vrajet ||151||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.triyajñāḍhyaṁ vaiśvadevaṁ kuryātsūnāpanu: triyajñāḍhyaṁ vaiśvadevaṁ kuryāt-sūnāpanuttaye | dhyāte kuṇḍa-sthāpite'gnau dīpte'nnādyāhutīr-hunet ||152||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.prātaḥ sāyaṁ balīndadyāt pitṛbhyo'pi bah: prātaḥ sāyaṁ balīn-dadyāt pitṛbhyo'pi bahir-balim | bhūtādy-uddeśataḥ kṣiptvā kāṅkṣed-atithim-āgatam ||153||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.kamapyabhyarcya śaktyānnaṁ deyamīśvaratu: kam-apy-abhyarcya śaktyānnaṁ deyam-īśvara-tuṣṭaye | sādyāntāmbv-annaṁ yatau tat svalpam-apy-adri-sindhuvat ||154||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.balāvanuddhṛte nādyānnoddharecca svayaṁ: balāv-anuddhṛte nādyānnoddharecca svayaṁ balim | nityaṁ śrāddhaṁ cared-vānnaṁ dadyād-adyāc-ca poṣya-yuk ||155||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.smṛtvāpo mantravatprāśya hutaprāṇāhutīrg: smṛtvāpo mantravat-prāśya huta-prāṇāhutīr-graset | dhṛta-pātraḥ prāṇa-mantrair-ajāvad-bhojanaṁ caret ||157||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.pātradhāraṇamaune tu prāṇāhutyūrdhvamaic: pātra-dhāraṇa-maune tu prāṇāhuty-ūrdhvam-aicchike | tejase rājate haime tāmre jambv-āmra-campake ||158||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.nārbhairvadhvodvāhamṛte nādyāduṣṭaikapaṅ: nārbhair-vadhvodvāham-ṛte nādyāduṣṭaikapaṅktigaḥ| dvār-bhasmāgry-ap-stambha-mārgair bhindyāt-paṅktiṁ tu saṁśaye ||161||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.nādyātpākāgnidevāsadgṛhe sandhyātirātriṣ: nādyāt-pākāgnidevāsadgṛhe sandhyātirātriṣu | pīta-śeṣaṁ grāsa-śeṣaṁ rātri-paryuṣitaṁ vinā ||162||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.tailājyapakvaṁ śūdrānnamudakyādivilokita: tailājya-pakvaṁ śūdrānnam-udakyādi-vilokitam | keśa-kīṭādi-yuk-pakvaṁ vyādyucchiṣṭaṁ sadā tyajet ||163||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.guḍaḥ sadadhyārdrako'san kevalaṁ lavaṇaṁ: guḍaḥ sadadhyārdrako'san kevalaṁ lavaṇaṁ tvasat | śvodakyāpatitādyāraśravaṇe tad-vilokane ||166||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.bhuktau parasparasparśe nādyātpaṅktistha: bhuktau paraspara-sparśe nādyāt-paṅktistha utthite | gurūn-vinolūkhalāder nādyādyāvaddhvani dvija ||167||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.naṣṭe dīpe na bhoktavyaṁ na mūtrādyutsṛt: naṣṭe dīpe na bhoktavyaṁ na mūtrādy-utsṛtau bhujiḥ| lehyādy-asaddhasta-dattaṁ nocchiṣṭaṁ bhājane nyaset ||168||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.grasedāsyāvikāreṇa grāsānaṣṭau yatirvanī: grased-āsyāvikāreṇa grāsān-aṣṭau yatir-vanī | ṣoḍaśa dvātriṁśad-anyo varṇīṣṭaṁ madhuraṁ dravam ||169||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.prāṅmadhye'mlādikaṭhinaṁ tiktādyante dra: prāṅ-madhye'mlādi-kaṭhinaṁ tiktādy-ante dravaṁ hyapi | sarvaṁ saśeṣam-aśrīyāt pāyasājyābdhijair-vinā ||170||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.tyaktvocchiṣṭaṁ kṣitau mantrāt pītāpośan: tyaktvocchiṣṭaṁ kṣitau mantrāt pītāpośana-śeṣakam | kau siktvā raurava iti mantrācchuddhkārāsyapāt||172||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.nayetpurāṇamananāt tato naktaṁ kṛtakriya: nayet-purāṇa-mananāt tato naktaṁ kṛta-kriyaḥ | svaped-yāmordhvaṁ dviyāmaṁ viṣṇavarpita-sama-kriyaḥ ||175||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.sumuhūrtakṛte talpe stuvanniṭsukhaśāyyah: sumuhūrta-kṛte talpe stuvanniṭsukhaśāyyahīn | trisandhye na svaped-bhūtyāṁ dhānye'hvacamaragogṛhe ||176||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.kāryā niśādyayāmāntaṁ saṅkaṭāntaritā kri: kāryā niśādya-yāmāntaṁ saṅkaṭāntaritā kriyā | naiśā niśītha-paryaṁtaṁ prāyaścittaṁ tataḥ param ||178||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.karmavaiguṇyādidoṣe lopādāvapi sarvaśaḥ: karma-vaiguṇyādi-doṣe lopādāv-api sarvaśaḥ | prāyaścittaṁ cared-vidvān yathāvan-nānyathā śuciḥ ||179||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.dveṣādinopagacchedyo nartau sa bhrūṇahāp: dveṣādinopagacched-yo nartau sa bhrūṇahāpy-ṛtau | yo videśaṁ vrajed-andhyāṁ kanyā-putrānvitām-ṛte ||182||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.ṣoḍaśāhamṛtuḥ kanyā'same'nnāhni same sut: ṣoḍaśāham-ṛtuḥ kanyā'same'nnāhni same sutaḥ | bhaven-niṣeka-samaye yādṛk-citta-vikalpanā ||183||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.bhrūṇastadvadatastābhyāṁ sattvaṁ dhāryaṁ: bhrūṇas-tadvad-atas-tābhyāṁ sattvaṁ dhāryaṁ hitāsraye | pitṛ-trātā hi sat-putraḥ prāyo'putrāḥ patanty-adhaḥ ||184||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.pitṛtāraka eko'pi satputrotra dhruvādiva: pitṛ-tāraka eko'pi satputrotra dhruvādivat | kiṁ kāryaṁ bahubhir-duṣṭair dhārtarāṣṭra-śatopamaiḥ ||185||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.tārako'traivamācāraḥ proktaḥ śāktyādisaṁ: tārako'traivam-ācāraḥ proktaḥ śāktyādi-saṁmataḥ | vicārācāram-ādāya karma kurvan-sukhī bhava ||186||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.ubhayīsiddhibhājaste ya ācāraṁ carantyam: ubhayī-siddhi-bhājas-te ya ācāraṁ caranty-amum | svācāra-hīnā daṇḍyāḥ syur brāhmaṇās-tu viśeṣataḥ ||187||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.iti gurumukhalabdhaṁ dharmamenaṁ caransa: iti guru-mukha-labdhaṁ dharmam-enaṁ caran-sa | dvija iha sukham-iṣṭaṁ sādhu bhuktvā'pa mokṣam|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/18_adh.tata udita ihāsau tiṣyalupto'pi dharmo|: tata udita ihāsau tiṣya-lupto'pi dharmo| vibhur-api laghu-siddhyai bhakti-yogaṁ tatāna ||188||

dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tribhiryogapathaireva parasparasahāyakai: tribhir-yoga-pathair-eva paraspara-sahāyakaiḥ | brahmādvandvaṁ samaṁ śāntaṁ gamyate naikayogataḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.śraddhāluḥ sāttviko bhakto nitarāṁ bhaga: śraddhāluḥ sāttviko bhakto nitarāṁ bhagavat-priyaḥ | sakārmam-api tad-bhinnaṁ śaśvat-kṣipati durbhave
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśyedakarmaṇyapi karm: karmaṇy-akarma yaḥ paśyed-akarmaṇy-api karma yaḥ | sa loke bhaktimān-dhīmān mucyate karma-bandhanāt
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.bhaktiyogamayaṁ tasya bhaktigamyasya ceṣ: bhakti-yoga-mayaṁ tasya bhakti-gamyasya ceṣṭitam | śṛṇu tasmin-dṛḍhā bhaktiḥ pūtā yacchravaṇād-bhavet
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.bhikṣāṁ saśiṣyagurava ekaikaḥ pratyahaṁ: bhikṣāṁ saśiṣya-gurava ekaikaḥ pratyahaṁ dadau | bhāskarākhyo dvijo dīna āyayau tatra bhaktimān
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.ādāya gurave bhikṣāṁ dātukāmo gurupriyaḥ: ādāya gurave bhikṣāṁ dātukāmo guru-priyaḥ | sa tripuṁbhukti-paryāptaṁ taṇḍulādikam-āpa tam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.taddine kenaciddattā bhikṣā śrīgurave va: tad-dine kenacid-dattā bhikṣā śrī-gurave varā | śiṣya-bhakta-yuje tatra so'pi bhoktuṁ yayau dvijaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.taṁ tatropahasanti sma prāpya svalpānnat: taṁ tatropahasanti sma prāpya svalpānnato gurum | bhikṣāṁ dātuṁ prājya-śiṣyaṁ puṣṇāti svam-itītare
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tajjñātvā taṁ prabhuḥ prāha bhaktiyogavi: taj-jñātvā taṁ prabhuḥ prāha bhakti-yoga-vidhitsayā | drāṅme saśiṣya-bhaktāya bhikṣāṁ dehy-adya bhāvika
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.dātuṁ tadānyamapyutkaṁ bhikṣāṁ dehi śva: dātuṁ tadānyam-apy-utkaṁ bhikṣāṁ dehi śva ity-ajaḥ | taṁ nivāryāhvayāśeṣān-bhoktum-ity-āha bhāskaram
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tacchrutvāpyāhvayattānsa ta ūcurlajjase: tacchrutvāpy-āhvayat-tān-sa ta ūcur-lajjase na kim | paktānna-kaṇa-tulyānnaḥ kim-āhūya kariṣyasi
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tacchrutvaitya guruṁ tatsa śaśaṁsa bhaga: tacchrutvaitya guruṁ tatsa śaśaṁsa bhagavāṁs-tadā | ānayitvātra bhoktavyaṁ sarvair-ity-āha tān-guruḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.śaṅkitā api tadvākyāt tūṣṇīṁ sthitvā bah: śaṅkitā api tad-vākyāt tūṣṇīṁ sthitvā bahūni te | nirmāya bhukti-pātrāṇi sarve snātvāyayuḥ punaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.śāṭyeśasyājñayācchādya siddhānnaṁ tīrtha: śāṭyeśasyājñayācchādya siddhānnaṁ tīrtha-mantritam | sahānyaiḥ ṣaḍvidhaṁ so'dād gurave brāhmaṇaiḥ saha
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.nītvā nītvāpi bhoktṛbhyo dattaṁ tatra tu: nītvā nītvāpi bhoktṛbhyo dattaṁ tatra tu pūrvavat | nāpy-alpaṁ dātṛbhis-taṣṭaṁ ceṣṭā bhagavatas-tv-iyam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.bhuktaṁ saśeṣamākaṇṭhaṁ tṛptāḥ smo'lamit: bhuktaṁ saśeṣam-ākaṇṭhaṁ tṛptāḥ smo'lam-iti dvijāḥ | uktvottasthuḥ sahājena tato gurv-ājñayāṅghrijān
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.hīnāṁścāhūya tebhyo'dātkāmaṁ nānnaṁ vyah: hīnāṁś-cāhūya tebhyo'dāt-kāmaṁ nānnaṁ vyahīyata | paśu-pakṣi-mṛgādibhyaḥ prakāmaṁ sa upānayat
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.na śiṣṭāstatra kepīti śrutvā bhuktvā tad: na śiṣṭās-tatra kepīti śrutvā bhuktvā tad-ājñayā | yādobhyo'dātsa śeṣānnaṁ tadā niḥśeṣatāṁ yayau
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.mādhuryaṁ surasānnasya durlabhaṁ hyamṛtā: mādhuryaṁ surasānnasya durlabhaṁ hy-amṛtāndhasām | svapne'pi na śrutaṁ rucyaṁ tṛptir-eṣāpy-alaukikī
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.prākpārthasaṅkaṭe'raṇye niśīthe'dātsvamā: prāk-pārtha-saṅkaṭe'raṇye niśīthe'dāt-svamāyayā | ṛṣibhyo'nnaṁ harir-iti śrutaṁ dṛṣṭaṁ tvado'tra tu
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.nṛṇāṁ catuḥsahasrāṇi bhuktāni svalpapāka: nṛṇāṁ catuḥ-sahasrāṇi bhuktāni svalpa-pākataḥ | jīvā agaṇitā bhuktā māyā'tarkyeyam-īśituḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.bhāskaro'yaṁ priyo bhakto yatprasādo'sya: bhāskaro'yaṁ priyo bhakto yat-prasādo'sya nānyake | trimāsaṁ sarvadā tena pāda-saṁvāhanādibhiḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.śraddhābhaktyaiva bhagavān sevitastatpha: śraddhā-bhaktyaiva bhagavān sevitas-tat-phalaṁ tvidam | ity-uktvānye narāḥ premṇā tuṣṭuvuḥ śrī-guruṁ param
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.datvā prabhurbhāskaramīpsitaṁ varaṁ pras: datvā prabhur-bhāskaram-īpsitaṁ varaṁ prasthāpayāmāsa gṛhāya sa dvijaḥ |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.sādhvī vaśānarca parameśamanvahaṁ bhakty: sādhvī vaśānarca parameśam-anvahaṁ bhaktyaikadoce sa tu tāṁ kim-icchasi
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.loko'putrasya na svasthā luptapiṇḍodakak: loko'putrasya na svasthā lupta-piṇḍodaka-kriyāḥ | pitaro'dhaḥ patantīti śrutvā svāmin bibhemy-aham
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.bhave'gre suputrāptyā gatirbhūyāditīccha: bhave'gre suputrāptyā gatir-bhūyād-itīcchayā | sarveśa te'rcanaṁ kurve pāhi māṁ karuṇā-nidhe
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.kamāvartena māyābdhau kva bhramiṣyasi ve: kamāvartena māyābdhau kva bhramiṣyasi vetsi kim | kveyaṁ tatra smṛtis-te'tra putrau gaṅge bhaviṣyataḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tacchrutvā pallave granthiṁ badhvoce put: tacchrutvā pallave granthiṁ badhvoce putravaty-aho | niṣkalā jāti-vandhyāpi bhaveyaṁ tvat-prasādataḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.vratatīrthārcane yātaṁ vayo me putrakāma: vrata-tīrthārcane yātaṁ vayo me putra-kāmayā | viśeṣāt-sevito'śvattho maukhyād-dāsyati kiṁ sa me
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.brahmanāradasaṁvādaṁ śṛṇvātha yadasattu: brahma-nārada-saṁvādaṁ śṛṇvātha yad-asat-tu tat | nāradāśvattha-mūle'haṁ madhye'jo'gre śivaḥ punaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.avākpratyagudakśākhās trayāṇāṁ prāksamāḥ: avāk-pratyag-udak-śākhās trayāṇāṁ prāk-samāḥ surāḥ | tīrthābdhayaś-cāṅkureṣu go-yajñarṣi-śruti-dvijāḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tattale goviśā lipte rañjite svasti vāca: tat-tale goviśā lipte rañjite svasti vācayet | saṁsnāpya sapta-kalaśaiḥ pūjayet-svādhikārataḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.nametpradakṣiṇāyāstu bhaktyādyantasamāpt: namet-pradakṣiṇāyās-tu bhaktyādy-anta-samāptiṣu | pade pade medha-phalaṁ dainyarṇārtyagha-tāpa-hṛt
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.yeneha sthāpito'śvatthastena svaḥ sthāpi: yeneha sthāpito'śvatthas-tena svaḥ sthāpitaṁ kulam | yena cchinno'pi vaṁśaḥ svastena cchinno na saṁśayaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.pradakṣiṇādaśāṁśena havanaṁ taddaśāṁśata: pradakṣiṇā-daśāṁśena havanaṁ tad-daśāṁśataḥ | kṛtvā brahma-bhuji dadyāddhaimāśvatthārthagotilān
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.sadbrahmabhyo labhediṣṭamityūce nāradaṁ: sad-brahmabhyo labhed-iṣṭam-ity-ūce nāradaṁ vidhiḥ | tasmāt-taṁ vidhinā sādhvī bhaja drāk-siddhido'sti saḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tvaṁ bhīmāmarajāyoge snātvā ṣaṭkula utta: tvaṁ bhīmāmarajā-yoge snātvā ṣaṭkula uttamam | saṁgama-sthaṁ bhajāśvatthaṁ satyaṁ putrau bhaviṣyataḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tathā kurve'pi ṣaṣṭyabdā matvoktiṁ tava: tathā kurve'pi ṣaṣṭyabdā matvoktiṁ tava vedavat | ity-uktvā seśvarāśvatthaṁ patyā bheje yathāvidhi
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.caturthe'hnyāha tatsvapne kṛtvāśvatthapr: caturthe'hnyāha tat-svapne kṛtvāśvattha-pradakṣiṇāḥ | yad-dāsyati gurur-bhuṅkṣva bhavet-putra iti dvijaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.sāpyutthāya tataḥ snātvā saṅgamaṁ prāpya: sāpy-utthāya tataḥ snātvā saṅgamaṁ prāpya sad-gurum | bhaktyā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya sāśvatthaṁ praṇanāma ha
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.datvā phale sa tāṁ prāha dānaṁ dehi samā: datvā phale sa tāṁ prāha dānaṁ dehi samāpya sat | vrataṁ pradakṣiṇā-rūpaṁ phale bhuṁkṣveṣṭa-kāmade
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tatsādhvīhaurasau putrau tārakau te bhav: tatsādhvīhaurasau putrau tārakau te bhaviṣyataḥ | mad-arcana-phalaṁ tvetan-na sandeho'tra śobhane
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tathetyuktvāpi sā gehaṁ gatvā cakre yath: tathety-uktvāpi sā gehaṁ gatvā cakre yathoditam | niṣkalāpy-ṛtumaty-āsīn niḥsīma-mahimā prabhoḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.śuddhyūrdhvaṁ saha patyaitya sā prapūjya: śuddhy-ūrdhvaṁ saha patyaitya sā prapūjya guruṁ mudā | gṛhaṁ gatvā dadhau garbhaṁ tan-niśīśa-prasādataḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.svatantrasaṁvidbhagavān līlāṁ ko vetti y: svatantra-saṁvid-bhagavān līlāṁ ko vetti yat-stutau | dvi-sahasra-rasajño'pi kuṇṭhitaścakitā śrutiḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.valīpalitavepairyaddeho viddho jarākṛśaḥ: valī-palita-vepair-yad-deho viddho jarā-kṛśaḥ | sādhatta garbham-ity-anye praśaśaṁsuḥ parasparam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tadbhartā somanāthastu prītyā puṁsavanād: tad-bhartā somanāthas-tu prītyā puṁsavanādikāḥ | kriyā vyadhāt-kramāt-putrīṁ kāle'sauṣīt-tataḥ satī
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tadeyaṁ kanyakā sādhvī sacchīlaguṇaśālin: tadeyaṁ kanyakā sādhvī sacchīlaguṇaśālinī | bhaviṣyati kuloddhartrī putrāḍhyety-āha daiva-vit
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tacchrutvā sa dvijebhyo'dādarthavastrādi: tacchrutvā sa dvijebhyo'dād-artha-vastrādikaṁ dvijaḥ | prāpatur-dvādaśe'hnīśaṁ kanyām-ādāya jampatī
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.sevyate phalito'pi druḥ pānthaiścetsupha: sevyate phalito'pi druḥ pānthaiś-cet-suphalo varam | vandhyo'pi mogha-phalata iti bhātīśa vetsi tat
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tacchrutvā sasmitaṁ kanyāmādāyeśo jagāda: tacchrutvā sasmitaṁ kanyām-ādāyeśo jagāda tau | śīla-dhī-guṇa-putrāḍhyā bhavet-sādhvy-akhilārcitā
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.kanyā labdhottameyaṁ vāṁ putrecchā cedbh: kanyā labdhottameyaṁ vāṁ putrecchā ced-bhavet-sutaḥ | mūrkhaḥ śatāyurvālpāyurvidvānvāṁ kataraḥ priyaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.sārbho vidvān priyo'lpāyurapītyūcaturapy: sārbho vidvān priyo'lpāyur-apīty-ūcatur-apy-ubhau | tathety-uktvā sa sāpatyau gamayāmāsa tau prabhuḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.garbhaṁ sāpyalpakālena dhṛtvāsūta sutaṁ: garbhaṁ sāpy-alpa-kālena dhṛtvāsūta sutaṁ śubham | śraddhayā niṣkalāpy-evaṁ putrau lebhe'tha kiṁ vada
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.vidyāvinayavān bhūtvā pitṛśuśrūṣaṇodyata: vidyā-vinayavān bhūtvā pitṛ-śuśrūṣaṇodyataḥ | dhārmikaḥ pañca putrāṁs-tat-putro labdhvāmṛtaṁ yayau
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.evaṁ guruprabhāvo'yaṁ śraddhādṛṣṭyaiva d: evaṁ guru-prabhāvo'yaṁ śraddhā-dṛṣṭyaiva dṛśyate | sad-bhaktair-na tv-abhaktaiḥ sa janmāndhair-iva bhāskaraḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.daṇḍakuṇḍīkaraṁ śāntaṁ kāṣāyācchādanaṁ s: daṇḍa-kuṇḍī-karaṁ śāntaṁ kāṣāyācchādanaṁ sadā | dhyāyantau yati-rūpaṁ taṁ dampatī muktim-āpatuḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.śraddhābhaktyaiva sulabhā guruvākyānuvar: śraddhā-bhaktyaiva sulabhā guru-vākyānuvartinām | ubhayī siddhir-apy-anyac-citraṁ tac-ceṣṭitaṁ śṛṇu
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tatraitya naraharyākhyo vipraḥ kuṣṭhī ja: tatraitya narahary-ākhyo vipraḥ kuṣṭhī jagad-gurum | praṇataḥ śaraṇaṁ prāpya prāvocad gadgadākṣaraḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.yajurvido'pi me tuṇḍaṁ ke'pi nekṣanti ku: yajur-vido'pi me tuṇḍaṁ ke'pi nekṣanti kuṣṭhinaḥ | tīrthārcana-japaiḥ kuṣṭhaṁ tanme nāpaityaghātmanaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.kṛpayā te'payāyāt taditi matvāgato'smyah: kṛpayā te'payāyāt taditi matvāgato'smy-aham | nāsti cet-tat-pratīkāraḥ śaṁsāgre'sūṁstyajāmi te
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tacchrutvā prāktanāghotthaṁ kuṣṭhaṁ naśy: tacchrutvā prāktanāghotthaṁ kuṣṭhaṁ naśyed-iti prabhuḥ | proktvā śuṣkaudumbaraidho dṛṣṭvāvocat-sa kuṣṭhinam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.madvākye bhaktimāṁścet tatkāṣṭhamāropya: mad-vākye bhaktimāṁś-cet tat-kāṣṭham-āropya saṅgame | bhaja pallavite tasmiñchuddho'kuṣṭho bhaviṣyasi
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.omityuktvā tadāropya śraddhābhaktyā sa s: om-ity-uktvā tad-āropya śraddhā-bhaktyā sa saṅgame | bheje datvādhāra-bandhaṁ parito'mbu-niṣecanaiḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.kṛpā'sya sadyastava śuddhyabhāvāduktaṁ p: kṛpā'sya sadyas-tava śuddhy-abhāvād-uktaṁ phalaṁ kaṣṭam-idaṁ kuto'smin |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tadaitya te guruṁ prāhurbhavadvākyādidvi: tadaitya te guruṁ prāhur-bhavadvākyādidvijo jarat | bhajatīdhmaṁ bodhaya taṁ mariṣyatyupavāsataḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.karoti sādhu tadvipro dṛḍhabhaktyā tariṣ: karoti sādhu tad-vipro dṛḍha-bhaktyā tariṣyati | bhaktir-hi tārakātraiva bhava-sindhu-nimajjataḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.mantre tīrthe dvije deve daivajñe bhi(bh: mantre tīrthe dvije deve daivajñe bhi(bhe)ṣaje gurau | yādṛśī bhāvanā yasya tasya siddhis-tu tādṛśī
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.vacmi sūtarṣisaṁvādaṁ prāgvṛttaṁ dṛḍhabh: vacmi sūtarṣi-saṁvādaṁ prāg-vṛttaṁ dṛḍha-bhakti-dam | ṛṣīn-sūto jagādedaṁ siṁha-ketu-nṛpātmajaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.dhanañjayākhyaḥ pāñcāla ekadā vanamabhya: dhanañjayākhyaḥ pāñcāla ekadā vanam-abhyagāt | dṛṣṭvā sa mṛgayā-śrāntas tatra jīrṇaṁ śivālayam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.liṅgaṁ nītvā pūjayituṁ kāṁkṣe'jño'smyanu: liṅgaṁ nītvā pūjayituṁ kāṁkṣe'jño'smy-anuśādhi mām | yad-ājñāpayase deva dṛḍha-bhaktyā karomi tat
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.saṁsthāpya satsthale liṅgaṁ śucirbhūtvā: saṁsthāpya sat-sthale liṅgaṁ śucir-bhūtvā striyānvitaḥ | bhaktyā pūjaya matveśam-upacārair-yathāvidhi
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.citābhasmānvahaṁ deyaṁ dattānnaṁ bhuṅkṣv: citā-bhasmānvahaṁ deyaṁ dattānnaṁ bhuṅkṣva bhāryayā | prasāda-buddhyety-uktvā sa pūjā-vidhim-upādiśat
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.so'pi tuṣṭo gṛhītvaikaṁ liṅgaṁ gatvā gṛh: so'pi tuṣṭo gṛhītvaikaṁ liṅgaṁ gatvā gṛhaṁ striyā | bheje yathopadeśaṁ tad bhasmādāt-pratyahaṁ mudā
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.bhasmaikasmindine kvāpi na lebhe'bhūtsa: bhasmaikasmindine kvāpi na lebhe'bhūt-sa durmanāḥ | tad-bhāryā prāha māṁ dagdhvā śambhave'rpaya bhasma tat
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.kuryāṁ kathaṁ tanvi kiśori bālike bho sā: kuryāṁ kathaṁ tanvi kiśori bālike bho sādhvy-alabdhaihika-saukhya uttame
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.prokte suyukte priyayā tathetyasau prokt: prokte suyukte priyayā tathety-asau proktvā gṛhe tām-avaruddhya sālayām |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.dagdhvārpayadbhasma śivāya nityavad bhrā: dagdhvārpayad-bhasma śivāya nityavad bhrāntyā prasāda-kṣaṇa āhvayat-priyām
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.dagdhāpi gehena sahāgatā kathaṁ suptotth: dagdhāpi gehena sahāgatā kathaṁ suptotthitāsmīti śabary-uvāca tam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.dauṣkulyadoṣaṁ parihṛtya darśanāt tābhyā: dauṣkulya-doṣaṁ parihṛtya darśanāt tābhyāṁ śivo'dād-ubhayatra kāṅkṣitam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.bhakteḥ prabhāvo'yamiyānna kiñcit phalat: bhakteḥ prabhāvo'yam-iyān-na kiñcit phalaty-ṛte bhaktimato'sya siddhyet |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.bhaktyeṣṭamityāha sa tānkadācid gacchanp: bhaktyeṣṭam-ity-āha sa tān-kadācid gacchan-prabhuḥ snātum-amuṁ dadarśa
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.dadarśa saddivyadṛśā tadedhme sadyo'ṅkur: dadarśa sad-divya-dṛśā tad-edhme sadyo'ṅkurā bhūriśa āvirāsan
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.divyaṁ svadhāmāṅkuritaṁ ca kāṣṭhamadṛṣṭa: divyaṁ sva-dhāmāṅkuritaṁ ca kāṣṭham-adṛṣṭa-kuṣṭho'grata āsthitaṁ tam |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.bhaktapriyaṁ tvātrisutaṁ vareṇyaṁ vande: bhakta-priyaṁ tvātri-sutaṁ vareṇyaṁ vande nṛsiṁheśvara pāhi māṁ tvam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.sadbhaktasevyaṁ varadaṁ variṣṭhaṁ vande: sad-bhakta-sevyaṁ varadaṁ variṣṭhaṁ vande nṛsiṁheśvara pāhi māṁ tvam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.saddharmaguptyai vidhṛtāvatāraṁ vande nṛ: sad-dharma-guptyai vidhṛtāvatāraṁ vande nṛsiṁheśvara pāhi māṁ tvam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.śritasmitajyotsnamukhenduśobhaṁ vande nṛ: śrita-smita-jyotsna-mukhendu-śobhaṁ vande nṛsiṁheśvara pāhi māṁ tvam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tritāpataptāśritakalpavṛkṣaṁ vande nṛsiṁ: tritāpa-taptāśrita-kalpavṛkṣaṁ vande nṛsiṁheśvara pāhi māṁ tvam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.kṛṣṇānadīpañcasaridyutisthaṁ vande nṛsiṁ: kṛṣṇā-nadī-pañcasarid-yuti-sthaṁ vande nṛsiṁheśvara pāhi māṁ tvam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.vyatītavāghṛtpathamadvitīyaṁ vande nṛsiṁ: vyatīta-vāghṛt-patham-advitīyaṁ vande nṛsiṁheśvara pāhi māṁ tvam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.stotre kva te me'styurugāya śaktiś catur: stotre kva te me'sty-urugāya śaktiś catur-mukho vai vimukho'tra jātaḥ |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.śiṣyottama tvaṁ yogajño bhaviṣyasi kulaṁ: śiṣyottama tvaṁ yogajño bhaviṣyasi kulaṁ ca te | tvadvad-bhaviṣyaty-ānīya vadhūṁ tiṣṭha dhruvaṁ tviha
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tathetyuktvā dvijo bhāryāmānīya sa tayā: tathety-uktvā dvijo bhāryām-ānīya sa tayā saha | tatra tasthau tato lebhe putrān-putrīṁ sa sattamān
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.vidyāsarasvatīmantraṁ gurudattaṁ japanva: vidyā-sarasvatī-mantraṁ guru-dattaṁ japan-varam | bheje guruṁ bhavāsakto jīvan-mukto'bhavad-dvijaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.tatkulaṁ cāpi tattulyaṁ tadbhaktimahimā: tat-kulaṁ cāpi tat-tulyaṁ tad-bhakti-mahimā tviyān | tvat-pūrvajo'pi tat-tulyas tasmāt-te matir-īdṛśī
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/19_adh.sadgurostu prasādo'yaṁ bhaviṣyatyapi te: sad-guros-tu prasādo'yaṁ bhaviṣyaty-api te kule | vardhamānaḥ sadaiveti saṁvinme brāhmaṇa dhruvā

dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.ko matpūrvaḥ kathaṁ tena sevito bhagavān: ko mat-pūrvaḥ kathaṁ tena sevito bhagavān-prabhuḥ | yatprabhāvānmamedṛgddhīs tacchrotuṁ sādaro'smy-aham
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.prāguktaṁ yavanāt trātaḥ sāyaṁdeva iti p: prāg-uktaṁ yavanāt trātaḥ sāyaṁdeva iti priya | pūrvaḥ sa eva te'śrauṣīd-guruṁ gandharva-pūḥ-sthitam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.tatraitya praṇato vipro maṭhe dṛṣṭvā par: tatraitya praṇato vipro maṭhe dṛṣṭvā parātparam | natvā daṇḍavad-astauṣīd-upasaṁgṛhya paddvayam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.paramātmanparañjyotiḥ śrīnṛsiṁhasarasvat: paramātman-parañ-jyotiḥ śrī-nṛsiṁhasarasvati | bhakteśa śruti-cintyaṁ te sarva-tīrthāśrayaṁ padam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.mṛto jīvito yena dugdhā lulāyī vaśā śuṣk: mṛto jīvito yena dugdhā lulāyī vaśā śuṣka-kāṣṭhaṁ tarutvaṁ praṇītam|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.stutyānayāsmi te vipra bhṛśaṁ toṣamupāga: stutyānayāsmi te vipra bhṛśaṁ toṣam-upāgataḥ | bhūyāt-te vaṁśa-mātrasya śraddhā-bhaktir-mayi dhruvā
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.kaccitkṣemaṁ yuvatyādes tava brūhi kva t: kaccit-kṣemaṁ yuvatyādes tava brūhi kva tiṣṭhasi | kālena bahunā vipra saṁgato'sy-adya mat-priya
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.devadeva jagannātha bhagavantvatprasādat: deva-deva jagannātha bhagavan-tvat-prasādataḥ | sarveṣāṁ kṣemam-astīśa kāñcyāṁ tiṣṭhāmy-ahaṁ svakaiḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.kaṣṭaṁ me sevanaṁ nājña ko'pi jñātuṁ na: kaṣṭaṁ me sevanaṁ nājña ko'pi jñātuṁ na śakyate | grāme nadī-taṭe'raṇye durgame'pi vasāmyaham
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.tacchrutvā so'nuyāsyāmi yatra kvāpīttham: tacchrutvā so'nuyāsyāmi yatra kvāpīttham-ādade | tathety-uktvaikadā śambhus tenāgāt-saha saṁgamam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.nivāryānyānsamaṁ tena sthitvāśvatthatale: nivāryānyān-samaṁ tena sthitvāśvattha-tale niśi | vṛṣṭyai tadādideśābdam-akāle'pi parīkṣitum
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.garjitābdo vavarṣāraṁ jhañjhāvātasakhast: garjitābdo vavarṣāraṁ jhañjhāvāta-sakhas-tadā | kṣaṇaprabhāpi muṣṇantī dṛṣṭim-āsīd-anukṣaṇam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.uparyupari vastraistaṁ samantātsa prakam: uparyupari vastrais-taṁ samantāt-sa prakampitam | sahiṣṇuḥ śrī-guruṁ bheja āsārārtiraṇaddvijaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.yāmābhyāṁ khaṇḍitaṁ varṣaṁ dṛṣṭvoce taṁ: yāmābhyāṁ khaṇḍitaṁ varṣaṁ dṛṣṭvoce taṁ guruḥ puram | gatvāgnim-ānayātyantaṁ klinnāṅge śītam-utthitam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.kaiḥ kṛto'yaṁ dhvanirdyotaḥ kvetyabhūcch: kaiḥ kṛto'yaṁ dhvanir-dyotaḥ kvety-abhūcchaṅkitaḥ sa tam | bhītaṁ prāha gurur-mā bhīs-tvad-guptyai tau pracoditau
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.tadāpyahī guruṁ natvā jagmatustaṁ prabhu: tadāpy-ahī guruṁ natvā jagmatus-taṁ prabhur-dvijam | prāhedṛśī guroḥ sevā marutām-api duṣkarā
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.chāyaupamyena saṁsevyo gurustattvamidaṁ: chāyaupamyena saṁsevyo gurus-tattvam-idaṁ param | prārpayen-niyataṁ dehaṁ sārthaṁ tasmai parātma-dṛk
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.duḥsādhye'pi yadādiṣṭaṁ kārye bhaktyā ta: duḥsādhye'pi yad-ādiṣṭaṁ kārye bhaktyā tad-ārabhet | ārabdhaṁ sa nayet-siddhiṁ bhītaḥ kālo'py-apaity-ataḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.śṛṇu gaurīśasaṁvādaṁ brāhmastvaṣṭābhajad: śṛṇu gaurīśa-saṁvādaṁ brāhmas-tvaṣṭābhajad gurum | vidyārthī sarva-bhāvāt-tad-dārḍhyaṁ jñātuṁ gurur-jagau
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.varṣāsvāpaḥ patantyatra pratyabjamuṭaje: varṣāsv-āpaḥ patanty-atra pratyabjamuṭaje tvataḥ | racayaikaṁ gṛhaṁ ramyaṁ sukhadaṁ nūtnavatsadā
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.śiṣyaṁ tadāśrutya yāntaṁ gurustrīḥ prāha: śiṣyaṁ tadāśrutya yāntaṁ guru-strīḥ prāha kañcukam | dehi me'ṅgamitaṁ citraṁ manoharam-akṛtrimam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.putro'pyāhāṅghriyogye me pāduke dehi ye': putro'pyāhāṅghri-yogye me pāduke dehi ye'mbhasi | garte'pi yātuḥ sukhade cintita-sthala-nāyake
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.sacetanāḥ sadā yeṣu pākaḥ śaityaṁ na yās: sacetanāḥ sadā yeṣu pākaḥ śaityaṁ na yāsyati | anañjana-spṛg-bhāṇḍānīty-ākarṇya sa yayau vanam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.ajño'smyapyatra gurvarthaṁ martavyamiti: ajño'smy-apy-atra gurv-arthaṁ martavyam-iti taṁ vane | nirviṇṇam-āyayau kaścid-avadhūto dayārdra-dhīḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.vyapetabhīḥ prahṛṣṭātmā gurubhāvanayā sa: vyapeta-bhīḥ prahṛṣṭātmā guru-bhāvanayā sa tam | upasaṁgṛhya tat-tasmai śaśaṁsa guru-bhāṣitam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.tamāśvāsyābravītsādhuḥ kāśīkṣetre tvabhī: tam-āśvāsyābravīt-sādhuḥ kāśī-kṣetre tv-abhīṣṭade | sati jāgrati viśveśe kiṁ keṣāṁ durlabhaṁ vada
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.tatratyapuṇyaṁ ko vetti tadvāsyuddīkṣaṇā: tatratya-puṇyaṁ ko vetti tad-vāsy-uddīkṣaṇād-api | apaity-aghaughaḥ kiṁ vācyaṁ sukham-ānanda-kānane
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.pumarthado'pi viśveśaḥ prāṇimātraṁ mṛtaṁ: pum-artha-do'pi viśveśaḥ prāṇi-mātraṁ mṛtaṁ kṣaṇāt | sa tārakopadeśena datte muktim-anukṣaṇam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.kvāste kāśī kva viśveśo jāne svarbhuvi v: kvāste kāśī kva viśveśo jāne svar-bhuvi vā na tat | prārthaye tārakaṁ tvāṁ me darśayājño'smi kevalam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.viśveśadarśanaṁ cāntargṛhayātrāṁ yathākr: viśveśa-darśanaṁ cāntar-gṛha-yātrāṁ yathākramam | dakṣiṇodaṅ-mānasākhyāṁ pañca-krośīṁ ca vistarāt
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.guhaḥ kāśī ca gaṅgādyā devā liṅgani sarv: guhaḥ kāśī ca gaṅgādyā devā liṅgani sarvaśaḥ| ity-ādīnāṁ pūjanaṁ ca nivedya sthāpanaṁ tathā
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.svanāmāṅkitaliṅgasya kathayitvā yathokta: sva-nāmāṅkita-liṅgasya kathayitvā yathoktavat | kuru prasīdedviśveśa ity-uktvāntardadhe svayam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.madbhāvasya parīkṣāyai gurū rūpāntarāday: mad-bhāvasya parīkṣāyai gurū rūpāntarād-ayam | prāptaḥ kileti matvā sa yathānirdiṣṭam-ācarat
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.caritvā kṣetrayātrāṁ sa liṅgaṁ saṁsthāpa: caritvā kṣetra-yātrāṁ sa liṅgaṁ saṁsthāpayat-tadā | viśveśo darśayitvā svaṁ rūpaṁ prīto'bravīd-idam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.vatsa vatsa pavitro'si gurubhaktyā viśud: vatsa vatsa pavitro'si guru-bhaktyā viśuddhayā | dhanyo'sy-anugṛhīto'si vṛṇīṣvābhīpsitaṁ varam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.prasārya kvāpi cāturyaṁ lokakhyāto bhavi: prasārya kvāpi cāturyaṁ loka-khyāto bhaviṣyasi | ity-uktvāntardadhe viśveṭ tataḥ so'py-āyayau gurum
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.bhūtvā jyotīṁṣi yāvattvaṁ cirajīvī prasā: bhūtvā jyotīṁṣi yāvat-tvaṁ cira-jīvī prasārya sat | cāturyaṁ sarva-lokeṣu tvaṁ sraṣṭevāparo bhava
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.tava sarvardhinidhayo vaśāścintāvyathādi: tava sarvardhi-nidhayo vaśāś-cintā-vyathādikāḥ | na spṛśanti kadāpi tvāṁ prasādo'yaṁ mama dhruvaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.tataḥ prasthāpayāmāsa taṁ svasthānamupet: tataḥ prasthāpayāmāsa taṁ sva-sthānam-upetya saḥ | bhūtvā gurūktavaddhyāste śrīmaṁstvaṣṭākhilaśrutaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.iti gauryai śivenoktaṁ sevātattvaṁ tvida: iti gauryai śivenoktaṁ sevā-tattvaṁ tvidaṁ guroḥ | tad-uktācaraṇaṁ bhaktyā sarva-bhāvāt-tad-arcanam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.etāvaduktvā virate gurau dvijo natvābrav: etāvad-uktvā virate gurau dvijo natvābravīd-adya vicitram-īkṣitam|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.kāśīpuraṁ vai bhavatā sahākhilaṁ yadyats: kāśī-puraṁ vai bhavatā sahākhilaṁ yad-yat-samākhyātam-avekṣitaṁ samam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.kvāhaṁ kva kāśī kva bhavāṁstathāpi vā ad: kvāhaṁ kva kāśī kva bhavāṁs-tathāpi vā adṛṣṭa-pūrvaṁ sakalaṁ pradarśitam|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.prāgbrahma tvamajo'kriyo'pi bahulaṁ syām: prāg-brahma tvam-ajo'kriyo'pi bahulaṁ syām-ity-abhūd-dhīs-tayā | sṛṣṭvaivāṇḍa-bhuvaṁ tato jagad-idaṁ sṛṣṭaṁ sadharma guṇaiḥ ||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.svaiḥ svaṁ bho ramayanvihaṁsi sadarīntrā: svaiḥ svaṁ bho ramayanvihaṁsi sadarīntrāvatīryāniśaṁ | vande śrī-nṛhare sarasvati varaṁ te śrī-padābja-dvayam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.saddharmāśramasetumatra śithilaprāyaṁ su: sad-dharmāśrama-setum-atra śithila-prāyaṁ sudāḍhyaṁ nayan| vande śrī-nṛhare sarasvati varaṁ te śrī-padābja-dvayam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.saṁsārāvaṭamagnamuddharasi bho svīkṛtya: saṁsārāvaṭa-magnam-uddharasi bho svīkṛtya turyāśramam| vande śrī-nṛhare sarasvati varaṁ te śrī-padābja-dvayam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.mūke gāṁ dṛśamandhake sutanayaṁ vandhyās: mūke gāṁ dṛśam-andhake sutanayaṁ vandhyāsu cāsūn-mṛte| saubhāgyaṁ vidhavāsu pallavam-aho dattaṁ suśuṣkendhane||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.evaṁbhūta iyāntavaiṣa mahimā trailokyasa: evaṁ-bhūta iyān-tavaiṣa mahimā trailokya-saṁsthākṣamo | vande śrī-nṛhare sarasvati varaṁ te śrī-padābja-dvayam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.muktāvāsa mumukṣukalpaviṭapin bho kāminā: muktāvāsa mumukṣu-kalpa-viṭapin bho kāmināṁ kāma-dhug | dāridrānala-megha duṣkṛta-davāgne tāpitārāma te ||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.śrutyanviṣṭarajaḥpadaṁ śrutavivādātītata: śrutyanviṣṭa-rajaḥ-padaṁ śruta-vivādātīta-tattvaṁ mahat | vande śrī-nṛhare sarasvati varaṁ te śrī-padābja-dvayam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.bho yogīśvarabhāvitaṁ tava padaṁ tīrthāś: bho yogīśvara-bhāvitaṁ tava padaṁ tīrthāśrayaṁ sajjanā-| jīvaṁ kāmi-sudaivataṁ ca kamalā-līlā-sthalaṁ nirmalam ||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.vidvadvādakaraṇḍakaṁ sukṛtasaṁsthānaṁ ma: vidvad-vāda-karaṇḍakaṁ sukṛta-saṁsthānaṁ mahat-pāvanaṁ | vande śrī-nṛhare sarasvati varaṁ te śrī-padābja-dvayam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.vedāgocara te caritramamalaṁ śakto'tra k: vedāgocara te caritram-amalaṁ śakto'tra kaḥ kṛtsnaśo | vaktuṁ vahny-ab-inendu-bhū-kha-pavanātmetīha mūrty-aṣṭakam||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.etadviśvamayaṁ na cānyadiha vā oṁkārarūp: etad-viśvamayaṁ na cānyad-iha vā oṁkāra-rūpeśitar -| vande śrī-nṛhare sarasvati varaṁ te śrī-padābja-dvayam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.kuṇḍīdaṇḍakaraṁ praśāntamamalaṁ saṁnyāsi: kuṇḍī-daṇḍa-karaṁ praśāntam-amalaṁ saṁnyāsi-rūpaṁ tava | śrī-bhīmāmarajā-yuti-sthitam-aja dhyeyaṁ śaraṇyaṁ mayi ||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.jñātaṁ tārakamīśa satyamaniśaṁ brahmanst: jñātaṁ tārakam-īśa satyam-aniśaṁ brahmansthirīkurvado | vande śrī-nṛhare sarasvati varaṁ te śrī-padābja-dvayam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.evaṁ stuvantaṁ prabhurāha te'rpitā | tuṣ: evaṁ stuvantaṁ prabhur-āha te'rpitā | tuṣṭena bhaktir-mayi khalv-ahaitukī|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.bho putrapautrādisamastavaṁśajā | bhaktā: bho putra-pautrādi-samasta-vaṁśajā | bhaktā bhaviṣyanti mamaiva niścitam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.itaḥparaṁ mlecchaniṣevaṇaṁ jahi | striyā: itaḥparaṁ mleccha-niṣevaṇaṁ jahi | striyā sutaiś-cātra sadaiva tiṣṭha bhoḥ |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.dvijo'pi gatvā gṛhamānayatstriyaṁ | sutā: dvijo'pi gatvā gṛham-ānayat-striyaṁ | sutāṁś-ca tuṣṭāva jagad-guruṁ punaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.tvaṁ vācyavācakatayeśa jaganmayo vā | oṁ: tvaṁ vācya-vācakatayeśa jaganmayo vā | oṁkāra-vācya bhagavan triguṇātmako'si|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.tapto'pi śānto'smi mukhendudarśanād | dī: tapto'pi śānto'smi mukhendu-darśanād | dīno'pi dhanyo'smi tava prasādataḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.stutvaivaṁ śrīguruṁ hṛṣṭaḥ kāranāṭakabhā: stutvaivaṁ śrī-guruṁ hṛṣṭaḥ kāranāṭaka-bhāṣayā | āvatāra-kathoddhātaṁ jagau tasya yathākramam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.bhagavāntena tuṣṭaḥ san datveṣṭaṁ varamā: bhagavān-tena tuṣṭaḥ san datveṣṭaṁ varam-āha tam | ayaṁ jyeṣṭha-suto mānyo dhanyas-te me'tivallabhaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.ityuktvā nāganāthasya mūrdhnyadhācchaṁka: ity-uktvā nāga-nāthasya mūrdhny-adhācchaṁkaraṁ karam | tadaiva gīṣpati-samo vaktā jñātā babhūva saḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.sadguruḥ prāha vipraṁ te bhāryeyaṁ subha: sad-guruḥ prāha vipraṁ te bhāryeyaṁ subhagā satī | caturaś-caturān-putrān labhet-tvam-api bhāgya-bhāk
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.snātvā svakaiḥ saha tithau bhādraśuddhac: snātvā svakaiḥ saha tithau bhādra-śuddha-caturdaśe | ananta-vratam-asty-adya tārakaṁ tattvam-ācara
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.dharmaḥ kṛṣṇopadeśena caritvā yadvrataṁ: dharmaḥ kṛṣṇopadeśena caritvā yad-vrataṁ mahat | divyaṁ saukhyaṁ sārvabhaumaṁ bhuktvāgāt-satanur-divam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.bhavāndevo'sti no'nanto bhavatsevāvrataṁ: bhavān-devo'sti no'nanto bhavat-sevā-vrataṁ param | tathāpi śrotum-icchāmi ko dharmaḥ kīdṛśaṁ vratam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.dharmo'bhūtpāṇḍavo rājā tatsadasyāṁ suyo: dharmo'bhūt-pāṇḍavo rājā tat-sadasyāṁ suyodhanaḥ | māyā-bhrāntyāpatan-mānī vrīḍito jana-hāsyataḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.jitvā dyūtamiṣāddharmaṁ hṛtatacchrīḥ sa: jitvā dyūta-miṣād-dharmaṁ hṛta-tacchrīḥ sa sānujam | vanāya prerayat-so'pi tatra gatvā suduḥkhitaḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.sa ekadāgataṁ kṛṣṇaṁ natvā sastryanujo'b: sa ekadāgataṁ kṛṣṇaṁ natvā sastry-anujo'bravīt | tvannaratrāteti birudaṁ vahanno'kaṁ na vetsi kim
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.balavaddaivamapi māṁ bhajatāṁ nekṣate sa: balavad-daivam-api māṁ bhajatāṁ nekṣate sadā | tvaṁ mad-bhakto'pi mad-vākyāt kurvanantavrataṁ mahat
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.ko'nantastadvrataṁ kīdṛk purā kena kṛtaṁ: ko'nantas-tad-vrataṁ kīdṛk purā kena kṛtaṁ vada | iti dharmānuyogaṁ sa śrutvā vaktuṁ pracakrame
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.ṛṣiḥ sumantuḥ prāgāsīd vāsiṣṭho gautamīp: ṛṣiḥ sumantuḥ prāg-āsīd vāsiṣṭho gautamī-patiḥ | tat-strīḥ kanyāṁ prasūyaikāṁ mṛtānyodvāhitāmunā
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.tatra śvaśuravātsalyāt sthitvā māsadvaya: tatra śvaśura-vātsalyāt sthitvā māsa-dvayaṁ muniḥ | śvaśrū-trasto yayau vadhvā kauṇḍiṇyaḥ śvaśurājñayā
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.madhyāhne tasthaturnadyāṁ ciraṇṭīḥ prekṣ: madhyāhne tasthatur-nadyāṁ ciraṇṭīḥ prekṣya tatra sā | gatvārcayantīḥ prāhedaṁ yuṣmābhiḥ kriyate kimu
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.bhādraśuddhacaturdaśyāmadyānantavrataṁ ś: bhādra-śuddha-caturdaśyām-adyānanta-vrataṁ śṛṇu | snātvā raktāmbaraṁ dhṛtvā rakta-sūtre caturdaśa
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.datvā caturdaśāpūpān brahmaṇe jīrṇadorak: datvā caturdaśāpūpān brahmaṇe jīrṇa-dorakam | visṛjya datvā nūtnaṁ sve badhvā haste ca dampatī
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.saṁtarpyābde ghaṭāndadyāc caturdaśa catu: saṁtarpyābde ghaṭān-dadyāc caturdaśa caturdaśe | pratyabdaṁ pūjayed bhaktyā varaṁ nātaḥ paraṁ vratam
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.tato yāntau dhanī kaścid grāmaṁ nītvā śr: tato yāntau dhanī kaścid grāmaṁ nītvā śriyaṁ dadau | tatrānanta-prasādāt-tau śrīmānāḍhyau babhūvatuḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.jaya sarveśvarānanta viśvavyāpinjanārdan: jaya sarveśvarānanta viśva-vyāpin-janārdana | tvan-māyā-mohita-dhiyā kṛtān-mantūn-kṣamasva me
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.na dainyaṁ duṣkṛtaṁ te'tra śriyaṁ bhuktv: na dainyaṁ duṣkṛtaṁ te'tra śriyaṁ bhuktvā punarvasuḥ | nakṣatreṣu prasādān-me bhaviṣyasi mahā-mune
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.ke'pi satphalitāmrasya phalaṁ nāśnanti g: ke'pi sat-phalitāmrasya phalaṁ nāśnanti gomukhe | tṛṇaṁ naiti paśoś-cāpi svādv-ap-pūrṇe sarovare
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.śiṣyānnāpāṭhayanmatto vidvāṁstenāmra īdṛ: śiṣyān-nāpāṭhayan-matto vidvāṁs-tenāmra īdṛśaḥ | gaur-jātā mogha-bhū-dānād vṛṣo'dātābhavad-dhanī
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.anyonyadānagrahaṇādīdṛśyau staḥ sarasyub: anyonya-dāna-grahaṇādīdṛśyau staḥ sarasyubhe | kharaḥ krodhībho madī ca dvijo'haṁ te'pi mocitāḥ
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.iti labdhavaro'nantaṁ natvaitya sa tathā: iti labdha-varo'nantaṁ natvaitya sa tathābhavat | tasmād-vratottamaṁ dharma vrataṁ cara hitaṁ bhavet
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.iti kṛṣṇo'bravītso'pi vrataṁ kṛtvā hatāh: iti kṛṣṇo'bravīt-so'pi vrataṁ kṛtvā hatāhitaḥ | akaṇṭakaṁ ciraṁ rājyam-ṛddhaṁ bhuktvāmṛtaṁ yayau
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.tatra sthitvā svakaiḥ sārdhaṁ pretya sāy: tatra sthitvā svakaiḥ sārdhaṁ pretya sāyujyam-āptavān | tad-vaṁśa-jā api guroḥ prasādāt-tādṛśo'bhavan
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/20_adh.tvamapīdṛktatprasādād bhaktimānasi sadgu: tvam-apīdṛk-tat-prasādād bhaktimān-asi sad-gurau | mā bhīs-tariṣyasi bhavaṁ mṛgatṛṣṇopamaṁ drutam

dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.sādhūditaṁ caritraṁ bho prabhordhanyaṁ d: sādhūditaṁ caritraṁ bho prabhor-dhanyaṁ dinaṁ tvidam | kṣaṇa-mātro'pi kālo'dya nātītas-tat-kathāmṛte ||1||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.tantuko nāma bhakto'bhūt triyāmaṁ bhagav: tantuko nāma bhakto'bhūt triyāmaṁ bhagavat-priyaḥ | saṁsāra-yātrāṁ nistīrya yāma-mātraṁ tam-ābhajat ||2||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.tadvandhutā kadācittaṁ śrīśailaṁ gantumā: tad-vandhutā kadācit-taṁ śrīśailaṁ gantum-āhvayat | sa prāha me maṭhaḥ śailaḥ śrī-gurur-mallikārjunaḥ ||3||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.sā taṁ niṣidhya mūrkho'yamiti matvā yaya: sā taṁ niṣidhya mūrkho'yam-iti matvā yayau nagam | kuto neto'sītyajena pṛṣṭo'pi prāha pūrvavat ||4||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.tato māghe'lpakālena śivarātrirupasthitā: tato māghe'lpa-kālena śivarātrir-upasthitā | madhyāhne tad-dine'jastaṁ prāha śailotsavo'dya san ||5||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.tvatpādābjotsavānmanye kvāpi nāstyadhiko: tvat-pādābjotsavān-manye kvāpi nāsty-adhikotsavaḥ | idaṁ pratyakṣam-ajñāya mudhā mugdhā bhramanti kau ||6||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.tacchutvā prāha bhagavānmā brūhīdaṁ jaga: tacchutvā prāha bhagavān-mā brūhīdaṁ jagat-prabhuḥ | sarvatrāvasthito'pyeṣa sat-kṣetra-mahimā varaḥ ||7||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.mahātapasvibhiḥ kṣetraṁ pavitrīkṛtamasti: mahā-tapasvibhiḥ kṣetraṁ pavitrīkṛtam-asti tat | paramātmā tat-prabhāvāt tatra jāgarty-anāratam ||8||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.atastatraiva bhajatāṁ kāryasiddhirbhavat: atas-tatraiva bhajatāṁ kārya-siddhir-bhavaty-aram | mahā-tapasvino dhanyāḥ svayaṁ muktā apītarān ||9||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.mocayanti svatapasā janmasaṁsārabandhanā: mocayanti sva-tapasā janma-saṁsāra-bandhanāt | lokoddhṛtyai prajāyante sat-tapasvi-vibhūtayaḥ ||10||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.ehyadya yogagatyādriṁ gatvā te darśayāmi: ehy-adya yoga-gatyādriṁ gatvā te darśayāmi tat | ity-uktvā pāduke divye dhārayitvā dṛḍhaṁ dṛśau ||12||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.nimīlayitvā śrīśailaṁ saha tena yayau kṣ: nimīlayitvā śrīśailaṁ saha tena yayau kṣaṇāt | prāhonmīlya dṛśau paśya śrīśailam-amum-ity-ajaḥ ||13||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.so'pyunmīlitadṛgdṛṣṭvā śrīgiriṁ tadanujñ: so'py-unmīlita-dṛg-dṛṣṭvā śrīgiriṁ tad-anujñayā | kṣaura-snānādi kṛtvāgād draṣṭuṁ śrī-mallikārjunam ||14||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.tasmai yathāsvaṁ sa nivedya bhakto| gurv: tasmai yathāsvaṁ sa nivedya bhakto| gurv-aṅghri-padma-dvaya eka-tānaḥ|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.tatropaviṣṭaṁ gurumarcayanti| sarve'pi k: tatropaviṣṭaṁ gurum-arcayanti| sarve'pi kaścin-na hi tatra devaḥ|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.itthaṁ vilokyāpi guruṁ prapūjya| punargu: itthaṁ vilokyāpi guruṁ prapūjya| punar-guruṁ prāpya tad-uktavān-saḥ ||17||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.atra tvamevāsi kuto'jñalokā| āyānti hitv: atra tvam-evāsi kuto'jñalokā| āyānti hitvā nikaṭa-sthitaṁ tvām |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.vyāpyākhilaṁ tvaṁ paripūrṇaviśvaṁ| daśāṅ: vyāpyākhilaṁ tvaṁ paripūrṇa-viśvaṁ| daśāṅgulaṁ tiṣṭhasi vakti vedaḥ ||18||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.ekaḥ parātmā bhajatāṁ tathāpi| sthānapra: ekaḥ parātmā bhajatāṁ tathāpi| sthāna-prabhāvaḥ priya bhinna eva |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.sthānaṁ tvidaṁ sarvajanāśrayaṁ san| mukt: sthānaṁ tvidaṁ sarva-janāśrayaṁ san| mukti-pradaṁ śṛṇviha pūrva-vṛttam ||19||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.taṁ prāha sādhvī mahiṣī kathaṁ śive | bh: taṁ prāha sādhvī mahiṣī kathaṁ śive | bhaktir-dṛḍhā dharma-viruddha-ceṣṭa te ||21||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.hanyurjanā dvāri mṛtikṣaṇe'jo | dṛṣṭo'rc: hanyur-janā dvāri mṛti-kṣaṇe'jo | dṛṣṭo'rcitaḥ projvalitāś-ca dīpāḥ ||22||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.pradakṣiṇaṁ taṁ hi parītya śaive | dine: pradakṣiṇaṁ taṁ hi parītya śaive | dine mṛtas-tena nṛpo'tra śaivaḥ|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.ye durguṇāste śvanisargajotthāḥ | syuḥ p: ye durguṇās-te śva-nisarga-jotthāḥ | syuḥ pūrva-saṁskṛty-anugo hi jīvaḥ ||23||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.prāṅme janiḥ kveti tayāha pṛṣṭaḥ| prāktv: prāṅme janiḥ kveti tayāha pṛṣṭaḥ| prāk-tvāṁ kapotīṁ sati cañcu-māṁsām|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.kveto bhavān yāsyasi cāpyahaṁ kva| śaṁse: kveto bhavān yāsyasi cāpy-ahaṁ kva| śaṁseti pṛṣṭaḥ sa tu sindhu-deśe |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.rājā bhaviṣyāmyapi sṛñjayotthā | matstrī: rājā bhaviṣyāmy-api sṛñjayotthā | mat-strī tvam-agre'pi kaliṅga-jā tvam ||25||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.saurāṣṭrake'haṁ khalu māgadhī tvaṁ | gan: saurāṣṭrake'haṁ khalu māgadhī tvaṁ | gandhārajāvanti-daśārṇajau ca|
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.nṛpo'pyananto'pi yayātijā tvaṁ | pāṇḍyo': nṛpo'py-ananto'pi yayātijā tvaṁ | pāṇḍyo'ham-agre'pi vidarbhajā tvam ||26||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.smaropamo dhīguṇaśīlaśālyahaṁ | vṛttvā t: smaropamo dhī-guṇa-śīla-śāly-ahaṁ | vṛttvā tadā tvāṁ ratibhāṁ svayaṁvare |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.tvayā saheṣṭvā purudakṣiṇānmakhān| samrā: tvayā saheṣṭvā puru-dakṣiṇān-makhān| samrāṭ-tayā prāpya sutān-subhoga-yuk ||27||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.rāḍdampatī vai pratijanma bhūtvā | mukta: rāḍ-dampatī vai pratijanma bhūtvā | muktau bhaviṣyāva iti hy-avocat ||28||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.śambhoḥ puraḥ sāhajikāsudānādevaṁ tiraśc: śambhoḥ puraḥ sāhajikāsu-dānād-evaṁ tiraśco'pi gatis-tu lokāḥ |
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.buddhvedamāyāntyapi devatā tu | sthalānu: buddhvedam-āyānty-api devatā tu | sthalānumānāt khalu jāgarūkā ||29||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.ityuktvā dhārayitveśaḥ pāduke saṅgamaṁ k: ity-uktvā dhārayitveśaḥ pāduke saṅgamaṁ kṣaṇāt | tam-ānīyerayad grāmaṁ prahṛṣṭaḥ prayayau sa tu ||30||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.tatratyāḥ saṅgame'dṛṣṭvā guruṁ khinnā av: tatratyāḥ saṅgame'dṛṣṭvā guruṁ khinnā avekṣya tam | āyāntam-abruvannāntaḥ kasmāt kṣauraṁ kṛtaṁ tvayā ||31||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.sa prāha māṁ kṣaṇānnītvā śrīśailaṁ bho y: sa prāha māṁ kṣaṇān-nītvā śrīśailaṁ bho yathāvidhi | kṣetrācāraṁ kārayitvā sampraty-atrānayat-prabhuḥ ||32||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.śrīśaile'yaṁ śivadvāri tantukaḥ sakṛdīkṣ: śrīśaile'yaṁ śiva-dvāri tantukaḥ sakṛd-īkṣitaḥ | tadā sapratyayāḥ sarve nanandur-vismitā bhṛśam ||35||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.sadguroḥ sevayā bāḍhaṁ karmabandhaṁ niha: sad-guroḥ sevayā bāḍhaṁ karma-bandhaṁ nihatya saḥ | siṣeve paramānandaṁ yatra no dvandva-sādhvasam ||36||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.ekaikayāpi bhaktyaivaṁ muktāḥ kati na ve: ekaikayāpi bhaktyaivaṁ muktāḥ kati na veda tān | kavī śiṣyāv-abhūtāṁ tau muktau śrī-guru-kīrtanāt ||37||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.gurulīlāmayāstābhyāṁ prabhūtā grathitāḥ: guru-līlā-mayās-tābhyāṁ prabhūtā grathitāḥ kathāḥ | tal-līlā vakti kaḥ kārtsnyād-yatra vedo'pi śaṅkitaḥ ||38||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.kau śiṣyau sadgurorjātau tanme kathaya s: kau śiṣyau sad-guror-jātau tanme kathaya sādaram | vaktā hi śrotṛ-pṛcchāśīḥ smṛtim-eti yataḥ kathā ||39||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.sa candaleśvarīṁ prāpya saptamāsaṁ tapo': sa candaleśvarīṁ prāpya sapta-māsaṁ tapo'tapat | tayāpy-uktaṁ yatiṁ gaccha sthitaṁ bhīmāmarāyutau ||41||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.sa prāha tāṁ gaccha martyamiti vaktuṁ na: sa prāha tāṁ gaccha martyam-iti vaktuṁ na lajjase | parīkṣitaṁ ta aiśvaryam-iyat-kaṣṭaṁ kuto'rpitam ||42||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.ityuktvā sa tapastepe bhaktairdevyā sa h: ity-uktvā sa tapas-tepe bhaktair-devyā sa hāpitaḥ | yad-dravyaṁ tad-dravatv-eva kaṣṭam-etāvad-arjitam ||43||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.devyājñayā tathaivālpaṁ saha bhogyamiti: devy-ājñayā tathaivālpaṁ saha bhogyam-iti dvijaḥ | matvā svagatam-ānamya devīṁ bhukto yayau yatim ||44||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.gandharvapuramāsādya sa yatiḥ kvetyapṛcc: gandharva-puram-āsādya sa yatiḥ kvety-apṛcchata | pāpaṁ matvārjunābhaṁ taṁ kuṣṭhinaṁ nottaraṁ daduḥ ||45||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.taṁ kaścidāha snātvāraṁ śivarātrivratasy: taṁ kaścid-āha snātvāraṁ śivarātri-vratasya ca | pāraṇāyai maṭhe deva āyāsy-atra tiṣṭha bhoḥ ||46||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.atrāntare prabhuḥ prāpa maṭhaṁ bhaktāsta: atrāntare prabhuḥ prāpa maṭhaṁ bhaktās-tam-abruvan | dvijo'rjuna-śveta-deha idānīṁ kaścid-āgataḥ ||47||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.viśvasākṣī tamāhūya prāha hitvāmarānnara: viśva-sākṣī tam-āhūya prāha hitvāmarān-naram | āyāto'si kuto'rhaḥ kiṁ doṣotthasthāsnurughatau ||48||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.tacchutvā matkṛtaṁ jñātamanenaiṣa na mān: tacchutvā mat-kṛtaṁ jñātam-anenaiṣa na mānuṣaḥ | pratyakṣaḥ paramātmeti matvoce taṁ kṣamāpya saḥ ||49||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.mūḍho'haṁ kutsitamatiḥ pāpātmā pāpasambh: mūḍho'haṁ kutsita-matiḥ pāpātmā pāpa-sambhavaḥ | śaraṇyaṁ tvāṁ prapanno'smi dayābdhiṁ bhakta-vatsalam ||50||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.nāṅgīkurvantyapi surā bhātyato'pi mṛtirv: nāṅgīkurvanty-api surā bhāty-ato'pi mṛtir-varam | parātmanā tvayā nocet-svīkṛto'tra jahāmy-asūn ||52||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.mā bhīḥ pāpottharogo'yamiyatkālamanena t: mā bhīḥ pāpottha-rogo'yam-iyat-kālam-anena tu | bhuktaṁ pāpam-ato bhaktir-mayi jātācalāmalā ||53||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.so'pyuktavat kārayitvā tamānīya guroḥ pa: so'py-uktavat kārayitvā tam-ānīya guroḥ pade | upānayattamāheśaḥ paśyottiṣṭhākhilaṁ vapuḥ ||56||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.svarṇībhūtaṁ sa tu svāṅgamutthāyodvīkṣya: svarṇībhūtaṁ sa tu svāṅgam-utthāyodvīkṣya vismitaḥ | kiñcit-kuṣṭhāṅkitāṣṭhīvad guruṁ prāñjalir-abravīt ||57||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.bhagavankiṁ kṛtaṁ tvetat kuṣṭhaṁ śiṣṭaṁ: bhagavan-kiṁ kṛtaṁ tvetat kuṣṭhaṁ śiṣṭaṁ kuto'lpakam | tacchutvā sasmitaṁ prāha tvat-saṁśaya-phalaṁ tvidam ||58||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.ityāśrāvya gurorvākyaṁ praṇipatyābravīdv: ity-āśrāvya guror-vākyaṁ praṇipatyābravīd-vacaḥ | sudhāpy-ambudhiyā pītā mṛtiṁ nayati kiṁ davaḥ ||59||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.sraṣṭā'vitvāddahatyalpaṁ svabhāvaṁ parih: sraṣṭā'vitvād-dahaty-alpaṁ svabhāvaṁ parihatya kim | hare svabhāvaḥ pūrṇatvaṁ tavānenaiti kiṁ vada ||60||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.yadbhāvo yādṛśaḥ kvāpi nānyathā syātsvad: yad-bhāvo yādṛśaḥ kvāpi nānyathā syāt-sva-doṣataḥ | grahītur-bhāty-anyathārke janmāndhasyeva śūnyatā ||61||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.martyena mama kiṁ bhūyāditi śaṅkoditā tv: martyena mama kiṁ bhūyād-iti śaṅkoditā tvayi | tat-phalaṁ tvidam-asty-ekaḥ pratīkāro'tra taṁ kuru ||62||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.śrutibṛṁhitayā siddhyeccet puruṣṭutyā tv: śruti-bṛṁhitayā siddhyec-cet puruṣṭutyā tvamartyatā | bhaviṣyaty-anayā śuddhis tvaṁ kṛtārtho bhaviṣyasi ||63||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.tacchutvā dīnavāglolatsarvāpaghana āha t: tacchutvā dīnavāglolatsarvāpaghana āha tam | svāmin sarvāntarasthas-tvaṁ kiṁ vācyaṁ te'grataḥ prabho ||64||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.lipimapyakṣamo jñātuṁ kathaṁ staumi puru: lipim-apy-akṣamo jñātuṁ kathaṁ staumi puruṣṭuta | anyat-kim-api kartuṁ māṁ yathāsvaṁ viniyojaya ||65||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.prabhuḥ prāha sakṛdvaktrān nirgataṁ na p: prabhuḥ prāha sakṛd-vaktrān nirgataṁ na punar-vacaḥ | mamāntaḥ praviśaty-eva dantāvala-radopamam ||66||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.uktameva tvayā kāryamityuktvā bhasma man: uktam-eva tvayā kāryam-ity-uktvā bhasma mantritam | prakṣipya tan-mukhe prāha stuhi nānā-vidhoktibhiḥ ||67||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.so'pi gīṣpativadbhūtvā taṁ stotumupacakr: so'pi gīṣpativad-bhūtvā taṁ stotum-upacakrame | prema-gaurava-namrāṅgo harṣa-gadgadayā girā ||68||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.sākṣāttvamasīśa tvaṁ kartā bhartāvyayo d: sākṣāt-tvam-asīśa tvaṁ kartā bhartāvyayo dhruvaḥ | tvaṁ sarvaṁ khalv-idaṁ brahmāsyātmā sākṣī jaganmayaḥ ||69||
dattatreya/dvisahasri_gurucaritra/21_adh.dhiyā guṇaistridhābhūtāt svabhedāt sattv: dhiyā guṇais-tridhābhūtāt sva-bhedāt sattva-lakṣaṇāt | bhūtāny-udbhāvya sarvātman viśvaṁ sṛṣṭaṁ carācaram ||70||
