shiva/04_shiva_kavacham.txt.dhārayasva mayā dattaṁ sadyaḥ śreyo hyav: dhārayasva mayā dattaṁ sadyaḥ śreyo hy-avāpsyasi ||
shiva/04_shiva_kavacham.txt.sa rājaputraḥ śuśubhe śaradarka iva śriy: sa rāja-putraḥ śuśubhe śarad-arka iva śriyā ||
shiva/04_shiva_kavacham.txt.tamāha prāñjaliṁ bhūyaḥ sa yogī rājanand: tamāha prāñjaliṁ bhūyaḥ sa yogī rāja-nandanam |
shiva/04_shiva_kavacham.txt.sa sadyo mriyate śatruḥ sākṣānmṛtyurapi: sa sadyo mriyate śatruḥ sākṣān-mṛtyur-api svayam ||

shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.atītaḥ panthānaṁ tava ca mahimā vāṅmanas: atītaḥ panthānaṁ tava ca mahimā vāṅ-manasayor-atad-vyāvṛttyā yaṁ cakitam-abhidhatte śrutir-api |
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.sa kasya stotavyaḥ katividhaguṇaḥ kasya: sa kasya stotavyaḥ katividha-guṇaḥ kasya viṣayaḥ
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.pade tvarvācīne patati na manaḥ kasya na: pade tv-arvācīne patati na manaḥ kasya na vacaḥ ||
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.madhusphītā vācaḥ paramamamṛtaṁ nirmitav: madhu-sphītā vācaḥ paramam-amṛtaṁ nirmitavatas-tava brahman kiṁ vāgapi sura-guror-vismaya-padam |
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.kimīhaḥ kiṁ kāyaḥ sa khalu kimupāyastrib: kim-īhaḥ kiṁ kāyaḥ sa khalu kim-upāyas-tribhuvanaṁ
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.kimādhāro dhātā sṛjati kimupādāna iti ca: kim-ādhāro dhātā sṛjati kim-upādāna iti ca |
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.ajanmāno lokāḥ kimavayavavanto'pi jagatā: ajanmāno lokāḥ kim-avayavavanto'pi jagatām-adhiṣṭhātāraṁ kiṁ bhava-vidhir-anādṛtya bhavati |
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.stuvañjihremi tvāṁ na khalu nanu dhṛṣṭā: stuvañ-jihremi tvāṁ na khalu nanu dhṛṣṭā mukharatā ||
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.svayaṁ tasthe tābhyāṁ tava kimanuvṛttirn: svayaṁ tasthe tābhyāṁ tava kim-anuvṛttir-na phalati ||
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.yadṛddhiṁ sutrāmṇo varada paramoccairapi: yad-ṛddhiṁ sutrāmṇo varada paramoccair-api satīm-adhaś-cakre bāṇaḥ parijana-vidheya-tri-bhuvanaḥ |
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.na taccitraṁ tasmin varivasitari tvaccar: na tac-citraṁ tasmin varivasitari tvac-caraṇayor-na kasyāpy-unnatyai bhavati śirasas-tvayy-avanatiḥ ||
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.sa kalmāṣaḥ kaṇṭhe tava na kurute na śri: sa kalmāṣaḥ kaṇṭhe tava na kurute na śriyam-aho
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.jagadrakṣāyai tvaṁ naṭasi nanu vāmaiva v: jagad-rakṣāyai tvaṁ naṭasi nanu vāmaiva vibhutā ||
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.pravāho vārāṁ yaḥ pṛṣatalaghudṛṣṭaḥ śira: pravāho vārāṁ yaḥ pṛṣata-laghu-dṛṣṭaḥ śirasi te |
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.jagaddvīpākāraṁ jaladhivalayaṁ tena kṛta: jagad-dvīpākāraṁ jaladhi-valayaṁ tena kṛtam-ity-anenaivonneyaṁ dhṛta-mahima divyaṁ tava vapuḥ ||
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.didhakṣoste ko'yaṁ tripuratṛṇamāḍambarav: didhakṣoste ko'yaṁ tripura-tṛṇam-āḍambara-vidhir-vidheyaiḥ krīḍantyo na khalu para-tantrāḥ prabhu-dhiyaḥ ||
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.hariste sāhasraṁ kamalabalimādhāya paday: haris-te sāhasraṁ kamala-balim-ādhāya padayor-yad-ekone tasmin nijam-udaharan-netra-kamalam |
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.śrutau śraddhāṁ baddhvā dṛḍhaparikaraḥ k: śrutau śraddhāṁ baddhvā dṛḍha-parikaraḥ karmasu janaḥ ||
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.yadi straiṇaṁ devī yamanirata dehārdhagh: yadi straiṇaṁ devī yama-nirata dehārdha-ghaṭanād-avaiti tvām-addhā bata varada mugdhā yuvatayaḥ ||
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.śmaśāneṣvākrīḍā smarahara piśācāḥ sahaca: śmaśāneṣv-ākrīḍā smara-hara piśācāḥ sahacarāś-citā-bhasmālepaḥ srag-api nṛ-karoṭī-parikaraḥ |
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.tvamarkastvaṁ somastvamasi pavanastvaṁ h: tvam-arkas-tvaṁ somas-tvam-asi pavanas-tvaṁ hutavahas-tvam-āpas-tvaṁ vyoma tvamu dharaṇir-ātmā tvam-iti ca |
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.na vidmastattattvaṁ vayamiha tu yattvaṁ: na vidmas-tat-tattvaṁ vayam-iha tu yat-tvaṁ na bhavasi ||
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.samastaṁ vyastaṁ tvāṁ śaraṇada gṛṇātyomi: samastaṁ vyastaṁ tvāṁ śaraṇada gṛṇāty-om-iti padam ||
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.bhavaḥ śarvo rudraḥ paśupatirathograḥ sa: bhavaḥ śarvo rudraḥ paśupatir-athograḥ sahamahāṁstathā bhīmeśānāv-iti yad-abhidhānāṣṭakam-idam |
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.namaḥ kṣodiṣṭhāya smarahara mahiṣṭhāya c: namaḥ kṣodiṣṭhāya smara-hara mahiṣṭhāya ca namaḥ |
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.namaḥ sarvasmai te tadidamiti śarvāya ca: namaḥ sarvasmai te tad-idam-iti śarvāya ca namaḥ ||
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.iti cakitamamandīkṛtya māṁ bhaktirādhādv: iti cakitam-amandīkṛtya māṁ bhaktirādhādvarada caraṇayos-te vākya-puṣpopahāram ||
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.tadapi tava guṇānāmīśa pāraṁ na yāti ||: tadapi tava guṇānām-īśa pāraṁ na yāti ||
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.aghorānnāparo mantro nāsti tattvaṁ guroḥ: aghorān-nāparo mantro nāsti tattvaṁ guroḥ param ||
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.dīkṣā dānaṁ tapastīrthaṁ jñānaṁ yāgādikā: dīkṣā dānaṁ tapas-tīrthaṁ jñānaṁ yāgādikāḥ kriyāḥ |
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.sa khalu nijamahimno bhraṣṭa evāsya roṣā: sa khalu nija-mahimno bhraṣṭa evāsya roṣāt
shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.ekakālaṁ dvikālaṁ vā trikālaṁ yaḥ paṭhen: eka-kālaṁ dvi-kālaṁ vā trikālaṁ yaḥ paṭhen-naraḥ |

shiva/06_shiva_tandava_stotram.txt.cakāra caṇḍatāṇḍavaṁ tanotu naḥ śivaḥ śi: cakāra caṇḍa-tāṇḍavaṁ tanotu naḥ śivaḥ śivam ||
shiva/06_shiva_tandava_stotram.txt.hare gurau subhaktimāśu yāti nānyathā ga: hare gurau subhaktim-āśu yāti nānyathā gatiṁ

shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.na manye svapne vā tadanusaraṇaṁ tatkṛta: na manye svapne vā tad-anusaraṇaṁ tat-kṛta-phalam |
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.ciraṁ yāce śambho śiva tava padāmbhojabh: ciraṁ yāce śambho śiva tava padāmbhoja-bhajanam ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.kathaṁ rājñāṁ prītirbhavati mayi ko'haṁ: kathaṁ rājñāṁ prītir-bhavati mayi ko'haṁ paśupate
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.paṭo vā tanturvā pariharati kiṁ ghoraśam: paṭo vā tantur-vā pariharati kiṁ ghora-śamanam |
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.viśāle śaile ca bhramati kusumārthaṁ jaḍ: viśāle śaile ca bhramati kusumārthaṁ jaḍa-matiḥ |
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.vaṭurvā gehī vā yatirapi jaṭī vā taditar: vaṭur-vā gehī vā yatir-api jaṭī vā tad-itaro
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.naro vā yaḥ kaścidbhavatu bhava kiṁ tena: naro vā yaḥ kaścid-bhavatu bhava kiṁ tena bhavati |
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.tadīyastvaṁ śambho bhavasi bhavabhāraṁ c: tadīyas-tvaṁ śambho bhavasi bhava-bhāraṁ ca vahasi ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.guhāyāṁ gehe vā bahirapi vane vā'driśikh: guhāyāṁ gehe vā bahir-api vane vā'dri-śikhare
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.sthitaṁ cedyogo'sau sa ca paramayogī sa: sthitaṁ ced-yogo'sau sa ca parama-yogī sa ca sukhī ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.upekṣā no cetkiṁ na harasi bhavaddhyānav: upekṣā no cetkiṁ na harasi bhavad-dhyāna-vimukhāṁ
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.phalādvā puṇyānāṁ mayi karuṇayā vā tvayi: phalād-vā puṇyānāṁ mayi karuṇayā vā tvayi vibho
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.kiyadvā dākṣiṇyaṁ tava śiva madāśā ca ki: kiyad-vā dākṣiṇyaṁ tava śiva madāśā ca kiyatī
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.vadeyaṁ prītiścettava śiva kṛtārthāḥ kha: vadeyaṁ prītiś-cet-tava śiva kṛtārthāḥ khalu vayam ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.dṛḍhaṁ bhaktyā baddhvā śiva bhavadadhīna: dṛḍhaṁ bhaktyā baddhvā śiva bhavad-adhīnaṁ kuru vibho ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.imaṁ cetaścoraṁ kathamiha sahe śaṅkara v: imaṁ cetaś-coraṁ katham-iha sahe śaṅkara vibho
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.karomi tvatpūjāṁ sapadi sukhado me bhava: karomi tvat-pūjāṁ sapadi sukhado me bhava vibho
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.vidhitvaṁ viṣṇutvaṁ diśasi khalu tasyāḥ: vidhitvaṁ viṣṇutvaṁ diśasi khalu tasyāḥ phalam-iti |
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.kadā vā tvāṁ dṛṣṭvā giriśa tava bhavyāṅg: kadā vā tvāṁ dṛṣṭvā giriśa tava bhavyāṅghri-yugalaṁ
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.kamarthaṁ dāsye'haṁ bhavatu bhavadarthaṁ: kam-arthaṁ dāsye'haṁ bhavatu bhavad-arthaṁ mama manaḥ ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.sāyujyaṁ mama siddhamatra bhavati svāmin: sāyujyaṁ mama siddham-atra bhavati svāmin kṛtārtho'smy-aham ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.tvāmīśaṁ śaraṇaṁ vrajāmi vacasā tvāmeva: tvām-īśaṁ śaraṇaṁ vrajāmi vacasā tvām-eva yāce vibho |
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.vīkṣāṁ me diśa cākṣuṣīṁ sakaruṇāṁ divyai: vīkṣāṁ me diśa cākṣuṣīṁ sakaruṇāṁ divyaiś-ciraṁ prārthitāṁ
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.nālaṁ vā paramopakārakamidaṁ tvekaṁ paśū: nālaṁ vā paramopakārakam-idaṁ tvekaṁ paśūnāṁ pate
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.nikṣiptaṁ garalaṁ gale na gilitaṁ nodgīr: nikṣiptaṁ garalaṁ gale na gilitaṁ nodgīrṇam-eva tvayā ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.jvālograḥ sakalāmarātibhayadaḥ kṣvelaḥ k: jvālograḥ sakalāmarāti-bhaya-daḥ kṣvelaḥ kathaṁ vā tvayā
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.dṛṣṭaḥ kiṁ ca kare dhṛtaḥ karatale kiṁ p: dṛṣṭaḥ kiṁ ca kare dhṛtaḥ kara-tale kiṁ pakva-jambū-phalam |
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.jihvāyāṁ nihitaśca siddhaghuṭikā vā kaṇṭ: jihvāyāṁ nihitaś-ca siddha-ghuṭikā vā kaṇṭha-deśe bhṛtaḥ
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.kiṁ te nīlamaṇirvibhūṣaṇamayaṁ śambho ma: kiṁ te nīla-maṇir-vibhūṣaṇa-mayaṁ śambho mahātman vada ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.nālaṁ vā sakṛdeva deva bhavataḥ sevā nat: nālaṁ vā sakṛd-eva deva bhavataḥ sevā natir-vā nutiḥ
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.kā vā muktiritaḥ kuto bhavati cetkiṁ prā: kā vā muktir-itaḥ kuto bhavati cetkiṁ prārthanīyaṁ tadā ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.śambho tvaṁ paramāntaraṅga iti me citte: śambho tvaṁ paramāntaraṅga iti me citte smarāmy-anvaham ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.dharmo me caturaṅghrikaḥ sucaritaḥ pāpaṁ: dharmo me catur-aṅghrikaḥ sucaritaḥ pāpaṁ vināśaṁ gataṁ
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.mā gaccha tvamitastato giriśa bho mayyev: mā gaccha tvam-itas-tato giriśa bho mayy-eva vāsaṁ kuru
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.śambho vāñchati nīlakandhara sadā tvāṁ m: śambho vāñchati nīla-kandhara sadā tvāṁ me manaś-cātakaḥ ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.śyāmāṁ śailasamudbhavāṁ ghanaruciṁ dṛṣṭv: śyāmāṁ śaila-samudbhavāṁ ghana-ruciṁ dṛṣṭvā naṭantaṁ mudā
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.haṁsaḥ padmavanaṁ samicchati yathā nīlām: haṁsaḥ padma-vanaṁ samicchati yathā nīlāmbudaṁ cātakaḥ
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.ceto vāñchati māmakaṁ paśupate cinmārgam: ceto vāñchati māmakaṁ paśupate cin-mārga-mṛgyaṁ vibho
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.cetaḥ sarvabhayāpahaṁ vraja sukhaṁ śambh: cetaḥ sarva-bhayāpahaṁ vraja sukhaṁ śambhoḥ padāmbhoruham ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.sādhvī naijavibhuṁ latā kṣitiruhaṁ sindh: sādhvī naija-vibhuṁ latā kṣitiruhaṁ sindhuḥ sarid-vallabham |
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.bhaktiḥ kiṁ na karotyaho vanacaro bhaktā: bhaktiḥ kiṁ na karoty-aho vana-caro bhaktāvataṁsāyate ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.yatkarmācaritaṁ mayā ca bhavataḥ prītyai: yat-karmācaritaṁ mayā ca bhavataḥ prītyai bhavaty-eva tat |
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.śambho svasya kutūhalasya karaṇaṁ macceṣ: śambho svasya kutūhalasya karaṇaṁ mac-ceṣṭitaṁ niścitaṁ
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.ye pādapadmamiha te śiva te kṛtārthāḥ ||: ye pāda-padmam-iha te śiva te kṛtārthāḥ ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.prāyaḥ satsu śilātaleṣu naṭanaṁ śambho k: prāyaḥ satsu śilā-taleṣu naṭanaṁ śambho kim-arthaṁ tava ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.yaḥ prāpnoti mudā tvadarpitamanā jīvan s: yaḥ prāpnoti mudā tvad-arpita-manā jīvan sa muktaḥ khalu ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.ghoṇitvaṁ sakhitā mṛdaṅgavahatā cetyādi: ghoṇitvaṁ sakhitā mṛdaṅga-vahatā cetyādi rūpaṁ dadhau |
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.pūjyātpūjyataraḥ sa eva hi na cetko vā t: pūjyāt-pūjyataraḥ sa eva hi na cetko vā tad-anyo'dhikaḥ ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.na bhavati sukhaleśaḥ saṁśayo nāsti tatr: na bhavati sukha-leśaḥ saṁśayo nāsti tatra |
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.ya iha paramasaukhyaṁ te hi dhanyā labha: ya iha parama-saukhyaṁ te hi dhanyā labhante ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.na ca vanamṛgayāyāṁ naiva lubdhaḥ pravīṇ: na ca vana-mṛgayāyāṁ naiva lubdhaḥ pravīṇaḥ |
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.pakṣitvaṁ na ca vā kiṭitvamapi na prāpta: pakṣitvaṁ na ca vā kiṭitvam-api na prāptaṁ mayā durlabham |
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.na jñātaṁ hi pitāmahena hariṇā tattvena: na jñātaṁ hi pitāmahena hariṇā tattvena tad-rūpiṇā ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.kalyāṇīṁ deva gaurīpriya mama kavitākany: kalyāṇīṁ deva gaurī-priya mama kavitā-kanyakāṁ tvaṁ gṛhāṇa ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.idaṁ te yuktaṁ vā paramaśiva kāruṇyajala: idaṁ te yuktaṁ vā paramaśiva kāruṇya-jaladhe
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.haribrahmāṇau tau divi bhuvi carantau śr: hari-brahmāṇau tau divi bhuvi carantau śrama-yutau
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.kathaṁ śambho svāminkathaya mama vedyo's: kathaṁ śambho svāmin-kathaya mama vedyo'si purataḥ ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.stotreṇālamahaṁ pravacmi na mṛṣā devā vi: stotreṇālam-ahaṁ pravacmi na mṛṣā devā viriñcādayaḥ

shiva/08_shiva_raksha_stotram.txt.asya śrī śivarakṣāstotramantrasya yājñav: asya śrī śiva-rakṣā-stotra-mantrasya yājñavalkya ṛṣiḥ | śrī sadāśivo devatā | anuṣṭup chandaḥ | śrī sadāśiva-prītyarthaṁ śiva-rakṣā-stotra-jape viniyogaḥ ||
shiva/08_shiva_raksha_stotram.txt.ghrāṇaṁ pātu purārātiḥ mukhaṁ pātu jagat: ghrāṇaṁ pātu purārātiḥ mukhaṁ pātu jagat-patiḥ |
shiva/08_shiva_raksha_stotram.txt.śrīkaṇṭhaḥ pātu me kaṇṭhaṁ skandhau viśv: śrīkaṇṭhaḥ pātu me kaṇṭhaṁ skandhau viśva-dhurandharaḥ |
shiva/08_shiva_raksha_stotram.txt.jaṅghe pātu jagatkartā gulphau pātu gaṇā: jaṅghe pātu jagat-kartā gulphau pātu gaṇādhipaḥ |
shiva/08_shiva_raksha_stotram.txt.etāṁ śivabalopetāṁ rakṣāṁ yaḥ sukṛtī paṭ: etāṁ śiva-balopetāṁ rakṣāṁ yaḥ sukṛtī paṭhet |
shiva/08_shiva_raksha_stotram.txt.bhaktyā bibharti yaḥ kaṇṭhe tasya vaśyaṁ: bhaktyā bibharti yaḥ kaṇṭhe tasya vaśyaṁ jagat-trayam ||

shiva/10_natarajashtakam.txt.nāsti punarjaniretī ca dhāma sa śāmbhava: nāsti punarjanir-etī ca dhāma sa śāmbhavam-uttama-modakaram ||

shiva/11_dakshinamurthy_ashtakam.txt.jñānaṁ yasya tu cakṣurādikaraṇadvārā bah: jñānaṁ yasya tu cakṣur-ādi-karaṇa-dvārā bahiḥ spandate |
shiva/11_dakshinamurthy_ashtakam.txt.dehaṁ prāṇamapīndriyāṇyapi calāṁ buddhiṁ: dehaṁ prāṇam-apīndriyāṇy-api calāṁ buddhiṁ ca śūnyaṁ viduḥ

shiva/12_shiva_shadakshara_stotram.txt.kāmadaṁ mokṣadaṁ caiva oṅkārāya namo nam: kāma-daṁ mokṣa-daṁ caiva oṅkārāya namo namaḥ ||
shiva/12_shiva_shadakshara_stotram.txt.vāme śaktidharaṁ devaṁ vakārāya namo nam: vāme śakti-dharaṁ devaṁ vakārāya namo namaḥ ||
shiva/12_shiva_shadakshara_stotram.txt.yatra yatra sthito devaḥ sarvavyāpī mahe: yatra yatra sthito devaḥ sarva-vyāpī maheśvaraḥ |
shiva/12_shiva_shadakshara_stotram.txt.yo guruḥ sarvadevānāṁ yakārāya namo nama: yo guruḥ sarva-devānāṁ yakārāya namo namaḥ ||

shiva/13_shri_gangadhara_stotram.txt.kṣīraṁ svādu nipīya mātulagṛhe gatvā sva: kṣīraṁ svādu nipīya mātula-gṛhe gatvā svakīyaṁ gṛhaṁ
shiva/13_shri_gangadhara_stotram.txt.ārtatrāṇaparāyaṇaḥ sa bhagavān gaṅgādhar: ārta-trāṇa-parāyaṇaḥ sa bhagavān gaṅgādharo me gatiḥ ||
shiva/13_shri_gangadhara_stotram.txt.khidyantaṁ tava mūrdhni puṣpanicayaṁ dāt: khidyantaṁ tava mūrdhni puṣpa-nicayaṁ dātuṁ samudyat-karam |
shiva/13_shri_gangadhara_stotram.txt.santrasteṣu purā surāsurabhayādindrādibṛ: santrasteṣu purā surāsurabhayādindrādibṛndārake-'śvārūḍho dharaṇī-ratham śruti-hayam kṛtvā murāriṁ śaram |
shiva/13_shri_gangadhara_stotram.txt.rakṣan yaḥ kṛpayā samastavibudhān jitvā: rakṣan yaḥ kṛpayā samasta-vibudhān jitvā purārīn kṣaṇāt
shiva/13_shri_gangadhara_stotram.txt.gāṅgaṁ vegamavāpya mānyavibudhaiḥ soḍhuṁ: gāṅgaṁ vegam-avāpya mānya-vibudhaiḥ soḍhuṁ purā yācito

shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.ādau karma prasaṅgātkalayati kaluṣaṁ māt: ādau karma prasaṅgāt-kalayati kaluṣaṁ mātṛ-kukṣau sthitaṁ māṁ
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.yadyadvai tatra duḥkhaṁ vyathayati nitar: yad-yad-vai tatra duḥkhaṁ vyathayati nitarāṁ śakyate kena vaktuṁ
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.kṣantavyo me'parādhaḥ śiva śiva śiva bho: kṣantavyo me'parādhaḥ śiva śiva śiva bhoḥ śrī-mahādeva śambho ||
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.no liptaṁ candanādyaiḥ kanakaviracitaiḥ: no liptaṁ candanādyaiḥ kanaka-viracitaiḥ pūjitaṁ na prasūnaiḥ |
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.śraute vārtā kathaṁ me dvijakulavihite b: śraute vārtā kathaṁ me dvija-kula-vihite brahma-mārgānusāre |
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.dhyātvā citte śivākhyaṁ pracurataradhana: dhyātvā citte śivākhyaṁ pracuratara-dhanaṁ naiva dattaṁ dvijebhyo
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.no taptaṁ gāṅgatīre vratajapaniyamaiḥ ru: no taptaṁ gāṅga-tīre vrata-japa-niyamaiḥ rudra-jāpyaṁ na japtaṁ
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.unmanyāvasthayā tvāṁ vigatagatimatiḥ śaṅ: unmanyāvasthayā tvāṁ vigata-gati-matiḥ śaṅkaraṁ na smarāmi
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.śānte svānte pralīne prakaṭitavibhave di: śānte svānte pralīne prakaṭita-vibhave divya-rūpe śivākhye |
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.liṅgāgre brahmavākye sakalatanugataṁ śaṅ: liṅgāgre brahma-vākye sakala-tanu-gataṁ śaṅkaraṁ na smarāmi
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.jāgratsvapne suṣuptau triguṇavirahitaṁ ś: jāgrat-svapne suṣuptau triguṇa-virahitaṁ śaṅkaraṁ na smarāmi
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.mokṣārthaṁ kuru citta vṛttimamalāmanyais: mokṣārthaṁ kuru citta vṛttim-amalām-anyais-tu kiṁ karmabhiḥ ||
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.kiṁ yānena dhanena vājikaribhiḥ prāptena: kiṁ yānena dhanena vāji-karibhiḥ prāptena rājyena kiṁ
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.jñātvaitatkṣaṇabhaṅguraṁ sapadi re tyājy: jñātvaitat-kṣaṇa-bhaṅguraṁ sapadi re tyājyaṁ mano dūrataḥ
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.āyurnaśyati paśyatāṁ pratidinaṁ yāti kṣa: āyur-naśyati paśyatāṁ pratidinaṁ yāti kṣayaṁ yauvanaṁ
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.pratyāyānti gatāḥ punarna divasāḥ kālo j: pratyāyānti gatāḥ punar-na divasāḥ kālo jagad-bhakṣakaḥ |
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.tasmānmāṁ śaraṇāgataṁ karuṇayā tvaṁ rakṣ: tasmān-māṁ śaraṇāgataṁ karuṇayā tvaṁ rakṣa rakṣādhunā ||
shiva/15_shivaparadha_kshamapana_stotram.iti śrīmatparamahaṁsaparivrājakācāryasya: iti śrīmat-paramahaṁsa-parivrājakācāryasya śrī-govinda-bhagavat-pūjyapāda-śiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkara-bhagavataḥ kṛtau śrī śivāparādha-kṣamāpaṇa stotram sampūrṇam ||

shiva/16_dwadasha_jyotirlinga_stotram.tx.bhaktapradānāya kṛpāvatīrṇaṁ taṁ somanāt: bhakta-pradānāya kṛpāvatīrṇaṁ taṁ somanāthaṁ śaraṇaṁ prapadye ||
shiva/16_dwadasha_jyotirlinga_stotram.tx.pūrvottare prajvalikānidhāne sadā vasaṁ: pūrvottare prajvalikā-nidhāne sadā vasaṁ taṁ girijā-sametam |
shiva/16_dwadasha_jyotirlinga_stotram.tx.sadaiva bhīmādipadaprasiddhaṁ taṁ śaṅkar: sadaiva bhīmādi-pada-prasiddhaṁ taṁ śaṅkaraṁ bhakta-hitaṁ namāmi ||
shiva/16_dwadasha_jyotirlinga_stotram.tx.śrīrāmacandreṇa samarpitaṁ taṁ rāmeśvarā: śrī-rāmacandreṇa samarpitaṁ taṁ rāmeśvarākhyaṁ niyataṁ namāmi ||
shiva/16_dwadasha_jyotirlinga_stotram.tx.yāmye sadaṅge nagare'tiramye vibhūṣitāṅg: yāmye sadaṅge nagare'tiramye vibhūṣitāṅgaṁ vividhaiś-ca bhogaiḥ |
shiva/16_dwadasha_jyotirlinga_stotram.tx.yaddarśanāt pātakaṁ pāśu nāśaṁ prayāti t: yad-darśanāt pātakaṁ pāśu nāśaṁ prayāti taṁ tryambakam-īśam-īḍe ||
shiva/16_dwadasha_jyotirlinga_stotram.tx.mahādripārśve ca taṭe ramantaṁ sampūjyam: mahādri-pārśve ca taṭe ramantaṁ sampūjyamānaṁ satataṁ munīndraiḥ |
shiva/16_dwadasha_jyotirlinga_stotram.tx.stotraṁ paṭhitvā manujo'tibhaktyā phalaṁ: stotraṁ paṭhitvā manujo'tibhaktyā phalaṁ tad-ālokya nijaṁ bhajec-ca ||

shiva/19_vedasara_shiva_stotram.txt.na bhūmirna cāpo na vahnirna vāyurna cāk: na bhūmir-na cāpo na vahnir-na vāyur-na cākāśam-āste na tandrā na nidrā |
shiva/19_vedasara_shiva_stotram.txt.tvadanyo vareṇyo na mānyo na gaṇyaḥ ||: tvad-anyo vareṇyo na mānyo na gaṇyaḥ ||
shiva/19_vedasara_shiva_stotram.txt.kāśīpate karuṇayā jagadetadekastvaṁ haṁs: kāśī-pate karuṇayā jagad-etad-ekas-tvaṁ haṁsi pāsi vidadhāsi maheśvaro'si ||
shiva/19_vedasara_shiva_stotram.txt.iti śrīmatparamahaṁsa parivrājakācārya ś: iti śrīmat-paramahaṁsa parivrājakācārya śrīmacchaṅkarācārya viracitaṁ veda-sāra śiva stotraṁ sampūrṇam |

shiva/23_pashupatyashtakam.txt.na tanayo na ca bhūribalaṁ kulam |: na tanayo na ca bhūri-balaṁ kulam |

shiva/24_pradoshastotrashtakam.txt.etatkathāṁ śrutipuṭairna pibanti mūḍhāst: etat-kathāṁ śruti-puṭair-na pibanti mūḍhās-te janma-janmasu bhavanti narā daridrāḥ ||
shiva/24_pradoshastotrashtakam.txt.vāgdevī dhṛtavallakī śatamakho veṇuṁ dad: vāgdevī dhṛta-vallakī śatamakho veṇuṁ dadhat-padmajas-tālonnidra-karo ramā bhagavatī geya-prayogānvitā |
shiva/24_pradoshastotrashtakam.txt.iti śrīskāndapurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe tṛtīye: iti śrī-skānda-purāṇe brahma-khaṇḍe tṛtīye brahmottara-khaṇḍe ṣaṣṭho'dhyāye śāṇḍilya kṛta pradoṣa-stotrāṣṭakam |

shiva/25_shiva_namavalyashtakam.txt.iti śrīmatparamahaṁsaparivrājakācāryasya: iti śrīmat-paramahaṁsa-parivrājakācāryasya śrī-govinda-bhagavat-pūjyapāda-śiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkara-bhagavataḥ kṛtau śrī-śiva-nāmāvaly-aṣṭakaṁ sampūrṇam ||

shiva/26_maheshwara_pancharatna_stotram..iti śrīmacchaṅkarācārya kṛtaṁ maheśvara: iti śrīmacchaṅkarācārya kṛtaṁ maheśvara pañca-ratna stotram |

shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.na śakyaṁ vistarātkṛtsnaṁ vaktuṁ sarvasy: na śakyaṁ vistarāt-kṛtsnaṁ vaktuṁ sarvasya kenacit |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.aprāpya tu tato'nujñāṁ na śakyaḥ stotumī: aprāpya tu tato'nujñāṁ na śakyaḥ stotum-īśvaraḥ |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.śṛṇu nāmnāṁ cayaṁ kṛṣṇa yaduktaṁ padmayo: śṛṇu nāmnāṁ cayaṁ kṛṣṇa yad-uktaṁ padma-yoninā ||
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.gireḥ sāraṁ yathā hema puṣpasāraṁ yathā: gireḥ sāraṁ yathā hema puṣpa-sāraṁ yathā madhu |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.sa kṛṣṇa narakaṁ yāti sahapūrvaiḥ sahātm: sa kṛṣṇa narakaṁ yāti saha-pūrvaiḥ sahātmajaiḥ ||
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.dāntānāmapi yo dānto dhīmatāmapi yā ca d: dāntānām-api yo dānto dhīmatām-api yā ca dhīḥ |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.yajñānāmapi yo yajñaḥ śivānāmapi yaḥ śiv: yajñānām-api yo yajñaḥ śivānām-api yaḥ śivaḥ |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.yogināmapi yo yogī kāraṇānāṁ ca kāraṇam: yoginām-api yo yogī kāraṇānāṁ ca kāraṇam |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.aṣṭottarasahasraṁ tu nāmnāṁ śarvasya me: aṣṭottara-sahasraṁ tu nāmnāṁ śarvasya me śṛṇu |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.jaṭī carmī śikhī khaḍgī sarvāṅgaḥ sarvab: jaṭī carmī śikhī khaḍgī sarvāṅgaḥ sarva-bhāvanaḥ |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.dīrghaśca harikeśaśca sutīrthaḥ kṛṣṇa ev: dīrghaś-ca harikeśaś-ca sutīrthaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.ghoro mahātapāḥ pāśo nityo giriruho nabh: ghoro mahā-tapāḥ pāśo nityo giri-ruho nabhaḥ |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.bhagahārī nihantā ca kālo brahmā pitāmah: bhaga-hārī nihantā ca kālo brahmā pitāmahaḥ ||
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.dambho hyadambho vaidambho vaśyo vaśakar: dambho hy-adambho vaidambho vaśyo vaśa-karaḥ kaliḥ |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.akṣaraṁ paramaṁ brahma balavacchakra eva: akṣaraṁ paramaṁ brahma balavac-chakra eva ca |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.dhātā śakraśca viṣṇuśca mitrastvaṣṭā dhr: dhātā śakraś-ca viṣṇuś-ca mitras-tvaṣṭā dhruvo dharaḥ ||
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.kalā kāṣṭhā lavā mātrā muhūrtāhaḥkṣapāḥ: kalā kāṣṭhā lavā mātrā muhūrtāhaḥ-kṣapāḥ kṣaṇāḥ |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.guhaḥ kānto nijaḥ sargaḥ pavitraṁ sarvap: guhaḥ kānto nijaḥ sargaḥ pavitraṁ sarva-pāvanaḥ |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.gīyate ca sa buddhyeta brahmā śaṅkarasan: gīyate ca sa buddhyeta brahmā śaṅkara-sannidhau ||
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.idaṁ puṇyaṁ pavitraṁ ca sarvadā pāpanāśa: idaṁ puṇyaṁ pavitraṁ ca sarvadā pāpa-nāśanam |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.yogadaṁ mokṣadaṁ caiva svargadaṁ toṣadaṁ: yogadaṁ mokṣa-daṁ caiva svargadaṁ toṣadaṁ tathā ||
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.yā gatiḥ sāṅkhyayogānāṁ vrajantyetāṁ gat: yā gatiḥ sāṅkhya-yogānāṁ vrajanty-etāṁ gatiṁ tadā ||

shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.kurudvayaṁ tataḥ paścād baṭukāya punaḥ k: kuru-dvayaṁ tataḥ paścād baṭukāya punaḥ kṣipet |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.na dāridryaṁ na daurbhāgyaṁ nāpadāṁ bhay: na dāridryaṁ na daurbhāgyaṁ nāpadāṁ bhayam-eva ca || 15 ||
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.ka eṣa bhairavo nāma āpaduddhāraṇo mataḥ: ka eṣa bhairavo nāma āpad-uddhāraṇo mataḥ |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.tvayā ca kathito deva bhairavaḥ kalpavit: tvayā ca kathito deva bhairavaḥ kalpa-vittamaḥ || 16 ||
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.anādināthaṁ saumye ca śaktihastaṁ gale n: anādi-nāthaṁ saumye ca śakti-hastaṁ gale nyaset |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.udare ca sadā tuṣṭaṁ kṣetreśaṁ pārśvayos: udare ca sadā tuṣṭaṁ kṣetreśaṁ pārśvayos-tathā |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.dhyānaṁ tasya pravakṣyāmi yathā dhyātvā: dhyānaṁ tasya pravakṣyāmi yathā dhyātvā paṭhen-naraḥ |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.smerāsyaṁ varadaṁ kapālamabhayaṁ śūlaṁ d: smerāsyaṁ varadaṁ kapālam-abhayaṁ śūlaṁ dadhānaṁ karaiḥ |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.digvastraṁ piṅgakeśaṁ ḍamarumatha sṛṇiṁ: dig-vastraṁ piṅga-keśaṁ ḍamarum-atha sṛṇiṁ śūla-khaḍgau dadhānam |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.asya śrībaṭukabhairavanāmāṣṭaśatakāpadud: asya śrī-baṭuka-bhairava-nāmāṣṭa-śatakāpad-uddhāraṇa-stotra-mantrasya bṛhadāraṇyaka ṛṣiḥ, śrī-baṭuka-bhairavo devatā, anuṣṭup chandaḥ, hrīṁ bījam, baṭukāyeti śaktiḥ, praṇavaḥ kīlakam, abhīṣṭa-siddhy-arthe pāṭhe jape viniyogaḥ |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.hāṁ vām aṅguṣṭhābhyāṁ namaḥ | hrīṁ vīṁ t: hāṁ vām aṅguṣṭhābhyāṁ namaḥ | hrīṁ vīṁ tarjanībhyāṁ svāhā | hūṁ vūṁ madhyamābhyāṁ vaṣaṭ | haiṁ vaiṁ anāmikābhyāṁ hum | hauṁ vauṁ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṁ vauṣaṭ | haḥ vaḥ kara-tala-kara-pṛṣṭhābhyāṁ phaṭ |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.hāṁ vāṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ | hrīṁ vīṁ śirase: hāṁ vāṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ | hrīṁ vīṁ śirase svāhā | hūṁ vūṁ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | haiṁ vaiṁ kavacāya hum | hauṁ vauṁ netra-trayāya vauṣaṭ | haḥ vaḥ astrāya phaṭ |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.śūlaṁ khaḍgaṁ ca vajraṁ paraśumusalake d: śūlaṁ khaḍgaṁ ca vajraṁ paraśu-musalake dakṣiṇāṅge vahantam |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.nāgaṁ pāśaṁ ca ghaṇṭāṁ nalinakarayutaṁ s: nāgaṁ pāśaṁ ca ghaṇṭāṁ nalina-kara-yutaṁ sāṅkuśaṁ vāma-bhāge
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.na tasya duritaṁ kiñcinna ca bhūtabhayaṁ: na tasya duritaṁ kiñcin-na ca bhūta-bhayaṁ tathā |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.na ca mārībhayaṁ tasya graharājabhayaṁ t: na ca mārī-bhayaṁ tasya graha-rāja-bhayaṁ tathā || 16 ||
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.bhīto bhayātpramucyeta devi sadyo na saṁ: bhīto bhayāt-pramucyeta devi sadyo na saṁśayaḥ |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.aprakāśyamidaṁ guhyaṁ na deyaṁ yasya kas: aprakāśyam-idaṁ guhyaṁ na deyaṁ yasya kasyacit |

shiva/32_harihara_ashtottarashatanama_st.kuryādimāṁ srajamaho sa yamaṁ na paśyet: kuryād-imāṁ srajam-aho sa yamaṁ na paśyet || 11 ||
shiva/32_harihara_ashtottarashatanama_st.nityaṁ japet stanarasaṁ sa pibenna mātuḥ: nityaṁ japet stana-rasaṁ sa piben-na mātuḥ || 12 ||
shiva/32_harihara_ashtottarashatanama_st.|| iti śrīskandamahāpurāṇe kāśīkhaṇḍapūr: || iti śrī-skanda-mahā-purāṇe kāśī-khaṇḍa-pūrvārdhe yama-proktaṁ śrī-hariharāṣṭottara-śata-nāma-stotraṁ sampūrṇam ||

venkateswara/03_venkateswara_prapatti.tx.syāṁ kiṅkaro vṛṣagirīśa na jātu mahyam |: syāṁ kiṅkaro vṛṣa-girīśa na jātu mahyam ||

venkateswara/05_venkateswara_vajrakavach.prāṇeśaḥ prāṇanilayaḥ prāṇān rakṣatu me: prāṇeśaḥ prāṇa-nilayaḥ prāṇān rakṣatu me hariḥ ||
venkateswara/05_venkateswara_vajrakavach.sāyaṁ prātaḥ paṭhennityaṁ mṛtyuṁ tarati: sāyaṁ prātaḥ paṭhen-nityaṁ mṛtyuṁ tarati nirbhayaḥ ||
venkateswara/05_venkateswara_vajrakavach.iti mārkaṇḍeya kṛta śrī veṅkaṭeśvara vaj: iti mārkaṇḍeya kṛta śrī veṅkaṭeśvara vajra-kavaca stotram |

venkateswara/07_venkatesha_ashtakam.txt.trikāle yaḥ paṭhennityaṁ pāpaṁ tasya na: trikāle yaḥ paṭhen-nityaṁ pāpaṁ tasya na vidyate ||
venkateswara/07_venkatesha_ashtakam.txt.iti śrī brahmāṇḍapurāṇe brahmanāradasaṁv: iti śrī brahmāṇḍa-purāṇe brahma-nārada-saṁvāde veṅkaṭa-giri-māhātmye śrī veṅkaṭeśa aṣṭakam |

venkateswara/08_venkatesha_karavalamba_s.iti śrī śṛṅgeri jagadguruṇā śrī nṛsiṁha: iti śrī śṛṅgeri jagad-guruṇā śrī nṛsiṁha bhārati svāminā racitaṁ śrī veṅkaṭeśa karāvalamba stotram |

venkateswara/11_venkatesha_mangalashtaka.tārkṣyo yasya ratho mahaśca bhavanaṁ bra: tārkṣyo yasya ratho mahaśca bhavanaṁ brahmāṇḍam-ādyaḥ pumān
venkateswara/11_venkatesha_mangalashtaka.saundaryaṁ ca manobhavānapi bahūn kāntiś: saundaryaṁ ca manobhavānapi bahūn kāntiś-ca kādambinīṁ
venkateswara/11_venkatesha_mangalashtaka.yaḥ svāmī sarasastaṭe viharato śrīsvāmin: yaḥ svāmī sarasas-taṭe viharato śrī-svāmi-nāmnaḥ sadā
venkateswara/11_venkatesha_mangalashtaka.yaḥ śatrūn hanayan nijānavati ca śrībhūv: yaḥ śatrūn hanayan nijān-avati ca śrī-bhūvarāhātmakaḥ
venkateswara/11_venkatesha_mangalashtaka.tebhyo yaḥ pradadādvarān bahuvidhān lakṣ: tebhyo yaḥ pradadād-varān bahuvidhān lakṣmī-nivāso vibhuḥ
venkateswara/11_venkatesha_mangalashtaka.yo devo bhuvi vartate kaliyuge vaikuṇṭha: yo devo bhuvi vartate kali-yuge vaikuṇṭha-loka-sthito

venkateswara/13_venkatesha_dvadasanama_s.asya śrī veṅkaṭeśa dvādaśanāma stotra ma: asya śrī veṅkaṭeśa dvādaśa-nāma stotra mahā-mantrasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrī veṅkaṭeśvaro devatā iṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ |

venkateswara/14_srinivasa_stuti_skanda_p.iti śrīskāndapurāṇe veṅkaṭācalamāhātmye: iti śrī-skānda-purāṇe veṅkaṭācala-māhātmye trayoviṁśo'dhyāye padmanābhākhya-dvija kṛta śrīnivāsa stutiḥ |

venkateswara/15_venkateswara_saranagati_.kalau sa veṅkaṭeśākhyaḥ śaraṇaṁ me ramāp: kalau sa veṅkaṭeśākhyaḥ śaraṇaṁ me ramā-patiḥ ||

venkateswara/17_thondaman_srinivasa_stut.anena stavarājena māmarcanti ca ye janāḥ: anena stava-rājena mām-arcanti ca ye janāḥ ||

venkateswara/19_venkateswara_dvadasa_man.yaḥ paṭhet satataṁ bhaktyā tasya muktiḥ: yaḥ paṭhet satataṁ bhaktyā tasya muktiḥ kare-sthitā ||

venkateswara/21_venkatesha_ashtottarasha.jaladharanibhakāntiṁ śrīmahībhyāṁ sameta: jaladhara-nibha-kāntiṁ śrī-mahībhyāṁ sametaṁ parama-puruṣam-ādyaṁ veṅkaṭeśaṁ namāmi ||
venkateswara/21_venkatesha_ashtottarasha.iti pṛṣṭastadā sūto dhyātvā svātmani tat: iti pṛṣṭas-tadā sūto dhyātvā svātmani tatkṣaṇāt |
venkateswara/21_venkatesha_ashtottarasha.durmedhaḥ prāṇahartre ca śrīdharāya namo: durmedhaḥ prāṇa-hartre ca śrīdharāya namo namaḥ |

vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.tatsaviturityasya viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ, savit: tat-savitur-ity-asya viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ, savitā devatā, gāyatrī chandaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.āpohiṣṭheti tisṛṇām, sindhudvīpa ṛṣiḥ, ā: āpohiṣṭheti tisṛṇām, sindhu-dvīpa ṛṣiḥ, āpo devatā, gāyatrī chandaḥ, mārjane viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.oṁ sūryaśca mā manyuśca manyupatayaśca m: oṁ sūryaś-ca mā manyuś-ca manyu-patayaś-ca manyu-kṛtebhyaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.āpaḥ punantviti mantrasya, nārāyaṇa ṛṣiḥ: āpaḥ punantv-iti mantrasya, nārāyaṇa ṛṣiḥ, āpo devatā, gāyatrī chandaḥ, udaka prāśane viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.āpo hiṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātan: āpo hiṣṭhā mayo-bhuvas-tā na ūrje dadhātana |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.yo vaśśivatamo rasastasya bhājayate ha n: yo vaś-śivatamo rasas-tasya bhājayate ha naḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.tatsaviturityasya, viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ, savi: tat-savitur-ity-asya, viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ, savitā devatā, gāyatrī chandaḥ, arghya-pradāne viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.śrī padminī uṣā saujñā chāyā sameta śrī: śrī padminī uṣā saujñā chāyā sameta śrī sūrya-nārāyaṇa parabrahmaṇe namaḥ | idam-arghyaṁ samarpayāmi |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.uṣasta ityasya mantrasya, gautama ṛṣiḥ,: uṣasta ity-asya mantrasya, gautama ṛṣiḥ, uṣo devatā, uṣṇik-chandaḥ, prāyaścittārghya pradāne viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.ākṛṣṇenetyasya mantrasya, hiraṇya stūpa: ākṛṣṇenety-asya mantrasya, hiraṇya stūpa ṛṣiḥ, sūryo devatā, triṣṭup-chandaḥ, prāyaścittārghya pradāne viniyogaḥ ||
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.ārātrītyasya mantrasya, kaśipā bharadvāj: ārātrīty-asya mantrasya, kaśipā bharadvāja duhitā ṛṣiḥ, rātrir-devatā, pathbhyā bṛhatī chandaḥ, prāyaścitārghya pradāne viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.sarasvatyā, vaśiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ, viṣṇurdevatā: sarasvatyā, vaśiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ, viṣṇur-devatā jagatī chandaḥ, sāyaṁ sandhyā tarpaṇe viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.ādityāstvā chṛndantu jāgatena chandasājg: ādityās-tvā chṛndantu jāgatena chandasājgirasva dviśvetvā devāvaiśvānarā āchṛndantv-ānuṣṭubhena chandasājgirasvat ||
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.udvayamudityamitidvayo, praskaṇva ṛṣiḥ,: udvayamudityamitidvayo, praskaṇva ṛṣiḥ, savitā devatā, prathamasyānuṣṭup-chandaḥ, dvitīyasya gāyatrī chandaḥ,
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.gāyatryasyekapadī dvipadī tripadī catuṣp: gāyatry-asy-ekapadī dvipadī tripadī catuṣpadya padasi na hi padyase |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.mādhyāhnika sandhyā, sāvitrī nāmā, śveta: mādhyāhnika sandhyā, sāvitrī nāmā, śveta-varṇā, vṛṣabha vāhanā, rudra-hṛdayā, yavvana rūpā, gārhapatyāgni-rūpa-sthānā, antarikṣāyatanā, svapnavad-dhṛtiḥ, mādhyāhnika savane yajurvede viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.sāyaṁ sandhyā, sarasvatī nāmā, kṛṣṇavarṇ: sāyaṁ sandhyā, sarasvatī nāmā, kṛṣṇa-varṇā, garuḍa vāhanā, viṣṇu hṛdayā, vṛddha-rūpā, dakṣiṇāgni-rūpa-sthānā, dyaur-āyatanā, suṣuptivad-dhṛtiḥ, sāyaṁ-savane sāmavede viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.asya śrī gāyatrī mahāmantrasya, viśvāmit: asya śrī gāyatrī mahā-mantrasya, viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ, savitā devatā, gāyatrī chandaḥ, mama japopasaṁhāre viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.devā gātu vida ityasya mantrasya, manasa: devā gātu vida ity-asya mantrasya, manasaspata ṛṣiḥ, vāto devatā, virāṭ chandaḥ, japa-nivedane viniyogaḥ||
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.sāyaṁ sandhyāṅga bhūtena gāyatryāstu jap: sāyaṁ sandhyāṅga bhūtena gāyatryās-tu japena ca |

vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ pavitre stho vaiṣṇavyau saviturvaḥ pr: oṁ pavitre stho vaiṣṇavyau savitur-vaḥ prasava utpunāmyacchidreṇa pavitreṇa sūryasya raśmibhiḥ |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.tasya te pavitrapate pavitrapūtasya yatk: tasya te pavitra-pate pavitra-pūtasya yat-kāmaḥ pune tacchakeyam ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ yajñopavītaṁ paramaṁ pavitraṁ prajāpa: oṁ yajñopavītaṁ paramaṁ pavitraṁ prajāpater-yat-sahajaṁ purastāt |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.āyuṣyamagryaṁ pratimuñca śubhraṁ yajñopa: āyuṣyam-agryaṁ pratimuñca śubhraṁ yajñopavītaṁ balam-astu tejaḥ ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ agniriti bhasma vāyuriti bhasma jalam: oṁ agnir-iti bhasma vāyur-iti bhasma jalam-iti bhasma sthalam-iti bhasma vyometi bhasma sarvaṁ ha vā idaṁ bhasma mana etāni cakṣūṁṣi bhasma |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.hariḥ oṁ tatsadadyaitasya śrībrahmaṇo dv: hariḥ oṁ tat-sad-adyaitasya śrī-brahmaṇo dvitīya-parārdhe śrī-śvetavārāha-kalpe jambū-dvīpe bharata-khaṇḍe āryāvartaika-deśāntargate puṇya-kṣetre kali-yuge kali-prathama-caraṇe amuka-saṁvatsare amuka-māse amuka-pakṣe amuka-tithau amuka-vāsare amuka-gotrotpannaḥ amuka-śarmāhaṁ mamopātta-durita-kṣaya-pūrvakaṁ śrī-parameśvara-prīty-arthaṁ prātaḥ-sandhyopāsanaṁ kariṣye |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.ṛtaṁ ceti tryṛcasya mādhucchandaso'ghama: ṛtaṁ ceti tryṛcasya mādhucchandaso'ghamarṣaṇa ṛṣir-anuṣṭup chando bhāva-vṛttaṁ daivatam-apām-upasparśane viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ ṛtaṁ ca satyaṁ cābhīddhāttapaso'dhyaj: oṁ ṛtaṁ ca satyaṁ cābhīddhāt-tapaso'dhyajāyata | tato rātry-ajāyata | tataḥ samudro arṇavaḥ |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.samudrādarṇavādadhi saṁvatsaro ajāyata |: samudrād-arṇavād-adhi saṁvatsaro ajāyata | ahorātrāṇi vidadhad-viśvasya miṣato vaśī |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.sūryācandramasau dhātā yathāpūrvamakalpa: sūryācandramasau dhātā yathāpūrvam-akalpayat | divaṁ ca pṛthivīṁ cāntarikṣam-atho svaḥ ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁkārasya brahmā ṛṣirdaivī gāyatrī chand: oṁkārasya brahmā ṛṣir-daivī gāyatrī chandaḥ paramātmā devatā sapta-vyāhṛtīnāṁ prajāpatir-ṛṣir-gāyatry-uṣṇig-anuṣṭub-bṛhatī-paṅkti-triṣṭub-jagatyaś-chandāṁsy-agni-vāyu-sūrya-bṛhaspati-varuṇendra-viśvedevā devatāḥ, tat-savitur-iti viśvāmitra ṛṣir-gāyatrī chandaḥ savitā devatā, āpojyotiriti śirasaḥ prajāpatir-ṛṣir-yajuś-chando brahmāgni-vāyu-sūryā devatāḥ prāṇāyāme viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ tatsaviturvareṇyaṁ bhargo devasya dhī: oṁ tat-savitur-vareṇyaṁ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ āpo jyotī raso'mṛtaṁ brahma bhūrbhuva: oṁ āpo jyotī raso'mṛtaṁ brahma bhūr-bhuvaḥ svarom ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.sūryaśca meti nārāyaṇa ṛṣiḥ prakṛtiśchan: sūryaś-ca meti nārāyaṇa ṛṣiḥ prakṛtiś-chandaḥ sūrya-manyu-manyupatayo rātriś-ca devatā apām-upasparśane viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ sūryaśca mā manyuśca manyupatayaśca m: oṁ sūryaś-ca mā manyuś-ca manyu-patayaś-ca manyu-kṛtebhyaḥ pāpebhyo rakṣantām |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.yadrātryā pāpamakārṣaṁ manasā vācā hastā: yad-rātryā pāpam-akārṣaṁ manasā vācā hastābhyāṁ padbhyām-udareṇa śiśnā rātris-tad-avalumpatu |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.yatkiṁca duritaṁ mayi idamahaṁ māmamṛtay: yat-kiṁca duritaṁ mayi idam-ahaṁ mām-amṛta-yonau sūrye jyotiṣi juhomi svāhā ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.sarvaṁ punantu māmāpo'satāṁ ca pratigrah: sarvaṁ punantu mām-āpo'satāṁ ca pratigrahaṁ svāhā ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ agniśca mā manyuśca manyupatayaśca ma: oṁ agniś-ca mā manyuś-ca manyu-patayaś-ca manyu-kṛtebhyaḥ pāpebhyo rakṣantām |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.yadahnā pāpamakārṣaṁ manasā vācā hastābh: yad-ahnā pāpam-akārṣaṁ manasā vācā hastābhyāṁ padbhyām-udareṇa śiśnā ahastadavalumpatu |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.yatkiṁca duritaṁ mayi idamahaṁ māmamṛtay: yat-kiṁca duritaṁ mayi idam-ahaṁ mām-amṛta-yonau satye jyotiṣi juhomi svāhā ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvaḥ | oṁ tā na ūrj: oṁ āpo hi ṣṭhā mayo-bhuvaḥ | oṁ tā na ūrje dadhātana | oṁ mahe raṇāya cakṣase |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ yo vaḥ śivatamo rasaḥ | oṁ tasya bhāj: oṁ yo vaḥ śivatamo rasaḥ | oṁ tasya bhājayateha naḥ | oṁ uśatīr-iva mātaraḥ |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ drupadādiva mumucānaḥ svinnaḥ snāto m: oṁ drupadād-iva mumucānaḥ svinnaḥ snāto malādiva |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.ṛtaṁ cetyasya tryṛcasya mādhucchandaso'g: ṛtaṁ cetyasya tryṛcasya mādhucchandaso'ghamarṣaṇa ṛṣir-anuṣṭup chando bhāva-vṛttaṁ daivatam-aghamarṣaṇe viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.tvaṁ yajñastvaṁ vaṣaṭkāra āpo jyotī raso: tvaṁ yajñas-tvaṁ vaṣaṭkāra āpo jyotī raso'mṛtam ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ tatsaviturvareṇyaṁ bh: oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ tat-savitur-vareṇyaṁ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ udvayaṁ tamasaspari svaḥ paśyanta utt: oṁ udvayaṁ tamasas-pari svaḥ paśyanta uttaram |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṁ sūrya ātmā: āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṁ sūrya ātmā jagatas-tasthuṣaś-ca ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.paśyema śaradaḥ śataṁ jīvema śaradaḥ śat: paśyema śaradaḥ śataṁ jīvema śaradaḥ śataṁ śṛṇuyāma śaradaḥ śataṁ pra bravāma śaradaḥ śatam-adīnāḥ syāma śaradaḥ śataṁ bhūyaś-ca śaradaḥ śatāt ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ svaḥ kavacāya hum ||4|| oṁ bhūrbhuvaḥ: oṁ svaḥ kavacāya hum ||4|| oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ netrābhyāṁ vauṣaṭ ||5|| oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ astrāya phaṭ ||6||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ tejo'si śukramasyamṛtamasi | dhāma nā: oṁ tejo'si śukram-asy-amṛtam-asi | dhāma nāmāsi priyaṁ devānām-anādhṛṣṭaṁ deva-yajanam-asi ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ gāyatryasyekapadī dvipadī tripadī cat: oṁ gāyatry-asy-ekapadī dvipadī tripadī catuṣpadapadasi na hi padyase |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ tatsaviturvareṇyaṁ bh: oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ tat-savitur-vareṇyaṁ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt oṁ ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.saṁ bāhubhyāṁ dhamati saṁ patatrairdyāvā: saṁ bāhubhyāṁ dhamati saṁ patatrair-dyāvābhūmī janayan deva ekaḥ ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.yāni kāni ca pāpāni janmāntarakṛtāni ca: yāni kāni ca pāpāni janmāntara-kṛtāni ca |

vidhi/samanya/03_bhasma_dharana_vidhi.tx.pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭhāyāṁ: pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭhāyāṁ śubha-tithau mama śarīra rakṣaṇa siddhy-arthaṁ bhūta preta piśāca rākṣasa gaṇa ariṣṭa saṁhārārthaṁ, jñāna aiśvaryatā prāpty-arthaṁ lalāṭe kuṁkuma sahita bhasma tripuṁḍra dhāraṇaṁ kariṣye ||
vidhi/samanya/03_bhasma_dharana_vidhi.tx.dakṣiṇa hastena bhasmamādāya, vāma haste: dakṣiṇa hastena bhasmamādāya, vāma haste nikṣipya, jalaṁ saṁprokṣya, hasta-dvayam-ācchādya, dakṣiṇa-hastānāmikayā vāma-hastopari ṣaṭkoṇaṁ likhitvā, ṣaṭkoṇa madhye oṁkāraḥ aṁ āṁ iṁ īṁ uṁ ūṁ sauṁ, ṣaṭkoṇeṣu oṁ namaḥ śivāya iti ṣaḍbījān likhitvā ||
