vidhi/samanya/04_karthika_snana_vidhi.tx.gaṁgāvālukābhi saptarṣimaṁḍalaparyaṁtaṁ: gaṁgā-vālukābhi saptarṣi-maṁḍala-paryaṁtaṁ kṛtavārāśeḥ pauṁḍarīkāśvamedhādi samasta kratu phalāvāpty-arthaṁ, iha janmani janmāṁtare ca bālya kaumāra yauvana vārdhakeṣu, jāgrat svapna suṣupty-avasthāsu jñānato'jñānataś-ca kāmato'kāmataḥ svataḥ preraṇayā saṁbhāvitānāṁ sarveṣāṁ pāpānām-apanodanārthaṁ dharmārtha-kāma-mokṣa catur-vidha puruṣārtha siddhy-arthaṁ, kṣema sthairya vijayāyur-ārogya aiśvaryādīnāṁ uttarottarābhivṛddhy-arthaṁ śrī śiva-keśavānugraha siddhy-arthaṁ varṣe varṣe prayukta kārtīkamāse ____ vāsara yuktānāṁ ____ tithau śrīmān (śrīmataḥ) ____ gotrābhijātaḥ ____ nāmadheyo'haṁ pavitra kārtīka prātaḥ snānaṁ kariṣye ||
vidhi/samanya/04_karthika_snana_vidhi.tx.aṁba tvaddarśanānmuktiḥ na jāne snānajaṁ: aṁba tvad-darśanān-muktiḥ na jāne snānajaṁ phalam |
vidhi/samanya/04_karthika_snana_vidhi.tx.gaṁgā gaṁgeti yo brūyāt yojanānāṁ śatair: gaṁgā gaṁgeti yo brūyāt yojanānāṁ śatair-api |
vidhi/samanya/04_karthika_snana_vidhi.tx.mucyate sarva pāpābhyo viṣṇulokaṁ sa gac: mucyate sarva pāpābhyo viṣṇu-lokaṁ sa gacchati ||

vidhi/samanya/05_nadi_snana_sankalpa_gan.oṁ adya brahmaṇo'hni dvitīyaparārdhe śrī: oṁ adya brahmaṇo'hni dvitīya-parārdhe śrī-śvetavārāha-kalpe vaivasvata-manvantare'ṣṭāviṁśatitame kali-yuge kali-prathama-caraṇe bauddhāvatāre bhūr-loke jambū-dvīpe bharata-khaṇḍe bhārata-varṣe ......kṣetre ......nagare ......grāme ......nāma-saṁvatsare ......māse ......pakṣe ......tithau ......vāsare ......gotraḥ ......śarmāham prātaḥ sarva-karmasu śuddhy-arthaṁ śruti-smṛti-purāṇokta-phala-prāpty-arthaṁ śrī-bhagavat-prīty-arthaṁ ca prātaḥ-snānaṁ kariṣye ||
vidhi/samanya/05_nadi_snana_sankalpa_gan.mṛttike hara me pāpaṁ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṁ k: mṛttike hara me pāpaṁ yan-mayā duṣkṛtaṁ kṛtam ||

vidhi/samanya/06_tungabhadra_pushkara_sn.mama upātta duritakṣayadvārā śubhe śobha: mama upātta durita-kṣaya-dvārā śubhe śobhane muhūrte śrī mahāviṣṇor-ājñayā pravartamānasya adya brahmaṇaḥ dvitīya parārdhe śveta varāha kalpe vaivasvata manvaṁtare kali-yuge prathama-pāde jaṁbū-dvīpe bharata-varṣe bharata-khaṁḍe meroḥ dakṣiṇa dig-bhāge śrīśailasya nairṛti pradeśe kṛṣṇā-kāveryoḥ madhya-deśe tuṁgabhadrāpuṣkara nadī tīre asmin vartamāna vyāvahārika cāṁdramānena ……nāma saṁvatsare ……ayane ……ṛtau ……māse ……pakṣe ……tithau ……vāsare śubha-nakṣatre śubha-yoge śubha-karaṇe evaṁ-guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha-tithau śrīmān ……gotraḥ ……nāmadheyaḥ mama saha-kuṭuṁbasya kṣema-sthairya vijaya abhaya āyur-ārogya aiśvaryābhivṛddhy-arthaṁ dharmārtha kāma-mokṣa catur-vidha puruṣārtha phala-siddhy-arthaṁ mṛgāgate deva-gurau sārdha-trikoṭi tīrtha puṣkara prayukta tuṁgabhadrānadī prīty-arthaṁ asmin śubha-dine mama anādy-avidyā vāsanayā pravartamāne vicitrābhiḥ karma-gatibhiḥ vicitrāsu yoniṣu punaḥ punar-anekadhā janitvā kenavā karma viśeṣeṇa idānīṁ ……gotrodbhavasya ……nāmadheyasya mama janma-prabhṛti etat-kṣaṇa paryaṁtaṁ bālya yauvana kaumāra vārdhakeṣu mano-vāk-kāya karmeṁdriya vyāpāraiḥ saṁbhāvitānāṁ pāpānāṁ tvak-cakṣuḥ śrotra-jihvā-ghrāṇānāṁ paṁcānāṁ jñāneṁdriyāṇāṁ vāk-pāṇi-pāda pāyūpasthānāṁ paṁcānāṁ karmeṁdriyāṇāṁ eteṣāṁ prerakasya aṁtaḥkaraṇasya manasaśca svasya gocaraiḥ prākṛtaiḥ kāma krodha lobha moha mada mātsaryaiḥ saṁjanita sakala doṣa-nivṛtty-arthaṁ |
vidhi/samanya/06_tungabhadra_pushkara_sn.iha janmani pūrvajanmani brahmahatyādi p: iha janmani pūrva-janmani brahma-hatyādi pāpānāṁ guru-talpakādi pāpānāṁ svarṇa-steya surā-pānādi pāpānāṁ dvija-patnī guru-patnī rāja-patnī para-patnī gamanādi doṣāṇāṁ deva-brāhmaṇa tiraskāra guru-tiraskāra para-strī-tiraskāra veda-śāstra tiraskāra patnī tiraskāra ātma-tiraskārādi doṣāṇāṁ deva-brāhmaṇa vṛtticchedana taṭākacchedana ātma-hatyādi pāpānāṁ mitra-dravyāpaharaṇa jñāti-dravyāpaharaṇa para-dravyāpaharaṇādi doṣāṇāṁ niṣiddhānna patitānna gaṇānna gaṇikānna duranna durjanānna mlecchānna ucchiṣṭādy-annādi bhakṣaṇādi doṣāṇāṁ nirhetuka bhāryā-visarjana mātā-pitṛ-visarjana mitra-visarjana putrādi visarjanādi doṣāṇāṁ brāhmaṇa-doṣa nirūpaṇa bhāryā-doṣa nirūpaṇa para-strī doṣa-nirūpaṇādi doṣāṇāṁ mama caṁḍāla sparśana para-strī sparśana para-vastra sparśana rajasvala strī sparśanādi doṣāṇāṁ ajñāna-kṛta doṣāṇāṁ kāyika vācika mānasika doṣāṇāṁ bahūnāṁ bahuvidhānāṁ sarveṣāṁ pāpānāṁ apanodanārthaṁ mṛgāgate deva-gurau sārdha-trikoṭi tīrtha puṣkara prayukta tuṁgabhadrā mahā-puṇya-nadī snānam-ahaṁ kariṣye || iti saṁkalpya |
vidhi/samanya/06_tungabhadra_pushkara_sn.pativaṁcanākaraṇa patiniṁdākaraṇa svabha: pati-vaṁcanā-karaṇa pati-niṁdā-karaṇa sva-bhartṛ-tāḍana dūṣaṇa tarjana svāpa-kāle bhartṛ-tāḍana bhartṛ-vaṁcana rūpāṇāṁ guru-vākyākaraṇa niṁdā-karaṇa rūpāṇāṁ para-devatā dūṣaṇa strī-doṣāropaṇa mānasa para-puruṣa samāgamana rūpāṇāṁ kāma-rūpāṇāṁ asnāna bhojana abhakṣya bhakṣaṇa atyaṁta bhāṣaṇa rūpāṇāṁ āraṁbha vrata tyāga nirnimitta tulasīdaḻa nikṛṁtana sadā durbhāṣaṇa durālāpana divāpuruṣa saṁsarga rūpāṇāṁ sālagrāma-sparśana brāhmaṇa-dūṣaṇa suta-vikraya go-vikraya kanyā-vikraya deha-vikraya malina vastra-dhāraṇa grahaṇa samaye puruṣa saṁsarga rajasvalādi sūtaka-madhye dravya-sparśana gṛha-bhāṁḍādi sparśana mitra-droha anṛta-saṁbhāṣaṇa kaṭhina svabhāva bhojana samaye viṣa-prayogādi pāpānāṁ deva-brāhmaṇa tiraskāra pitṛ-mātṛ tiraskāra śiśu stanya-pāna rāhitya śiśu-vadha go-vadha paṁkti-drohādi pāpānāṁ bhartṛ-pṛcchā paribhāṣaṇa upavāsākaraṇa upoṣite bhartari svayaṁ-bhojana bhartṛ-śuśrūṣā rāhitya tad-abhivādana rāhitya gṛhe vidyamāna dravya cora svagṛhastha dravya vikraya sadā anya-gṛha-vāsa bhartari doṣāropaṇa bhartur-apahāsa saṁbhāṣaṇa bhartṛ-vacana nirākaraṇa deśāṁtara-gate dehālaṁkaraṇa para-puruṣa sparśādi saṁbhāvitānāṁ pāpānāṁ ajñānato jñānataś-ca atyaṁta abhyastānāṁ svārtha-kriyā-paratva hīnānya puruṣa saṁyogādīnāṁ bahūnāṁ bahuvidhānāṁ sarveṣāṁ pāpānāṁ apanodanārthaṁ mṛgāgate deva-gurau sārdha-trikoṭi tīrtha puṣkara prayukta tuṁgabhadrā mahā-puṇya-nadī snānam-ahaṁ kariṣye || iti saṁkalpya |

vidhi/samanya/07_magha_snana_vidhi.txt.pāpaṁ nāśaya me deva vāṅmanaḥkarmabhiḥ k: pāpaṁ nāśaya me deva vāṅ-manaḥ-karmabhiḥ kṛtam ||

vidhi/samanya/08_vaisakha_snana_vidhi.tx.prātaḥsnānena me tasmin phaladaḥ pāpahā: prātaḥ-snānena me tasmin phaladaḥ pāpahā bhava ||

vidhi/samanya/09_snana_bheda_bhasma_goma.māntraṁ bhaumaṁ tathāgneyaṁ vāyavyaṁ div: māntraṁ bhaumaṁ tathāgneyaṁ vāyavyaṁ divyam-eva ca |
vidhi/samanya/09_snana_bheda_bhasma_goma.āgneyaṁ bhasmanā snānaṁ vāyavyaṁ gorajaḥ: āgneyaṁ bhasmanā snānaṁ vāyavyaṁ go-rajaḥ smṛtam ||
vidhi/samanya/09_snana_bheda_bhasma_goma.mṛttike hara me pāpaṁ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṁ k: mṛttike hara me pāpaṁ yan-mayā duṣkṛtaṁ kṛtam ||

vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.pavitraṁte vitataṁ brahmaṇaspate | prabh: pavitraṁte vitataṁ brahmaṇaspate | prabhur-gātrāṇi paryeṣi viśvataḥ |
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.mṛgāgate devagurau sārdhatrikoṭi tīrtha: mṛgāgate deva-gurau sārdha-trikoṭi tīrtha puṣkara prayukta tuṁgabhadrā puṇya-nadī tīre - asmat-pitṝṇāṁ akṣaya puṇya-loka phalāvāpty-arthaṁ, asmat-pitṝn-uddiśya, asmat-pitṝṇāṁ prīty-arthaṁ tīrtha śrāddha kāle tila tarpaṇaṁ (savyaṁ) kariṣye | kāle adhikāra siddhy-arthaṁ yathā saṁbhavat-prāyaścittaṁ kariṣye | darbhākṣatais-saha yathāśakti pariṣaddakṣiṇāṁ gṛhītvā ||
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.samasta saṁpatsamavāpya hetavaḥ samutthi: samasta saṁpat-samavāpya hetavaḥ samutthitā patkuladhūma ketavaḥ |
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.apāra saṁsāra samudrahetavaḥ punaṁtumāṁ: apāra saṁsāra samudra-hetavaḥ punaṁtumāṁ brāhmaṇa pāda-pāṁsavaḥ ||
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.samasta tīrthāṁbu pavitramūrtayaḥ rakṣaṁ: samasta tīrthāṁbu pavitra-mūrtayaḥ rakṣaṁtumāṁ brāhmaṇa pāda-pāṁsavaḥ ||
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.śrī puṣṭi kīrtidaṁ vaṁde vipraśrī pāda p: śrī puṣṭi kīrti-daṁ vaṁde vipra-śrī pāda paṁkajaṁ ||
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.asmatpitrādīnāṁ akṣaya puṇyalokā vāptyar: asmat-pitrādīnāṁ akṣaya puṇya-lokā vāptyarthaṁ tila tarpaṇaṁ kartuṁ mukhya-kālo bhūtvā adhikāra saṁpad-astīti bhavaṁto bruvaṁtu ||
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.kartuṁ adhikāra saṁpadastu || kṛcchra tr: kartuṁ adhikāra saṁpad-astu || kṛcchra trayāṇi dadyāt | prācīnāvīti ||
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.1. asmat pitaraṁ .. gotraṁ ... śarmaṇaṁ: 1. asmat pitaraṁ .. gotraṁ ... śarmaṇaṁ ... svadhā namas-tarpayāmi ||

vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.oṁ tatsaviturvareṇyam | bhargo devasya d: oṁ tat-savitur-vareṇyam | bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yonaḥ pracodayāt ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.mama upātta samasta duritakṣaya dvārā śr: mama upātta samasta durita-kṣaya dvārā śrī-parameśvaram-uddiśya śrī-parameśvara prīty-arthaṁ śubhābhyāṁ śubhe śobhane muhūrte śrī mahāviṣṇor-ājñayā pravartamānasya adya brahmaṇaḥ dvitīya parārthe śveta-varāha-kalpe vaivasvata manvaṁtare kali-yuge prathama-pāde jaṁbū-dvīpe bharata-varṣe bharata-khaṁḍe meroḥ dakṣiṇa dig-bhāge śrīśailasya …… pradeśe ……, …… nadyoḥ madhya pradeśe śobhana gṛhe samasta devatā brāhmaṇa ācārya harihara guru caraṇa sannidhau asmin vartamāna vyāvahārika cāṁdramānena śrī …… nāma saṁvatsare …… ayane …… ṛtau …… māse …… pakṣe …… tithau …… vāsare …… nakṣatre …… yoge …… karaṇa evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubhāyāṁ śubha-tithau śrīmān …… gotraḥ …… nāmadheyaḥ (śrīmataḥ …… gotrasya …… nāmadheyasya dharmapatnīsametasya) śrī parameśvara prīty-arthaṁ prātaḥ / mādhyāhnika / sāyaṁ saṁdhyāṁ upāsiṣye ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.āpo hiṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātan: āpo hiṣṭhā mayo-bhuvas-tā na ūrje dadhātana | maheraṇāya cakṣase |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasya bhājayate ha: yo vaḥ śivatamo rasas-tasya bhājayate ha naḥ | uśatīr-iva mātaraḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.idamahaṁ māmamṛtayonau | sūrye jyotiṣi j: idam-ahaṁ mām-amṛta-yonau | sūrye jyotiṣi juhomi svāhā |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.sarvaṁ punantu māmāpo'satāṁ ca pratigrah: sarvaṁ punantu mām-āpo'satāṁ ca pratigrahagṁ svāhā ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.idamahaṁ māmamṛtayonau | satye jyotiṣi j: idam-ahaṁ mām-amṛta-yonau | satye jyotiṣi juhomi svāhā |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.dadhikrāvṇo'kāriṣaṁ jiṣṇoraśvasya vājina: dadhikrāvṇo'kāriṣaṁ jiṣṇor-aśvasya vājinaḥ | surabhi no mukhā karatprāṇa āyūṁṣi tāriṣat ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā yāsu jātaḥ: hiraṇya-varṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā yāsu jātaḥ kaśyapo yāsvindraḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.yāsāṁ rājā varuṇo yāti madhye satyānṛte: yāsāṁ rājā varuṇo yāti madhye satyānṛte avapaśyañ-janānām |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.madhuścutaśśucayo yāḥ pāvakāstā na āpaśś: madhu-ścutaś-śucayo yāḥ pāvakās-tā na āpaśśagṁ syonā bhavantu ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.yāḥ pṛthivīṁ payasondanti śukrāstā na āp: yāḥ pṛthivīṁ payasondanti śukrās-tā na āpaśśagṁ syonā bhavantu ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.śivena mā cakṣuṣā paśyatāpaśśivayā tanuv: śivena mā cakṣuṣā paśyatāpaś-śivayā tanuvopa spṛśata tvacaṁ me |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.sarvāgṁ agnīgṁ rapsuṣado huve vo mayi va: sarvāgṁ agnīgṁ rapsuṣado huve vo mayi varco balam-ojo nidhatta ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ ś: pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha-tithau (mukhya kālātikramaṇa doṣa nivṛtty-arthaṁ prāyaścittārghya-pradānaṁ kariṣye) ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.oṁ bhūḥ | oṁ bhuvaḥ | ogṁ suvaḥ | oṁ tat: oṁ bhūḥ | oṁ bhuvaḥ | ogṁ suvaḥ | oṁ tat-savitur-vareṇyam | bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yonaḥ pracodayāt ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.udyantamastaṁ yantamādityamabhidhyāyanku: udyantam-astaṁ yantam-ādityam-abhidhyāyan-kurvan-brāhmaṇo vidvānt-sakalaṁ bhadram-aśnute'sāv-ādityo brahmeti brahmaivasanbrahmāpyeti ya evaṁ veda ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ ś: pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha-tithau prātaḥ / mādhyāhnika / sāyaṁ saṁdhyāṁga tarpaṇaṁ kariṣye ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.ojo'si saho'si balamasi bhrājo'si devānā: ojo'si saho'si balam-asi bhrājo'si devānāṁ dhāma-nāmāsi viśvam-asi viśvāyuḥ sarvam-asi sarvāyur-abhibhūr-oṁ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.gāyatriyā gāyatrī chaṁdo viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ: gāyatriyā gāyatrī chaṁdo viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ savitā devatā agnir-mukhaṁ brahmāśiro viṣṇur-hṛdayagṁ rudraḥ śikhā pṛthivī yoniḥ prāṇāpāna-vyānodāna samānā saprāṇā śveta-varṇā sāṁkhyāyana sagotrā gāyatrī caturviṁśaty-akṣarā tripadā ṣaṭkukṣiḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.dvimukhaṁ trimukhaṁ caiva catuḥ paṁcamuk: dvi-mukhaṁ trimukhaṁ caiva catuḥ paṁca-mukhaṁ tathā ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.gurussākṣātparaṁ brahmā tasmai śrī gurav: gurus-sākṣāt-paraṁ brahmā tasmai śrī gurave namaḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.oṁ tatsaviturvareṇyaṁ | bhargo devasya d: oṁ tat-savitur-vareṇyaṁ | bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.omāpo jyotī raso'mṛtaṁ brahma bhūrbhuvaḥ: omāpo jyotī raso'mṛtaṁ brahma bhūr-bhuvaḥ suvar-om ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.liṁgaṁ niryāṇa mudrā cetyaṣṭa mudrāḥ pra: liṁgaṁ niryāṇa mudrā cety-aṣṭa mudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.mitro janānyātayati prajānanmitro dādhār: mitro janān-yātayati prajānan-mitro dādhāra pṛthivī mutadyām |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.ā satyena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛ: ā satyena rajasā vartamāno niveśayann-amṛtaṁ martyaṁ ca |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.citraṁ devānā mudagā danīkaṁ cakṣurmitra: citraṁ devānā mudagā danīkaṁ cakṣur-mitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.ā prā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣagṁ sūrya ātm: ā prā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣagṁ sūrya ātmā jagatas-tasthuṣaś-ca ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.paśyema śaradaśśataṁ jīvema śaradaśśataṁ: paśyema śaradaś-śataṁ jīvema śaradaś-śataṁ | nandāma śaradaś-śataṁ modāma śaradaś-śataṁ |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.imaṁ me varuṇa śrudhī hava madyā ca mṛḍa: imaṁ me varuṇa śrudhī hava madyā ca mṛḍaya | tvām-avasyu rācake |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānastadā śāst: tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānas-tadā śāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.āheḍamāno varuṇeha bodhyuruśaṁsa mā na ā: āheḍamāno varuṇeha bodhy-uruśaṁsa mā na āyuḥ pramoṣīḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.yacciddhi te viśo yathā pra deva varuṇa: yac-ciddhi te viśo yathā pra deva varuṇa vratam | minīmasidyavidyavi |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.yatkiñcedaṁ varuṇa daivye jane'bhi droha: yat-kiñcedaṁ varuṇa daivye jane'bhi drohaṁ manuṣyāś-carāmasi |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.oṁ namaḥ prācyai diśe yāśca devatā etasy: oṁ namaḥ prācyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namo |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.namo dakṣiṇāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyā: namo dakṣiṇāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namo |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.namaḥ pratīcyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyā: namaḥ pratīcyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namo |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.nama udīcyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ p: nama udīcyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namo |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.nama ūrdhvāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ: nama ūrdhvāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namo |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.namo'dharāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ: namo'dharāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namo |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.namo'vāntarāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyā: namo'vāntarāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namaḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.namo gaṅgāyamunayormadhye ye vasanti te: namo gaṅgā-yamunayor-madhye ye vasanti te me prasannātmānaś-cirañjīvitaṁ vardhayanti |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.namo gaṅgāyamunayormunibhyaśca namo namo: namo gaṅgā-yamunayor-munibhyaś-ca namo namo gaṅgā-yamunayor-munibhyaś-ca namaḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.pṛthivyāpastejo vāyurākāśāt | oṁ namo bh: pṛthivy-āpas-tejo vāyur-ākāśāt | oṁ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.yathā'ntaraṁ na paśyāmi tathā me svastir: yathā'ntaraṁ na paśyāmi tathā me svastir-āyuṣi ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.namo brahmaṇya devāya gobrāhmaṇa hitāya: namo brahmaṇya devāya go-brāhmaṇa hitāya ca |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.stuto mayā varadā vedamātā pracodayantī: stuto mayā varadā veda-mātā pracodayantī pavane dvijātā |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.āyuḥ pṛthivyāṁ draviṇaṁ brahmavarcasaṁ m: āyuḥ pṛthivyāṁ draviṇaṁ brahmavarcasaṁ mahyaṁ datvā prajātuṁ brahma-lokam ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.kāyena vācā manaseṁdriyairvā buddhyā''tm: kāyena vācā manaseṁdriyair-vā buddhyā''tmanā vā prakṛteḥ svabhāvāt |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.ye santi brāhmaṇā devāstebhyo nityaṁ nam: ye santi brāhmaṇā devās-tebhyo nityaṁ namo namaḥ ||

vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ ś: pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha tithau śrī-parameśvaram-uddiśya śrī-parameśvara prīty-arthaṁ śrīmān …… sagotraḥ …… nāmadheyo'haṁ catur-veda pārāyaṇa phala-siddhy-arthaṁ nitya svādhyāya brahma-yajñena yakṣye ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.hastāvavanijya | trirācāmet | dviḥ parim: hastāvavanijya | trir-ācāmet | dviḥ parimṛjya | sakṛd-upaspṛśya | yat-savyaṁ pāṇiṁ pādau prokṣati | śiraś-cakṣuṣī nāsike śrotre hṛdayam-ālabhya || apa upaspṛśya |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.yastanna veda kimṛcā kariṣyati ya ittadv: yas-tan-na veda kimṛcā kariṣyati ya ittadvidusta ime samāsate ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ bhūḥ – tatsaviturvareṇyaṁ bhargo deva: oṁ bhūḥ – tat-savitur-vareṇyaṁ bhargo devasya dhīmahi |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ suvaḥ – tatsaviturvareṇyaṁ bhargo dev: oṁ suvaḥ – tat-savitur-vareṇyaṁ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ iṣe tvorje tvā vāyavassthopāyavasstha: oṁ iṣe tvorje tvā vāyavassthopāyavasstha devo vas-savitā prārpayatu śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇa ā pyāyadhvamaghniyā deva-bhāgam-ūrjasvatīḥ payasvatīḥ prajāvatīr-anamīvā ayakṣmāḥ mā vasstena īśata mā'ghaśagṁso rudrasya hetiḥ pari vo vṛṇaktu dhruvā asmin gopatau syāta bahvīr-yajamānasya paśūn pāhi || hariḥ om ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ brahma saṁdhattaṁ tanme jinvatam | kṣ: oṁ brahma saṁdhattaṁ tanme jinvatam | kṣattragṁ saṁdhattaṁ tanme jinvatam | iṣagṁ saṁdhattaṁ tāṁ me jinvatam | ūrjagṁ saṁdhattaṁ tāṁ me jinvatam | rayigṁ saṁdhattaṁ tāṁ me jinvatam | puṣṭigṁ saṁdhattaṁ tāṁ me jinvatam | prajāgṁ saṁdhattaṁ tāṁ me jinvatam | paśūnthsaṁdhattaṁ tānme jinvatam | stuto'si janadhāḥ | devās-tvā śukrapāḥ praṇayantu || suvīrāḥ prajāḥ prajanayan-parīhi || hariḥ om ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ namo brahmaṇe dhāraṇaṁ me astvanirāka: oṁ namo brahmaṇe dhāraṇaṁ me astv-anirākaraṇaṁ dhārayitā bhūyāsaṁ karṇayoś-śrutaṁ mā cyoḍhvaṁ mamāmuṣya om ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.ṛtaṁ tapassatyaṁ tapaśśrutaṁ tapaśśāntaṁ: ṛtaṁ tapas-satyaṁ tapaś-śrutaṁ tapaś-śāntaṁ tapo damas-tapaś-śamas-tapo dānaṁ tapo yajñaṁ tapo bhūr-bhuvas-suvar-brahmaitad-upāsyaitat-tapaḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.yathā vṛkṣasya saṁpuṣpitasya dūrādgandho: yathā vṛkṣasya saṁpuṣpitasya dūrād-gandho vāty-evaṁ puṇyasya karmaṇo dūrād-gandho vāti yathā'si-dhārāṁ karte'vahitāmavakrāme yadyuve yuve havā vihvayiṣyāmi kartaṁ patiṣyāmīty-evam-amṛtād-ātmānaṁ jugupset || ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.ahaṁ vṛkṣasya rerivā | kīrtiḥ pṛṣṭhaṁ gi: ahaṁ vṛkṣasya rerivā | kīrtiḥ pṛṣṭhaṁ gireriva | ūrdhva-pavitro vājinīva svamṛtam-asmi | draviṇagṁ savarcasam | sumedhā amṛtokṣitaḥ | iti triśaṅkor-vedānuvacanam ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ agna ā yāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye: oṁ agna ā yāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havya-dātaye | ni hotā sathsi barhiṣi ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ śaṁ no devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pī: oṁ śaṁ no devīr-abhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.gauḥ, gmā, jmā, kṣmā, kṣā, kṣaumā, kṣoṇī: gauḥ, gmā, jmā, kṣmā, kṣā, kṣaumā, kṣoṇī, kṣitiḥ, avaniḥ, urvī, pṛthvī, mahī, aditiḥ, ripaḥ, iḻā, nirṛtiḥ, mā, bhūmiḥ, pūṣā, gātuḥ, gotrā – ity-ekaviṁśatiḥ pṛthvī-nāmāni ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ samāmnāyaḥ samāmnātaḥ sa vyākhyātavya: oṁ samāmnāyaḥ samāmnātaḥ sa vyākhyātavyas-tam-imaṁ samāmnāyaṁ nighaṁṭava ity-ācakṣate |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.athāto brahmajijñāsā | janmādyasya yataḥ: athāto brahma-jijñāsā | janmādy-asya yataḥ | śāstra-yonitvāt | tattu samanvayāt ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.pramāṇa prameya saṁśaya prayojana dṛṣṭān: pramāṇa prameya saṁśaya prayojana dṛṣṭānta siddhāntāvayava tarka nirṇaya vāda jalpa vitaṇḍā hetvābhāsa cchala jati nigraha sthānānāṁ tattva-jñānān-niśśreyasādhigamaḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.tene brahma hṛdāya ādikavaye muhyaṁti ya: tene brahma hṛdāya ādi-kavaye muhyaṁti yat-sūrayaḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.dhāmnā svena sadā nirastakuhakaṁ satyaṁ: dhāmnā svena sadā nirasta-kuhakaṁ satyaṁ paraṁ dhīmahi ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ namo brahmaṇe namo astvagnaye namaḥ p: oṁ namo brahmaṇe namo astv-agnaye namaḥ pṛthivyai nama oṣadhībhyaḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ śāntiśśāntiśśāntiḥ | evaṁ triḥ | oṁ o: oṁ śāntiś-śāntiś-śāntiḥ | evaṁ triḥ | oṁ oṁ om ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ ś: pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha-tithau śrī-parameśvaram-uddiśya śrī-parameśvara prīty-arthaṁ brahma-yajñāṁga devarṣi-pitṝn-uddiśya devarṣi-pitṛ prīty-arthaṁ devarṣi-pitṛ tarpaṇaṁ kariṣye ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.kṛṣṇadvaipāyanādayo ye ṛṣayaḥ tān ṛṣīgṁs: kṛṣṇadvaipāyanādayo ye ṛṣayaḥ tān ṛṣīgṁs-tarpayāmi tarpayāmi |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.somaḥ pitṛmān yamo'ṁgirasvān agniṣvāttāg: somaḥ pitṛmān yamo'ṁgirasvān agniṣvāttāgniḥ kavya-vāhanādayo ye pitaraḥ tān pitṝgṁs-tarpayāmi tarpayāmi tarpayāmi |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.anena brahmayajñena devarṣipitṛ tarpaṇen: anena brahma-yajñena devarṣi-pitṛ tarpaṇena ca bhagavān sarvātmakaḥ śrī-parameśvaras-suprīṇātu ||

vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.oṁ bhūḥ | oṁ bhuvaḥ | ogṁ suvaḥ | oṁ mah: oṁ bhūḥ | oṁ bhuvaḥ | ogṁ suvaḥ | oṁ mahaḥ | oṁ janaḥ | oṁ tapaḥ | ogṁ satyaṁ | oṁ tat-savitur-vareṇyaṁ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt | omāpo jyotī rasomṛtaṁ brahma bhūr-bhuvas-suvar-om |
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.mama upātta samasta duritakṣaya dvārā śr: mama upātta samasta durita-kṣaya dvārā śrī parameśvaram-uddiśya śrī parameśvara prīty-arthaṁ śubhābhyāṁ śubhe śobhane muhūrte śrī mahāviṣṇor-ājñayā pravartamānasya adya brahmaṇaḥ dvitīya parārthe śveta-varāha kalpe vaivasvata manvaṁtare kali-yuge prathama-pāde jaṁbū-dvīpe bhārata-varṣe bharata-khaṁḍe meroḥ _____ dig-bhāge śrīśailasya ___ pradeśe ___, ___ nadyoḥ madhya pradeśe śobhana gṛhe samasta devatā brāhmaṇa ācārya harihara guru caraṇa sannidhau asmin vartamana vyāvaharika cāṁdramānena śrī ____ nāma saṁvatsare ___ ayane ___ ṛtau ___ māse ___ pakṣe ___ tithau ___ vāsare ___ nakṣatre ___ yoge ___ karaṇa evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha-tithau śrīmān ___ gotrasya ___ nāmadheyasya mama śrauta smārta nitya naimittika kāmya karmānuṣṭhāna yogyatā siddhy-arthaṁ brahma-tejo'bhivṛddhyarthaṁ nūtana yajñopavīta dhāraṇaṁ kariṣye ||
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.oṁ āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvaḥ | tā na ūrje d: oṁ āpo hi ṣṭhā mayo-bhuvaḥ | tā na ūrje dadhātana |
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.yo vaśśivatamo rasaḥ | tasya bhājayateha: yo vaś-śivatamo rasaḥ | tasya bhājayateha naḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.oṁ brahmādevānāṁ padavīḥ kavīnāmṛṣirvipr: oṁ brahmādevānāṁ padavīḥ kavīnām-ṛṣir-viprāṇāṁ mahiṣo mṛgāṇām |
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.śyeno gṛdhrāṇāgṁ svadhitirvanānāgṁ somaḥ: śyeno gṛdhrāṇāgṁ svadhitir-vanānāgṁ somaḥ pavitram-atyeti rebhann ||
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.idaṁ viṣṇuriti viṣṇave namaḥ – dvitīyagr: idaṁ viṣṇur-iti viṣṇave namaḥ – dvitīya-graṁthau viṣṇum-āvāhayāmi |
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.oṁ praṇavādyāvāhita devatābhyo namaḥ – v: oṁ praṇavādyāvāhita devatābhyo namaḥ – vastra-yugmaṁ samarpayāmi |
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.oṁ praṇavādyāvāhita devatābhyo namaḥ – k: oṁ praṇavādyāvāhita devatābhyo namaḥ – karpūra-nīrājanaṁ samarpayāmi |
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.oṁ praṇavādyāvāhita devatābhyo namaḥ – m: oṁ praṇavādyāvāhita devatābhyo namaḥ – maṁtra-puṣpaṁ samarpayāmi |
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.oṁ praṇavādyāvāhita devatābhyo namaḥ – ā: oṁ praṇavādyāvāhita devatābhyo namaḥ – ātma-pradakṣiṇa namaskārān samarpayāmi |
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.hṛdrogaṁ mama sūrya harimāṇaṁ ca nāśaya: hṛd-rogaṁ mama sūrya harimāṇaṁ ca nāśaya |
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ ś: pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha tithau mama śrauta smārta nitya naimittika karmānuṣṭhāna yogyatā siddhy-arthaṁ nūtana yajñopavīta dhāraṇaṁ kariṣye ||
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.asya yajñopavītamiti maṁtrasya parameṣṭh: asya yajñopavītam-iti maṁtrasya parameṣṭhī ṛṣiḥ, parabrahma paramātmā devatā, triṣṭup chaṁdaḥ, yajñopavīta-dhāraṇe viniyogaḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ ś: pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha tithau mama udvāhānaṁtara (gārhasthya) karmānuṣṭhāna yogyatā siddhy-arthaṁ dvitīya yajñopavīta dhāraṇaṁ kariṣye ||
pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha tithau uttarīyārthaṁ tṛtīya yajñopavīta-dhāraṇaṁ kariṣye ||
pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha tithau nūtana yajñopavīte maṁtra siddhy-arthaṁ yathāśakti gāyatrī maṁtra-japaṁ kariṣye ||
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.oṁ bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ | tatsaviturvareṇyam: oṁ bhūr-bhuvas-suvaḥ | tat-savitur-vareṇyam | bhargo devasya dhīmahi |
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ ś: pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha tithau jīrṇa-yajñopavīta visarjanaṁ kariṣye |
vidhi/taittiriya/03_yajnopavita_dharana_.samudraṁ gaccha svāhā'ntarikṣaṁ gaccha s: samudraṁ gaccha svāhā'ntarikṣaṁ gaccha svāhā devagṁ savitāraṁ gaccha svāhā'horātre gaccha svāhā mitrāvaruṇau gaccha svāhā somaṁ gaccha svāhā yajñaṁ gaccha svāhā chandāgṁsi gaccha svāhā dyāvā pṛthivī gaccha svāhā nabho divyaṁ gaccha svāhā'gniṁ vaiśvānaraṁ gaccha svāhā'dbhyas-tv-auṣadhībhyo mano me hārdi yaccha tanūṁ tvacaṁ putraṁ naptāram-aśīya śugasi tam-abhi śoca yo'smān dveṣṭi yaṁ ca vayaṁ dviṣmo dhāmno-dhāmno rājann-ito varuṇa no muñca yadāpo aṁghniyā varuṇeti śapāmahe tato varuṇa no muñca ||

vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.namaste astu dhanvane bāhubhyāmuta te na: namaste astu dhanvane bāhubhyām-uta te namaḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.aghorebhyo-'thaghorebhyo ghoraghoratareb: aghorebhyo-'thaghorebhyo ghora-ghoratarebhyaḥ || sarvebhyas-sarva śarvebhyo namaste astu rudra-rūpebhyaḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.sarpaprota kapāla śukti śakala vyākīrṇa: sarpa-prota kapāla śukti śakala vyākīrṇa sacchekharam
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.etābhyo daśa digbhyastu | sarvataḥ pātu: etābhyo daśa digbhyas-tu | sarvataḥ pātu śaṅkaraḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.mā nastoke tanaye mā na āyuṣi mā no goṣu: mā nas-toke tanaye mā na āyuṣi mā no goṣu mā no aśveṣu rīriṣaḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.namo hiraṇyabāhave senānye diśāñca patay: namo hiraṇya-bāhave senānye diśāñ-ca pataye namaḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.hiraṇyagarbha ssamavartatāgre bhūtasya j: hiraṇyagarbha ssamavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patir-eka āsīt |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.ya etāvantaśca bhūyāgṁsaśca diśo rudrā v: ya etāvantaś-ca bhūyāgṁsaś-ca diśo rudrā vitasthire |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.kālāya namaḥ kalavikaraṇāya namo balavik: kālāya namaḥ kalavikaraṇāya namo bala-vikaraṇāya namo balāya namo
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.balapramathanāya nama ssarvabhūtadamanāy: bala-pramathanāya nama ssarvabhūtadamanāya namo manonmanāya namaḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.asya śrī haṁsagāyatrī mahāmantrasya, avy: asya śrī haṁsa-gāyatrī mahā-mantrasya, avyakta parabrahma ṛṣiḥ,
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.haṁsauṁ - netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | haṁsaḥ -: haṁsauṁ - netra-trayāya vauṣaṭ | haṁsaḥ - astrāya phaṭ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.trātāramindra mavitāramindragṁ have have: trātāram-indra mavitāramindragṁ have have suhavagṁ śūram-indram |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.yasminnenamabhyaṣiñcanta devāḥ | tadasya: yasminn-enam-abhyaṣiñcanta devāḥ | tad-asya citragṁ haviṣā yajāma ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.anyamasmadiccha sā ta ityā namo devi nir: anyam-asmad-iccha sā ta ityā namo devi nirṛte tubhyam-astu ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānastadā śāst: tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānas-tadā śāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.aheḍamāno varuṇeha bodhyuruśagṁsa mā na: aheḍamāno varuṇeha bodhy-uruśagṁsa mā na āyuḥ pramoṣīḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.ā no niyudbhiḥ śatinībhiradhvaragm | sah: ā no niyudbhiḥ śatinībhiradhvaragm | sahasriṇībhir-upa yāhi yajñam |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.vayagṁ soma vrate tava | manastanūṣu bib: vayagṁ soma vrate tava | manas-tanūṣu bibhrataḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.asme rudrā mehanā parvatāso vṛtrahatye b: asme rudrā mehanā parvatāso vṛtra-hatye bharahūtau sajoṣāḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.namaḥ śambhave ca mayobhave ca namaḥ śaṅ: namaḥ śambhave ca mayo-bhave ca namaḥ śaṅkarāya ca
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.mayaskarāya ca namaḥ śivāya ca śivatarāy: mayas-karāya ca namaḥ śivāya ca śivatarāya ca ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.vibhūrasi pravāhaṇo raudreṇānīkena pāhi: vibhūr-asi pravāhaṇo raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā-'gne pipṛhi mā mā mā higṁsīḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.vahnirasi havyavāhano raudreṇānīkena pāh: vahnir-asi havya-vāhano raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā-'gne pipṛhi mā mā mā higṁsīḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.tuthosi viśvavedā raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā: tuthosi viśva-vedā raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā-'gne pipṛhi mā mā mā higṁsīḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.uśigasikavī raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā-'gne: uśig-asi-kavī raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā-'gne pipṛhi mā mā mā higṁsīḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.aṅghārirasi bambhārī raudreṇānīkena pāhi: aṅghārir-asi bambhārī raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā-'gne pipṛhi mā mā mā higṁsīḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.avasyurasi duvasvān raudreṇānīkena pāhi: avasyur-asi duvasvān raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā-'gne pipṛhi mā mā mā higṁsīḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.śundhyūrasi mārjālīyo raudreṇānīkena pāh: śundhyūr-asi mārjālīyo raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā-'gne pipṛhi mā mā mā higṁsīḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.samrāḍasi kṛśānū raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā-: samrāḍ-asi kṛśānū raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā-'gne pipṛhi mā mā mā higṁsīḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.asammṛṣṭosi havyasūdo raudreṇānīkena pāh: asammṛṣṭosi havya-sūdo raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā-'gne pipṛhi mā mā mā higṁsīḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.ṛtadhāmā-'si suvarjyotī raudreṇānīkena p: ṛtadhāmā-'si suvar-jyotī raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā-'gne pipṛhi mā mā mā higṁsīḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.brahmajyotirasi suvardhāmā raudreṇānīken: brahma-jyotir-asi suvar-dhāmā raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā-'gne pipṛhi mā mā mā higṁsīḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.ahirasi budhniyo raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā-: ahir-asi budhniyo raudreṇānīkena pāhi mā-'gne pipṛhi mā mā mā higṁsīḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.tato bhūtapreta piśāca baddha brahmarākṣ: tato bhūta-preta piśāca baddha brahmarākṣasa yakṣa yama-dūta śākinī ḍākinī hākinī
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.yā iṣṭā uṣaso nimrucaśca tāssandadhāmi h: yā iṣṭā uṣaso nimrucaś-ca tās-sandadhāmi haviṣā ghṛtena |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.marmāṇi te varmabhiśchādayāmi somastvā r: marmāṇi te varmabhiś-chādayāmi somas-tvā rājā-'mṛte nābhivastām |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.daśahotetyā cakṣate parokṣeṇa | parokṣap: daśahotetyā cakṣate parokṣeṇa | parokṣa-priyā iva hi devāḥ || 1
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.saptahotetyā cakṣate parokṣeṇa | parokṣa: saptahotetyā cakṣate parokṣeṇa | parokṣa-priyā iva hi devāḥ || 2
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.ṣaḍḍhotetyā cakṣate parokṣeṇa | parokṣap: ṣaḍḍhotetyā cakṣate parokṣeṇa | parokṣa-priyā iva hi devāḥ || 3
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.pañcahotetyā cakṣate parokṣeṇa | parokṣa: pañcahotetyā cakṣate parokṣeṇa | parokṣa-priyā iva hi devāḥ || 4
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.caturhotetyā cakṣate parokṣeṇa | parokṣa: caturhotetyā cakṣate parokṣeṇa | parokṣa-priyā iva hi devāḥ || 5
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.yena yajñastāyate (yajñastrāyate) saptah: yena yajñas-tāyate (yajñastrāyate) sapta-hotā tanme manaḥ śiva-saṅkalpam-astu || 1
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.yena karmāṇyapaso manīṣiṇo yajñe kṛṇvant: yena karmāṇy-apaso manīṣiṇo yajñe kṛṇvanti vidatheṣu dhīrāḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.yasmānna ṛte kiñcana karma kriyate tanme: yasmān-na ṛte kiñcana karma kriyate tanme manaḥ śiva-saṅkalpam-astu || 4
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.akāyo nirguṇo hyātmā tanme manaḥ śivasaṅ: akāyo nirguṇo hyātmā tanme manaḥ śiva-saṅkalpam-astu || 22
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.nīlakaṇṭhaṁ trinetraṁ ca tanme manaḥ śiv: nīla-kaṇṭhaṁ trinetraṁ ca tanme manaḥ śiva-saṅkalpam-astu || 26
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.vīrānmāno rudra bhāmitovadhī rhaviṣmanto: vīrān-māno rudra bhāmitovadhī rhaviṣmanto namasā vidhema te tanme
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.sarvo hyeṣa rudrastasmai rudrāya namo as: sarvo hyeṣa rudras-tasmai rudrāya namo astu tanme manaḥ
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.namakaṁ ca makaṁ caiva puruṣasūktaṁ ca y: namakaṁ ca makaṁ caiva puruṣa-sūktaṁ ca yad-viduḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.mahādevaṁ ca tattulyaṁ tanme manaḥ śivas: mahādevaṁ ca tat-tulyaṁ tanme manaḥ śiva-saṅkalpam-astu || 38
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.ya idagṁ śivasaṅkalpagṁ sadā dhyāyanti b: ya idagṁ śiva-saṅkalpagṁ sadā dhyāyanti brāhmaṇāḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.yā te agne rudriyā tanūstayā naḥ pāhi ta: yā te agne rudriyā tanūs-tayā naḥ pāhi tasyās-te svāhā |
vidhi/taittiriya/04_mahanyasa_vidhi.txt.ātvā mantrāḥ kaviśastā vahantvenā rājan: ātvā mantrāḥ kavi-śastā vahantv-enā rājan haviṣā mādayasva ||

vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā yāsu jātaḥ: hiraṇya-varṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā yāsu jātaḥ kaśyapo yāsvindraḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.yāsāgṁ rājā varuṇo yāti madhye satyānṛte: yāsāgṁ rājā varuṇo yāti madhye satyānṛte avapaśyañ-janānām |
vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.madhuścutaḥ śucayo yāḥ pāvakāstā na āpaḥ: madhu-ścutaḥ śucayo yāḥ pāvakās-tā na āpaḥ śagg syonā bhavantu || 2
vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.yāḥ pṛthivīṁ payasondanti śukrāstā na āp: yāḥ pṛthivīṁ payasondanti śukrās-tā na āpaḥ śagg syonā bhavantu || 3
vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.sarvāgṁ agnīgṁ raphsuṣado huve vo mayi v: sarvāgṁ agnīgṁ raphsuṣado huve vo mayi varco balam-ojo nidhatta || 4
vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.tasmādā nadyo nāma stha tā vo nāmāni sin: tasmād-ā nadyo nāma stha tā vo nāmāni sindhavaḥ || 5
vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.āpo bhadrā ghṛtamidāpa āsuragnīṣomau bib: āpo bhadrā ghṛtam-id-āpa āsur-agnīṣomau bibhraty-āpa ittāḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.tīvro raso madhupṛcāṁ araṁgama ā mā prāṇ: tīvro raso madhu-pṛcāṁ araṁgama ā mā prāṇena saha varcasā gan || 9
vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.manye bhejāno amṛtasya tarhi hiraṇyavarṇ: manye bhejāno amṛtasya tarhi hiraṇya-varṇā atṛpaṁ yadā vaḥ || 10
vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhāta: āpo hi ṣṭhā mayo-bhuvas-tā na ūrje dadhātana |
vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasya bhājayateha n: yo vaḥ śivatamo rasas-tasya bhājayateha naḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.divi śrayasvāntarikṣe yatasva pṛthivyā s: divi śrayasvāntarikṣe yatasva pṛthivyā saṁ bhava brahmavarcasam-asi brahmavarcasāya tvā || 14
vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.apāṁ grahāngṛhṇātyetadvāva rājasūyaṁ yad: apāṁ grahān-gṛhṇāty-etad-vāva rājasūyaṁ yadete grahāḥ savo'gnir-varuṇa-savo rājasūyam-agnisavaś-cityas-tābhyām-eva sūyate'tho ubhāv-eva lokāvabhi jayati yaśca rājasūyenejānasya yaścāgnicita āpo bhavanty-āpo vā agner-bhrātṛvyā yad-apo'gner-adhastād-upadadhāti bhrātṛvyābhibhūtyai bhavaty-ātmanā parā'sya bhrātṛvyo bhavaty-amṛtaṁ vā āpas-tasmād-adbhir-avatāntam-abhiṣiñcanti nā''rtim-ārchati sarvam-āyur-eti ||
vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.yaḥ potā sa punātu mā | punantu mā devaj: yaḥ potā sa punātu mā | punantu mā deva-janāḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.tena brahmavido vayam | pūtaṁ brahma pun: tena brahma-vido vayam | pūtaṁ brahma punīmahe |
vidhi/taittiriya/05_malapakarshana_snana.āpo vā idagṁ sarvaṁ viśvā bhūtānyāpaḥ pr: āpo vā idagṁ sarvaṁ viśvā bhūtāny-āpaḥ prāṇā vā āpaḥ paśava āpo'nnam-āpo'mṛtam-āpaḥ samrāḍ-āpo virāḍ-āpaḥ svarāḍ-āpaś-chandāgsy-āpo jyotīgṣy-āpo yajūgṣyāpaḥ satyam-āpaḥ sarvā devatā āpo bhūr-bhuvaḥ suvarāpa om ||

vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.ślo|| nityaṁ daśasnāna parasya sādho rūp: ślo|| nityaṁ daśa-snāna parasya sādho rūpaṁca tejaś-ca yaśaś-ca śaucaṁ |
vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.tayostu vāruṇaṁ mukhyaṁ ṣaḍvidhaṁ tatpun: tayos-tu vāruṇaṁ mukhyaṁ ṣaḍvidhaṁ tatpuna ssmṛtam |
vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.japtu kāmaḥ pavitrāṇi hyarciṣyan devatāḥ: japtu kāmaḥ pavitrāṇi hy-arciṣyan devatāḥ pitṝn ||
vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.sūtram — atha caturāśramiṇāṁ snānavidhi: sūtram — atha caturāśramiṇāṁ snāna-vidhi rabhiṣekaṁ divyaṁ vā yavyamāgneyaṁ gurv-anujñā iti paṁcadhā bhavaṁtīti | abhiṣekaṁ vāruṇaṁ avagāhana snānam-iti bhāṣye tat-prakāram-āha | ubhaya pavitra-pāṇiḥ dvir-ācamya ||
vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.hariḥ oṁ | asmadgurubhyo namaḥ | asmatpa: hariḥ oṁ | asmad-gurubhyo namaḥ | asmat-parama-gurubhyo namaḥ | śrī vikhanasa gurubhyo namaḥ | śrī lakṣmī-vallabhāraṁbhāṁ ...... vaṁde guru-paraṁparām | āsana maṁtrasya - yathābalaṁ prāṇāyāmaṁ kuryāt |
vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.śrī goviṁda goviṁda, asya śrī bhagavato: śrī goviṁda goviṁda, asya śrī bhagavato mahā puruṣasya | ...... asyāṁ śubha-tithau śrīman-nārāyaṇa prīty-arthaṁ | bhagavad-ājñā kaiṁkarya rūpa bhagavad-ārādhanāṁga-bhūtaṁ prātas-snānam-ahaṁ kariṣye | bhagavatobaleneti sāttvika saṁkalpaṁ kṛtvā ||
vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.ślo|| prātarmādhyaṁ dina snānaṁ vānapras: ślo|| prātar-mādhyaṁ dina snānaṁ vānaprastha gṛhastha yoḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.maṁtraḥ idamāpaḥ pravahatā vadyaṁca mala: maṁtraḥ idam-āpaḥ pravahatā vadyaṁca malaṁcayat | yadvābhi rudrahānnṛtā yadvāśepo abhīruṇaṁ | āpo mātasmādenaso viśvānmuṁcaṁ tvagṁ hasaḥ | nirmā muṁcāmiśapathānnirmā varuṇādadhi | nirmāyamasya paḍbiśāt sarvasmāddeva kilbiṣāt | idam-āpaḥ praṇīta bheṣajaṁ tanme varuṇaṁ namaḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.iti jalasamīpaṁ gatvā | hiraṇya śṛṁgamit: iti jala-samīpaṁ gatvā | hiraṇya śṛṁgam-iti praṇamya ||
vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.maṁtraḥ hiraṇya śṛṁgaṁ varuṇaṁ prapadye: maṁtraḥ hiraṇya śṛṁgaṁ varuṇaṁ prapadye tīrthaṁ me dehi-yācataḥ | yanmayābhukta masādhūnāṁ pāpebhyaś-ca pratigrahaḥ | yanme manasā vācā karmaṇāvā duṣkṛtaṁ kṛtam | tanna iṁdrovaruṇo bṛhaspati ssavitāca punaṁtu punaḥ punaḥ | sumitrāna āpa oṣadhayas-saṁtu durmitrā stasmai bhūyāsuryo smān dveṣṭiyaṁ cavayaṁ dviṣmaḥ | namo agnaye apsumate nama iṁdrāya namo varuṇāya namo vāruṇyai namo adbhyaḥ | yad-apāṁ krūraṁ yada medhyaṁ yad-aśāṁtaṁ tad-apagacchatāt | atyāśanādati pānādyacca ugrātprati grahāt | tanme varuṇo rājā pāṇinā hy-avamarśatu | so hamapāpo virajo-nirmukto mukta-kilbiṣaḥ | nākasya pṛṣṭha māruhyagacchedbrahma salokatām | imamme gaṁge yamune sarasvati śutudri stomagṁ sacatāparuṣṇiyā | asikniyā marudvṛdhe vitastayārjīkīye śṛṇuhyāsuṣomayā ||
vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.maṁtraḥ āpaḥ punātu pṛthivī sarvaṁ punāt: maṁtraḥ āpaḥ punātu pṛthivī sarvaṁ punātu dharaṇī | sarva-pūtā māgṁ sarva-pāpaiḥ punātu ||
vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.idaṁ snānaṁ varaṁ maṁtrāt sahasrādadhika: idaṁ snānaṁ varaṁ maṁtrāt sahasrād-adhikaṁ matam |

vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.vedyo vaidyaḥ sadāyogī vīrahā mādhavo ma: vedyo vaidyaḥ sadā-yogī vīrahā mādhavo madhuḥ |
vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.amṛtyuḥ sarvadṛk siṁhaḥ sandhātā sandhim: amṛtyuḥ sarva-dṛk siṁhaḥ sandhātā sandhimān sthiraḥ |
vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣaḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇadaḥ praṇa: vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣaḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇa-daḥ praṇavaḥ pṛthuḥ |
vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.yajña ijyo mahejyaśca kratuḥ satraṁ satā: yajña ijyo mahejyaś-ca kratuḥ satraṁ satāṁ gatiḥ |
vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.stavyaḥ stavapriyaḥ stotraṁ stutiḥ stotā: stavyaḥ stava-priyaḥ stotraṁ stutiḥ stotā raṇa-priyaḥ |
vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.eko naikaḥ savaḥ kaḥ kiṁ yat tatpadamanu: eko naikaḥ savaḥ kaḥ kiṁ yat tat-padam-anuttamam |
vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.na bhayaṁ kvacidāpnoti vīryaṁ tejaśca vi: na bhayaṁ kvacid-āpnoti vīryaṁ tejaś-ca vindati |
vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.yogo jñānaṁ tathā sāṅkhyaṁ vidyāḥ śilpād: yogo jñānaṁ tathā sāṅkhyaṁ vidyāḥ śilpādi-karma ca |
vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.paṭhedya icchetpuruṣaḥ śreyaḥ prāptuṁ su: paṭhed-ya icchet-puruṣaḥ śreyaḥ prāptuṁ sukhāni ca ||
vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.śrīvāsudeva namo'stu ta oṁ nama iti |: śrī-vāsudeva namo'stu ta oṁ nama iti |
vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.oṁ tatsaditi śrīmahābhārate śatasāhasryā: oṁ tat-sad-iti śrī-mahābhārate śatasāhasryāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ vaiyāsikyām-ānuśāsanike
vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhan: yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanur-dharaḥ |
vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.ārtā viṣaṇṇāḥ śithilāśca bhītā ghoreṣu c: ārtā viṣaṇṇāḥ śithilāś-ca bhītā ghoreṣu ca vyādhiṣu vartamānāḥ |
vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.tatsarvaṁ kṣamyatāṁ deva nārāyaṇa namo's: tat-sarvaṁ kṣamyatāṁ deva nārāyaṇa namo'stu te ||
vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.kāyena vācā manasendriyairvā buddhyātman: kāyena vācā manasendriyair-vā buddhyātmanā vā prakṛteḥ svabhāvāt | (prakṛtisvabhāvāt |)
vishnu/25_vishnu_sahasranama_stotram.txt.iti śrīmahābhārate śatasahasrikāyāṁ saṁh: iti śrī-mahābhārate śatasahasrikāyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ vaiyāsikyāṁ anuśāsana-parvāntargata anuśāsanika-parvaṇi

vishnu/26_vishnu_ashtottarashatanama_sto.iti te kathitaṁ divyaṁ nāmnāmaṣṭottaraṁ: iti te kathitaṁ divyaṁ nāmnām-aṣṭottaraṁ śatam || 15 ||

vishnu/27_hayagriva_ashtottarashatanama_.oṁ asya śrīhayagrīvastotramantrasya saṁk: oṁ asya śrī-hayagrīva-stotra-mantrasya saṁkarṣaṇa ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup-chandaḥ śrī-hayagrīvo devatā ṛṁ bījaṁ namaḥ śaktiḥ vidyārthe jape viniyogaḥ |
vishnu/27_hayagriva_ashtottarashatanama_.naśyanti sakalā rogā ante haripuraṁ vraj: naśyanti sakalā rogā ante hari-puraṁ vrajet || 19 ||

vishnu/29_vishnu_ashtottarashata_divyast.mauhūre kālameghaṁ tu madhurāyāṁ tu sund: mauhūre kāla-meghaṁ tu madhurāyāṁ tu sundaram |
vishnu/29_vishnu_ashtottarashata_divyast.kuraṅge tu tathā pūrṇaṁ kṛṣṇamekaṁ vaṭas: kuraṅge tu tathā pūrṇaṁ kṛṣṇam-ekaṁ vaṭa-sthale || 30 ||
vishnu/29_vishnu_ashtottarashata_divyast.adhītāḥ sakalā vedāḥ kṛtāśca vividhā mak: adhītāḥ sakalā vedāḥ kṛtāś-ca vividhā makhāḥ |
vishnu/29_vishnu_ashtottarashata_divyast.aṣṭau me mūrtayaḥ santi svayaṁ vyaktā ma: aṣṭau me mūrtayaḥ santi svayaṁ vyaktā mahī-tale || 36 ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.tattāvadbhāti sākṣād gurupavanapure hant: tat-tāvad-bhāti sākṣād guru-pavana-pure hanta bhāgyaṁ janānām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.ete tāvad vayaṁ tu sthirataramanasā viśv: ete tāvad vayaṁ tu sthiratara-manasā viśva-pīḍāpahatyai
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.kasmānno niṣkalastvaṁ sakala iti vacastv: kasmān-no niṣkalas-tvaṁ sakala iti vacas-tvat-kalāsv-eva bhūman||
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.kaṣṭā te sṛṣṭiceṣṭā bahutarabhavakhedāva: kaṣṭā te sṛṣṭi-ceṣṭā bahutara-bhava-khedāvahā jīva-bhājām-ity-evaṁ pūrvam-ālocitam-ajita mayā naivam-adyābhijāne|
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.no cejjīvāḥ kathaṁ vā madhurataramidaṁ t: no cej-jīvāḥ kathaṁ vā madhurataram-idaṁ tvad-vapuś-cid-rasārdraṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.namrāṇāṁ saṁnidhatte satatamapi purastai: namrāṇāṁ saṁnidhatte satatam-api purastair-anabhyarthitān-apy-arthān kāmān-ajasraṁ vitarati paramānanda-sāndrāṁ gatiṁ ca|
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.itthaṁ niśśeṣalabhyo niravadhikaphalaḥ p: itthaṁ niśśeṣa-labhyo niravadhika-phalaḥ pārijāto hare tvaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.kāruṇyāt kāmamanyaṁ dadati khalu pare sv: kāruṇyāt kāmam-anyaṁ dadati khalu pare svātmadas-tvaṁ viśeṣād-aiśvaryād-īśate'nye jagati para-jane svātmano'pīśvaras-tvam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.tvayyuccairāramanti pratipadamadhure cet: tvayy-uccair-āramanti pratipada-madhure cetanāḥ sphīta-bhāgyās-tvaṁ cātmārāma evety-atula-guṇa-gaṇādhāra śaure namaste||
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.aṅgāsaṅgā sadā śrīrakhilavidasi na kvāpi: aṅgāsaṅgā sadā śrīr-akhila-vid-asi na kvāpi te saṅga-vārtā

vishnu/narayaniyam/002_dasakam_02_bhagav.saundaryottarato'pi sundarataraṁ tvadrūp: saundaryottarato'pi sundarataraṁ tvad-rūpam-āścaryato'py-āścaryaṁ bhuvane na kasya kutukaṁ puṣṇāti viṣṇo vibho||
vishnu/narayaniyam/002_dasakam_02_bhagav.sā devī paramotsukā cirataraṁ nāste svab: sā devī paramotsukā cirataraṁ nāste sva-bhakteṣv-api|
vishnu/narayaniyam/002_dasakam_02_bhagav.ye tvaddhyānaguṇānukīrtanarasāsaktā hi b: ye tvad-dhyāna-guṇānukīrtana-rasāsaktā hi bhaktā janās-teṣv-eṣā vasati sthiraiva dayita-prastāva-dattādarā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/002_dasakam_02_bhagav.evaṁbhūtatayā hi bhaktyabhihito yogaḥ sa: evaṁ-bhūtatayā hi bhakty-abhihito yogaḥ sa yoga-dvayāt
vishnu/narayaniyam/002_dasakam_02_bhagav.kliṣṭvā tarkapathe paraṁ tava vapurbrahm: kliṣṭvā tarka-pathe paraṁ tava vapur-brahmākhyam-anye punaś-cittārdratvam-ṛte vicintya bahubhiḥ siddhyanti janmāntaraiḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/002_dasakam_02_bhagav.sadyaḥsiddhikarī jayatyayi vibho saivāst: sadyaḥ-siddhi-karī jayaty-ayi vibho saivāstu me tvat-pada-prema-prauḍhi-rasārdratā drutataraṁ vātālayādhīśvara||

vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.smaranto rūpaṁ te varada kathayanto guṇa: smaranto rūpaṁ te varada kathayanto guṇa-kathāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.caranto ye bhaktāstvayi khalu ramante pa: caranto ye bhaktās-tvayi khalu ramante paramamūnahaṁ dhanyān manye samadhigata-sarvābhilaṣitān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.gadakliṣṭaṁ kaṣṭaṁ tava caraṇasevārasabh: gada-kliṣṭaṁ kaṣṭaṁ tava caraṇa-sevā-rasa-bhare'py-anāsaktaṁ cittaṁ bhavati bata viṣṇo kuru dayām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.bhavatpādāmbhojasmaraṇarasiko nāmanivahā: bhavat-pādāmbhoja-smaraṇa-rasiko nāma-nivahān-ahaṁ gāyaṁ gāyaṁ kuhacana vivatsyāmi vijane||
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.kṛpā te jātā cetkimiva na hi labhyaṁ tan: kṛpā te jātā cet-kim-iva na hi labhyaṁ tanu-bhṛtāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.bhavadbhaktiḥ sphītā bhavatu mama saiva: bhavad-bhaktiḥ sphītā bhavatu mama saiva praśamayed-aśeṣa-kleśaughaṁ na khalu hṛdi saṁdeha-kaṇikā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.na ced vyāsasyoktistava ca vacanaṁ naiga: na ced vyāsasyoktis-tava ca vacanaṁ naigama-vaco
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.vidhūya kleśān me kuru caraṇayugmaṁ dhṛt: vidhūya kleśān me kuru caraṇa-yugmaṁ dhṛta-rasaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.bhavanmūrtyāloke nayanamatha te pādatula: bhavan-mūrty-āloke nayanam-atha te pāda-tulasī-parighrāṇe ghrāṇaṁ śravaṇam-api te cāru-carite||
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.bhavatsnehī so'haṁ subahu paritapye ca k: bhavat-snehī so'haṁ subahu paritapye ca kim-idam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.akīrtiste mā bhūd varada gadabhāraṁ praś: akīrtis-te mā bhūd varada gada-bhāraṁ praśamayan
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.kimuktairbhūyobhistava hi karuṇā yāvadud: kim-uktair-bhūyobhis-tava hi karuṇā yāvad-udiyād-ahaṁ tāvad deva prahita-vividhārtha-pralapitaḥ|

vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.kalyatāṁ mama kuruṣva tāvatīṁ kalyate bh: kalyatāṁ mama kuruṣva tāvatīṁ kalyate bhavad-upāsanaṁ yayā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.kurmahe dṛḍhamamī sukhāsanaṁ paṅkajādyam: kurmahe dṛḍham-amī sukhāsanaṁ paṅkajādyam-api vā bhavat-parāḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.tvatsamādhivijaye tu yaḥ punarmaṅkṣu mok: tvat-samādhi-vijaye tu yaḥ punar-maṅkṣu mokṣa-rasikaḥ krameṇa vā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.liṅgadehamapi saṁtyajannatho līyate tvay: liṅga-deham-api saṁtyajann-atho līyate tvayi pare nirāgrahaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.īyate bhavadupāśrayastadā vedhasaḥ padam: īyate bhavad-upāśrayas-tadā vedhasaḥ padam-ataḥ puraiva vā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.tatra vā tava pade'thavā vasan prākṛtapr: tatra vā tava pade'thavā vasan prākṛta-pralaya eti muktatām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.svecchayā khalu purā vimucyate saṁvibhid: svecchayā khalu purā vimucyate saṁvibhidya jagad-aṇḍam-ojasā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.tattadātmakatayā viśan sukhī yāti te pad: tat-tad-ātmakatayā viśan sukhī yāti te padam-anāvṛtaṁ vibho||
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.arcirādigatimīdṛśīṁ vrajan vicyutiṁ na b: arcirādi-gatim-īdṛśīṁ vrajan vicyutiṁ na bhajate jagat-pate|

vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.no mṛtyuśca tadāmṛtaṁ ca samabhūnnāhno n: no mṛtyuś-ca tadāmṛtaṁ ca samabhūn-nāhno na rātreḥ sthitis-tatraikas-tvam-aśiṣyathāḥ kila parānanda-prakāśātmanā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.kālaḥ karma guṇāśca jīvanivahā viśvaṁ ca: kālaḥ karma guṇāś-ca jīva-nivahā viśvaṁ ca kāryaṁ vibho
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.teṣāṁ naiva vadantyasattvamayi bho śakty: teṣāṁ naiva vadanty-asattvam-ayi bho śaktyātmanā tiṣṭhatāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.no cet kiṁ gaganaprasūnasadṛśāṁ bhūyo bh: no cet kiṁ gagana-prasūna-sadṛśāṁ bhūyo bhavet-sambhavaḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.bibhrāṇe tvayi cukṣubhe tribhuvanībhāvāy: bibhrāṇe tvayi cukṣubhe tri-bhuvanībhāvāya māyā svayam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.prādurbhūya guṇān vikāsya vidadhuḥ tasyā: prādurbhūya guṇān vikāsya vidadhuḥ tasyāḥ sahāya-kriyām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.tatrāsau triguṇātmako'pi ca mahān sattva: tatrāsau triguṇātmako'pi ca mahān sattva-pradhānaḥ svayaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.taccāntaḥkaraṇaṁ vibho tava balāt sattvā: tac-cāntaḥkaraṇaṁ vibho tava balāt sattvāṁśa evāsṛjat|
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.śabdād vyoma tatassasarjitha vibho sparś: śabdād vyoma tatas-sasarjitha vibho sparśaṁ tato mārutaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.tasmād rūpamato maho'tha ca rasaṁ toyaṁ: tasmād rūpam-ato maho'tha ca rasaṁ toyaṁ ca gandhaṁ mahīm|

vishnu/narayaniyam/006_dasakam_06_virat_.siddhādayassvaragaṇā mukharandhramagnird: siddhādayas-svaragaṇā mukha-randhram-agnir-devā bhujāḥ stana-yugaṁ tava dharma-devaḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/006_dasakam_06_virat_.pṛṣṭhaṁ tvadharma iha deva manassudhāṁśu: pṛṣṭhaṁ tv-adharma iha deva manas-sudhāṁśur-avyaktam-eva hṛdayāmbujam-ambujākṣa|

vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.evaṁ deva caturdaśātmakajagadrūpeṇa jāta: evaṁ deva caturdaśātmaka-jagad-rūpeṇa jātaḥ punas-tasyordhvaṁ khalu satyaloka-nilaye jāto'si dhātā svayam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.tāvattvaṁ jagatāmpate tapa tapetyevaṁ hi: tāvat-tvaṁ jagatām-pate tapa tapety-evaṁ hi vaihāyasīṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.divyaṁ varṣasahasramāttatapasā tena tvam: divyaṁ varṣa-sahasram-ātta-tapasā tena tvam-ārādhitas-tasmai darśitavān-asi sva-nilayaṁ vaikuṇṭham-ekādbhutam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.māyā yatra kadāpi no vikurute bhāte jaga: māyā yatra kadāpi no vikurute bhāte jagadbhyo bahiś-śoka-krodha-vimoha-sādhvasa-mukhā bhāvās-tu dūraṁgatāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.tatte dhāma vibhāvitaṁ vijayate vaikuṇṭh: tatte dhāma vibhāvitaṁ vijayate vaikuṇṭha-rūpaṁ vibho||
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.bhaktiprāptatathāvidhonnatapadā dīvyanti: bhakti-prāpta-tathāvidhonnata-padā dīvyanti divyā janās-tat-te dhāma nirasta-sarva-śamalaṁ vaikuṇṭha-rūpaṁ jayet||
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.yasmin vismayanīyadivyavibhavaṁ tatte pa: yasmin vismayanīya-divya-vibhavaṁ tatte padaṁ dehi me||
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.viśveṣāṁ tava rūpamaikṣata vidhistatte v: viśveṣāṁ tava rūpam-aikṣata vidhis-tat-te vibho bhātu me||
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.jānāsyeva manīṣitaṁ mama vibho jñānaṁ ta: jānāsy-eva manīṣitaṁ mama vibho jñānaṁ tad-āpādaya
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.ātāmre caraṇe vinamramatha taṁ hastena h: ātāmre caraṇe vinamram-atha taṁ hastena haste spṛśan
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.ityābhāṣya giraṁ pratoṣya nitarāṁ taccit: ity-ābhāṣya giraṁ pratoṣya nitarāṁ tac-citta-rūḍhaḥ svayaṁ

vishnu/narayaniyam/008_dasakam_08_pralay.tavaiva veṣe phaṇirājiśeṣe jalaikaśeṣe b: tavaiva veṣe phaṇi-rāji-śeṣe jalaika-śeṣe bhuvane sma śeṣe|
vishnu/narayaniyam/008_dasakam_08_pralay.caturyugāṇāṁ ca sahasramevaṁ tvayi prasu: catur-yugāṇāṁ ca sahasram-evaṁ tvayi prasupte punar-advitīye|
vishnu/narayaniyam/008_dasakam_08_pralay.samphullapatre nitarāṁ vicitre tasmin bh: samphulla-patre nitarāṁ vicitre tasmin bhavad-vīrya-dhṛte saroje|
vishnu/narayaniyam/008_dasakam_08_pralay.anantabhūmā mama rogarāśiṁ nirundhi vātā: ananta-bhūmā mama roga-rāśiṁ nirundhi vātālaya-vāsa viṣṇo||

vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.vilokya tadupāśrayaṁ tava tanuṁ tu nālok: vilokya tad-upāśrayaṁ tava tanuṁ tu nālokayan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.amuṣya hi saroruhaḥ kimapi kāraṇaṁ sambh: amuṣya hi saroruhaḥ kimapi kāraṇaṁ sambhaved-iti sma kṛta-niścayaḥ sa khalu nāla-randhrādhvanā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.svayogabalavidyayā samavarūḍhavān prauḍh: sva-yoga-bala-vidyayā samavarūḍhavān prauḍha-dhīs-tvadīyam-atimohanaṁ na tu kalevaraṁ dṛṣṭavān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.hare jaya jaya prabho padamupaiṣi diṣṭyā: hare jaya jaya prabho padam-upaiṣi diṣṭyā dṛśoḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.kuruṣva dhiyamāśu me bhuvananirmitau kar: kuruṣva dhiyam-āśu me bhuvana-nirmitau karmaṭhām-iti druhiṇavarṇitasvaguṇabṛṁhimā pāhi mām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.gṛhāṇa madanugrahaṁ kuru tapaśca bhūyo v: gṛhāṇa mad-anugrahaṁ kuru tapaś-ca bhūyo vidhe|
vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.bhavatvakhilasādhanī mayi ca bhaktiratyu: bhavatv-akhila-sādhanī mayi ca bhaktir-atyutkaṭety-udīrya giram-ādadhā mudita-cetasaṁ vedhasam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.śataṁ kṛtatapāstataḥ sa khalu divyasaṁva: śataṁ kṛta-tapās-tataḥ sa khalu divya-saṁvatsarān-avāpya ca tapo-balaṁ mati-balaṁ ca pūrvādhikam|

vishnu/narayaniyam/010_dasakam_10_srisht.te sṛṣṭikarmaṇi tu tena niyujyamānāstvat: te sṛṣṭi-karmaṇi tu tena niyujyamānās-tvat-pāda-bhakti-rasikā jagṛhur-na vāṇīm||
vishnu/narayaniyam/010_dasakam_10_srisht.nāmāni me kuru padāni ca hā viriñcetyāda: nāmāni me kuru padāni ca hā viriñcetyādau ruroda kila tena sa rudra-nāmā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/010_dasakam_10_srisht.mā mā prajāḥ sṛja tapaścara maṅgalāyetyā: mā mā prajāḥ sṛja tapaś-cara maṅgalāyety-ācaṣṭa taṁ kamala-bhūr-bhavad-īritātmā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/010_dasakam_10_srisht.tasyātha sargarasikasya marīciratristatr: tasyātha sarga-rasikasya marīcir-atris-tatrāṅgirāḥ kratu-muniḥ pulahaḥ pulastyaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/010_dasakam_10_srisht.putreṣu teṣu vinidhāya sa sargavṛddhimap: putreṣu teṣu vinidhāya sa sarga-vṛddhim-aprāpnuvaṁs-tava padāmbujam-āśrito'bhūt||

vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.krameṇa sarge parivardhamāne kadāpi divy: krameṇa sarge parivardhamāne kadāpi divyāḥ sanakādayas-te|
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.anaupamaṁ taṁ bhavato niketaṁ munīśvarāḥ: anaupamaṁ taṁ bhavato niketaṁ munīśvarāḥ prāpur-atīta-kakṣyāḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.bhavaddidṛkṣūn bhavanaṁ vivikṣūn dvāḥsth: bhavad-didṛkṣūn bhavanaṁ vivikṣūn dvāḥsthau jayas-tān vijayo'py-arundhām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.teṣāṁ ca citte padamāpa kopaḥ sarvaṁ bha: teṣāṁ ca citte padam-āpa kopaḥ sarvaṁ bhavat-preraṇayaiva bhūman||
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.iti praśaptau bhavadāśrayau tau harismṛt: iti praśaptau bhavad-āśrayau tau hari-smṛtir-no'stv-iti nematus-tān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.prasādya gīrbhiḥ stuvato munīndrānananya: prasādya gīrbhiḥ stuvato munīndrān-ananya-nāthāv-atha pārṣadau tau|
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.hiraṇyapūrvaḥ kaśipuḥ kilaikaḥ paro hira: hiraṇya-pūrvaḥ kaśipuḥ kilaikaḥ paro hiraṇyākṣa iti pratītaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.bhavatpriyāṁ kṣmāṁ salile nimajjya cacār: bhavat-priyāṁ kṣmāṁ salile nimajjya cacāra garvād-vinadan gadāvān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.tato jaleśāt sadṛśaṁ bhavantaṁ niśamya b: tato jaleśāt sadṛśaṁ bhavantaṁ niśamya babhrāma gaveṣayaṁs-tvām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.bhaktaikadṛśyaḥ sa kṛpānidhistvaṁ nirund: bhaktaika-dṛśyaḥ sa kṛpā-nidhis-tvaṁ nirundhi rogān marud-ālayeśa||

vishnu/narayaniyam/012_dasakam_12_varaha.sraṣṭāramāpa śaraṇaṁ bhavadaṅghrisevātuṣ: sraṣṭāram-āpa śaraṇaṁ bhavad-aṅghri-sevā-tuṣṭāśayaṁ muni-janaiḥ saha satyaloke||
vishnu/narayaniyam/012_dasakam_12_varaha.ityevameṣa kathito manunā svayambhūrambh: ity-evam-eṣa kathito manunā svayambhūr-ambhoruhākṣa tava pāda-yugaṁ vyacintīt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/012_dasakam_12_varaha.hā hā vibho jalamahaṁ nyapibaṁ purastāda: hā hā vibho jalam-ahaṁ nyapibaṁ purastād-adyāpi majjati mahī kim-ahaṁ karomi|
vishnu/narayaniyam/012_dasakam_12_varaha.abhre tathāvidhamudīkṣya bhavantamuccair: abhre tathāvidham-udīkṣya bhavantam-uccair-vismeratāṁ vidhir-agāt saha sūnubhiḥ svaiḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/013_dasakam_13_hirany.nadan kvāsau kvāsāviti sa muninā darśita: nadan kvāsau kvāsāv-iti sa muninā darśita-patho
vishnu/narayaniyam/013_dasakam_13_hirany.aho āraṇyo'yaṁ mṛga iti hasantaṁ bahutar: aho āraṇyo'yaṁ mṛga iti hasantaṁ bahutaraiduruktairvidhyantaṁ diti-sutam-avajñāya bhagavan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/013_dasakam_13_hirany.mahīṁ dṛṣṭvā daṁṣṭrāśirasi cakitāṁ svena: mahīṁ dṛṣṭvā daṁṣṭrā-śirasi cakitāṁ svena mahasā
vishnu/narayaniyam/013_dasakam_13_hirany.samāruṣṭo muṣṭyā sa khalu vitudaṁstvāṁ s: samāruṣṭo muṣṭyā sa khalu vitudaṁs-tvāṁ samatanod
vishnu/narayaniyam/013_dasakam_13_hirany.grahā jihvāyāṁ te parapuruṣa karṇe ca ca: grahā jihvāyāṁ te para-puruṣa karṇe ca camasā

vishnu/narayaniyam/014_dasakam_14_kapila.nijamantaramantarāyahīnaṁ caritaṁ te kat: nijam-antaram-antarāya-hīnaṁ caritaṁ te kathayan sukhaṁ nināya||
vishnu/narayaniyam/014_dasakam_14_kapila.hasitollasitānanaṁ vibho tvaṁ vapurāviṣk: hasitollasitānanaṁ vibho tvaṁ vapur-āviṣkuruṣe sma kardamāya||
vishnu/narayaniyam/014_dasakam_14_kapila.stuvate pulakāvṛtāya tasmai manuputrīṁ d: stuvate pulakāvṛtāya tasmai manu-putrīṁ dayitāṁ navāpi putrīḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/014_dasakam_14_kapila.śatavarṣamatha vyatītya so'yannava kanyā: śata-varṣam-atha vyatītya so'yan-nava kanyāḥ samavāpya dhanya-rūpāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/014_dasakam_14_kapila.kapilātmaka vāyumandireśa tvaritaṁ tvaṁ: kapilātmaka vāyu-mandireśa tvaritaṁ tvaṁ paripāhi māṁ gadaughāt||

vishnu/narayaniyam/015_dasakam_15_kapila.prakṛtimahadahaṅkārāśca mātrāśca bhūtāny: prakṛti-mahad-ahaṅkārāś-ca mātrāś-ca bhūtāny-api hṛdapi daśākṣī pūruṣaḥ pañcaviṁśaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/015_dasakam_15_kapila.yadi tu sajati tasyāṁ tadguṇāstaṁ bhajer: yadi tu sajati tasyāṁ tad-guṇās-taṁ bhajeran|
vishnu/narayaniyam/015_dasakam_15_kapila.vadasi khalu dṛḍhaṁ tvaṁ tadvidhūyāmayān: vadasi khalu dṛḍhaṁ tvaṁ tad-vidhūyāmayān me

vishnu/narayaniyam/016_dasakam_16_nara_n.dattāṁ tvayā ca jagṛhustrapayaiva sarvas: dattāṁ tvayā ca jagṛhus-trapayaiva sarva-svarvāsi-garva-śamanīṁ punar-urvaśīṁ tām||

vishnu/narayaniyam/017_dasakam_17_dhruva.reme ciraṁ bhavadanugrahapūrṇakāmastāte: reme ciraṁ bhavad-anugraha-pūrṇa-kāmas-tāte gate ca vanam-āhṛta-rājya-bhāraḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/018_dasakam_18_prithu.jātasya dhruvakula eva tuṅgakīrteraṅgasy: jātasya dhruva-kula eva tuṅga-kīrter-aṅgasya vyajani sutaḥ sa vena-nāmā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/018_dasakam_18_prithu.taddoṣavyathitamatiḥ sa rājavaryastvatpā: tad-doṣa-vyathita-matiḥ sa rāja-varyas-tvat-pāde nihita-manā vanaṁ gato'bhūt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/018_dasakam_18_prithu.satrasthaṁ muninivahaṁ hitāni śaṁsannaik: satra-sthaṁ muni-nivahaṁ hitāni śaṁsannaikṣiṣṭhāḥ sanaka-mukhān munīn purastāt||

vishnu/narayaniyam/019_dasakam_19_prache.pituḥ sisṛkṣāniratasya śāsanād bhavattap: pituḥ sisṛkṣā-niratasya śāsanād bhavat-tapasyābhiratā daśāpi te|
vishnu/narayaniyam/019_dasakam_19_prache.bhavadvicintāpi śivāya dehināṁ bhavatvas: bhavad-vicintāpi śivāya dehināṁ bhavatv-asau rudra-nutiś-ca kāmadā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/019_dasakam_19_prache.tataśca te bhūtalarodhinaḥ tarūn krudhā: tataś-ca te bhūtala-rodhinaḥ tarūn krudhā dahanto druhiṇena vāritāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/019_dasakam_19_prache.drumaiśca dattāṁ tanayāmavāpya tāṁ tvadu: drumaiś-ca dattāṁ tanayām-avāpya tāṁ tvad-ukta-kālaṁ sukhino'bhiremire||
vishnu/narayaniyam/019_dasakam_19_prache.avāpya dakṣaṁ ca sutaṁ kṛtādhvarāḥ prace: avāpya dakṣaṁ ca sutaṁ kṛtādhvarāḥ pracetaso nārada-labdhayā dhiyā|

vishnu/narayaniyam/020_dasakam_20_rishab.tvayi trilokībhṛti rājyabhāraṁ nidhāya n: tvayi trilokī-bhṛti rājya-bhāraṁ nidhāya nābhiḥ saha merudevyā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/020_dasakam_20_rishab.tapovanaṁ prāpya bhavanniṣevī gataḥ kilā: tapo-vanaṁ prāpya bhavan-niṣevī gataḥ kilānanda-padaṁ padaṁ te||
vishnu/narayaniyam/020_dasakam_20_rishab.yadā tadā tvaṁ nijayogaśaktyā svavarṣame: yadā tadā tvaṁ nija-yoga-śaktyā sva-varṣam-enad-vyadadhāḥ suvarṣam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/020_dasakam_20_rishab.śayuvrataṁ gomṛgakākacaryāṁ ciraṁ carann: śayu-vrataṁ go-mṛga-kāka-caryāṁ ciraṁ carann-āpya paraṁ svarūpam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/020_dasakam_20_rishab.davāhatāṅgaḥ kuṭakācale tvaṁ tāpān mamāp: davāhatāṅgaḥ kuṭakācale tvaṁ tāpān mamāpākuru vāta-nātha||

vishnu/narayaniyam/021_dasakam_21_jambud.nīlāmbaraṁ dhṛtahalaṁ bhujagāṅganābhirju: nīlāmbaraṁ dhṛta-halaṁ bhujagāṅganābhir-juṣṭaṁ bhaje hara gadān guru-geha-nātha||

vishnu/narayaniyam/022_dasakam_22_ajamil.adharmakārī daśamī bhavan punardadhau bh: adharma-kārī daśamī bhavan punar-dadhau bhavan-nāma-yute sute ratim||
vishnu/narayaniyam/022_dasakam_22_ajamil.na niṣkṛtiḥ kiṁ viditā bhavādṛśāmiti pra: na niṣkṛtiḥ kiṁ viditā bhavādṛśām-iti prabho tvat-puruṣā babhāṣire||
vishnu/narayaniyam/022_dasakam_22_ajamil.anantasevā tu nikṛntati dvayīmiti prabho: ananta-sevā tu nikṛntati dvayīmiti prabho tvat-puruṣā babhāṣire||
vishnu/narayaniyam/022_dasakam_22_ajamil.yadagrahīnnāma bhayākulo hareriti prabho: yad-agrahīn-nāma bhayākulo harer-iti prabho tvat-puruṣā babhāṣire||
vishnu/narayaniyam/022_dasakam_22_ajamil.yathāgniredhāṁsi yathauṣadhaṁ gadāniti p: yathāgniredhāṁsi yathauṣadhaṁ gadān-iti prabho tvat-puruṣā babhāṣire||

vishnu/narayaniyam/023_dasakam_23_chitra.prācetasastu bhagavannaparo hi dakṣastva: prācetasas-tu bhagavann-aparo hi dakṣas-tvat-sevanaṁ vyadhita sarga-vivṛddhi-kāmaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/023_dasakam_23_chitra.āvirbabhūvitha tadā lasadaṣṭabāhustasmai: āvirbabhūvitha tadā lasad-aṣṭa-bāhus-tasmai varaṁ daditha tāṁ ca vadhūm-asiknīm||
vishnu/narayaniyam/023_dasakam_23_chitra.|| iti dakṣacaritaṁ citraketūpākhyānaṁ v: || iti dakṣa-caritaṁ citraketūpākhyānaṁ vṛtra-vadha-varṇanaṁ marutām-utpatti-kathanaṁ ca trayoviṁśatitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/024_dasakam_24_prahla.nihantuṁ tvāṁ bhūyastava padamavāptasya: nihantuṁ tvāṁ bhūyas-tava padam-avāptasya ca ripor-bahirdṛṣṭer-antardadhitha hṛdaye sūkṣma-vapuṣā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/024_dasakam_24_prahla.sa vai jātyā daityaḥ śiśurapi sametya tv: sa vai jātyā daityaḥ śiśur-api sametya tvayi ratiṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/024_dasakam_24_prahla.guruproktaṁ cāsāvidamidamabhadrāya dṛḍha: guru-proktaṁ cāsāv-idam-idam-abhadrāya dṛḍham-ity-apākurvan sarvaṁ tava caraṇa-bhaktyaiva vavṛdhe||
vishnu/narayaniyam/024_dasakam_24_prahla.balaṁ me vaikuṇṭhastava ca jagatāṁ cāpi: balaṁ me vaikuṇṭhas-tava ca jagatāṁ cāpi sa balaṁ

vishnu/narayaniyam/025_dasakam_25_narasi.śrutvā yaṁ kila daityarājahṛdaye pūrvaṁ: śrutvā yaṁ kila daitya-rāja-hṛdaye pūrvaṁ kadāpy-aśrutaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/025_dasakam_25_narasi.sambhūtaṁ na mṛgātmakaṁ na manujākāraṁ v: sambhūtaṁ na mṛgātmakaṁ na manujākāraṁ vapus-te vibho|
vishnu/narayaniyam/025_dasakam_25_narasi.bhrāmyantaṁ ditijādhamaṁ punarapi prodgṛ: bhrāmyantaṁ ditijādhamaṁ punar-api prodgṛhya dorbhyāṁ javād
vishnu/narayaniyam/025_dasakam_25_narasi.śāntastvaṁ karamasya mūrdhni samadhāḥ st: śāntas-tvaṁ karam-asya mūrdhni samadhāḥ stotrair-athodgāyatas-tasyākāma-dhiyo'pi tenitha varaṁ lokāya cānugraham||

vishnu/narayaniyam/026_dasakam_26_gajend.etadvṛttaṁ tvāṁ ca māṁ ca prage yo: etad-vṛttaṁ tvāṁ ca māṁ ca prage yo

vishnu/narayaniyam/028_dasakam_28_lakshm.jagadīśa bhavatparā tadānīṁ kamanīyā kam: jagad-īśa bhavat-parā tadānīṁ kamanīyā kamalā babhūva devī|
vishnu/narayaniyam/028_dasakam_28_lakshm.amalāmavalokya yāṁ vilolaḥ sakalo'pi spṛ: amalām-avalokya yāṁ vilolaḥ sakalo'pi spṛhayāmbabhūva lokaḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/028_dasakam_28_lakshm.tvayi dattahṛde tadaiva devyai tridaśend: tvayi datta-hṛde tadaiva devyai tridaśendro maṇi-pīṭhikāṁ vyatārīt|
vishnu/narayaniyam/028_dasakam_28_lakshm.avamṛśya sadaiva sarvaramye nihitā tvayy: avamṛśya sadaiva sarva-ramye nihitā tvayy-anayāpi divya-mālā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/028_dasakam_28_lakshm.atimohanavibhramā tadānīṁ madayantī khal: atimohana-vibhramā tadānīṁ madayantī khalu vāruṇī nirāgāt|
vishnu/narayaniyam/028_dasakam_28_lakshm.amṛtaṁ kalaśe vahan karābhyāmakhilārtiṁ: amṛtaṁ kalaśe vahan karābhyām-akhilārtiṁ hara mārutālayeśa||
vishnu/narayaniyam/028_dasakam_28_lakshm.|| iti amṛtamathane kālakūṭotpattivarṇan: || iti amṛta-mathane kālakūṭotpatti-varṇanaṁ lakṣmī-svayaṁvara-varṇanam amṛtotpatti-varṇanaṁ ca aṣṭāviṁśatitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/029_dasakam_29_vishnu.ghore'tha mūrcchati raṇe balidaityamāyāv: ghore'tha mūrcchati raṇe bali-daitya-māyā-vyāmohite sura-gaṇe tvam-ihāvirāsīḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/030_dasakam_30_vamana.tāṁ narmadottarataṭe hayamedhaśālāmāsedu: tāṁ narmadottara-taṭe hayamedha-śālām-āseduṣi tvayi rucā tava ruddha-netraiḥ|

vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.mattaḥ kiṁ te samabhilaṣitaṁ viprasūno v: mattaḥ kiṁ te samabhilaṣitaṁ vipra-sūno vada tvaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.vittaṁ bhaktaṁ bhavanamavaniṁ vāpi sarva: vittaṁ bhaktaṁ bhavanam-avaniṁ vāpi sarvaṁ pradāsye||
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.tāmakṣīṇāṁ baligiramupākarṇya kāruṇyapūr: tām-akṣīṇāṁ bali-giram-upākarṇya kāruṇya-pūrṇo'py-asyotsekaṁ śamayitu-manā daitya-vaṁśaṁ praśaṁsan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.viśveśaṁ māṁ tripadamiha kiṁ yācase bāli: viśveśaṁ māṁ tripadam-iha kiṁ yācase bāliśas-tvaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.sarvāṁ bhūmiṁ vṛṇu kimamunetyālapattvāṁ: sarvāṁ bhūmiṁ vṛṇu kim-amunety-ālapat-tvāṁ sa dṛpyan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.pādatrayyā yadi na mudito viṣṭapairnāpi: pāda-trayyā yadi na mudito viṣṭapair-nāpi tuṣyed-ity-ukte'smin varada bhavate dātukāme'tha toyam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.yācatyevaṁ yadi sa bhagavān pūrṇakāmo'sm: yācatyevaṁ yadi sa bhagavān pūrṇa-kāmo'smi so'haṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.divyaṁ rūpaṁ tava ca tadidaṁ paśyatāṁ vi: divyaṁ rūpaṁ tava ca tad-idaṁ paśyatāṁ viśva-bhājām-uccair-uccair-avṛdhad-avadhīkṛtya viśvāṇḍa-bhāṇḍam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.kālātmāyaṁ vasati purato yadvaśāt prāgji: kālātmāyaṁ vasati purato yad-vaśāt prāg-jitāḥ smaḥ
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.kiṁ vo yuddhairiti baligirā te'tha pātāl: kiṁ vo yuddhair-iti bali-girā te'tha pātālam-āpuḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.pāśairbaddhaṁ patagapatinā daityamuccair: pāśair-baddhaṁ pataga-patinā daityam-uccair-avādīs-tārttīyīkaṁ diśa mama padaṁ kiṁ na viśveśvaro'si|
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.darpocchittyai vihitamakhilaṁ daitya sid: darpocchittyai vihitam-akhilaṁ daitya siddho'si puṇyair-lokas-te'stu tridiva-vijayī vāsavatvaṁ ca paścāt|
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.matsāyujyaṁ bhaja ca punarityanvagṛhṇā b: mat-sāyujyaṁ bhaja ca punar-ity-anvagṛhṇā baliṁ taṁ

vishnu/narayaniyam/032_dasakam_32_matsya.kṣiptaṁ jale tvāṁ cakitaṁ vilokya ninye': kṣiptaṁ jale tvāṁ cakitaṁ vilokya ninye'mbu-pātreṇa muniḥ sva-geham|
vishnu/narayaniyam/032_dasakam_32_matsya.svalpairahobhiḥ kalaśīṁ ca kūpaṁ vāpīṁ s: svalpair-ahobhiḥ kalaśīṁ ca kūpaṁ vāpīṁ saraś-cānaśiṣe vibho tvam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/032_dasakam_32_matsya.nirīkṣya tuṣṭā munayastvaduktyā tvattuṅg: nirīkṣya tuṣṭā munayas-tvad-uktyā tvat-tuṅga-śṛṅge taraṇiṁ babandhuḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/032_dasakam_32_matsya.saṁstūyamāno nṛvareṇa tena jñānaṁ paraṁ: saṁstūyamāno nṛ-vareṇa tena jñānaṁ paraṁ copadiśann-acārīḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/032_dasakam_32_matsya.kalpāvadhau sapta munīn purovat prasthāp: kalpāvadhau sapta munīn purovat prasthāpya satyavrata-bhūmipaṁ tam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/032_dasakam_32_matsya.svatuṅgaśṛṅgakṣatavakṣasaṁ taṁ nipātya d: sva-tuṅga-śṛṅga-kṣata-vakṣasaṁ taṁ nipātya daityaṁ nigamān gṛhītvā|

vishnu/narayaniyam/033_dasakam_33_ambari.kṛtyāṁ ca tāmasidharāṁ bhuvanaṁ dahantīm: kṛtyāṁ ca tāmasidharāṁ bhuvanaṁ dahantīm-agre'bhivīkṣya nṛpatir-na padāc-cakampe|
vishnu/narayaniyam/033_dasakam_33_ambari.sāyujyamāpa ca sa māṁ pavaneśa pāyāḥ||: sāyujyam-āpa ca sa māṁ pavaneśa pāyāḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.tadbhuktyā tatpurandhrīṣvapi tisṛṣu sama: tad-bhuktyā tat-purandhrīṣv-api tisṛṣu samaṁ jāta-garbhāsu jāto
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.kalyāṁ kurvannahalyāṁ pathi padarajasā p: kalyāṁ kurvann-ahalyāṁ pathi pada-rajasā prāpya vaideha-geham|
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.rājyaṁ prātiṣṭhathāstvaṁ tribhirapi ca s: rājyaṁ prātiṣṭhathās-tvaṁ tribhir-api ca samaṁ bhrātṛ-vīraiḥ sadāraiḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.yāte yāto'syayodhyāṁ sukhamiha nivasan k: yāte yāto'syayodhyāṁ sukham-iha nivasan kāntayā kānta-mūrtte|
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.nāvā saṁtīrya gaṅgāmadhipadavi punastaṁ: nāvā saṁtīrya gaṅgāmadhipadavi punas-taṁ bharadvājamārāntvā tad-vākya-hetor-atisukham-avasaś-citrakūṭe girīndre||
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.śrutvā putrārtikhinnaṁ khalu bharatamukh: śrutvā putrārti-khinnaṁ khalu bharata-mukhāt svarga-yātaṁ sva-tātaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.atriṁ natvātha gatvā vanamativipulaṁ daṇ: atriṁ natvātha gatvā vanam-ativipulaṁ daṇḍakaṁ caṇḍa-kāyaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.hatvā daityaṁ virādhaṁ sugatimakalayaścā: hatvā daityaṁ virādhaṁ sugatim-akalayaś-cāru bho śārabhaṅgīm||
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.pratyaśrauṣīḥ priyaiṣī tadanu ca muninā: pratyaśrauṣīḥ priyaiṣī tadanu ca muninā vaiṣṇave divya-cāpe|
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.brahmāstre cāpi datte pathi pitṛsuhṛdaṁ: brahmāstre cāpi datte pathi pitṛ-suhṛdaṁ vīkṣya bhūyo jaṭāyuṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.modād godātaṭānte pariramasi purā pañcav: modād godā-taṭānte pariramasi purā pañcavaṭyāṁ vadhūṭyā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.tāṁ saumitrau visṛjya prabalatamaruṣā te: tāṁ saumitrau visṛjya prabalatama-ruṣā tena nirlūna-nāsām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.dṛṣṭvaināṁ ruṣṭacittaṁ kharamabhipatitaṁ: dṛṣṭvaināṁ ruṣṭa-cittaṁ kharam-abhipatitaṁ dūṣaṇaṁ ca trimūrddhaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.bhūyastanvīṁ vicinvannahṛta daśamukhastv: bhūyas-tanvīṁ vicinvann-ahṛta daśamukhas-tvad-vadhūṁ mad-vadhenety-uktvā yāte jaṭāyau divam-atha suhṛdaḥ prātanoḥ preta-kāryam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.gṛhṇānaṁ taṁ kabandhaṁ jaghanitha śabarī: gṛhṇānaṁ taṁ kabandhaṁ jaghanitha śabarīṁ prekṣya pampā-taṭe tvaṁ

vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.nītaḥ sugrīvamaitrīṁ tadanu hanumatā dun: nītaḥ sugrīva-maitrīṁ tadanu hanumatā dundubheḥ kāyam-uccaiḥ
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.kṣiptvāṅguṣṭhena bhūyo luluvitha yugapat: kṣiptvāṅguṣṭhena bhūyo luluvitha yugapat-patriṇā sapta sālān|
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.sugrīveṇānujoktyā sabhayamabhiyatā vyūhi: sugrīveṇānujoktyā sabhayam-abhiyatā vyūhitāṁ vāhinīṁ tām-ṛkṣāṇāṁ vīkṣya dikṣu drutam-atha dayitā-mārgaṇāyāvanamrām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.mārge mārge mamārge kapibhirapi tadā tva: mārge mārge mamārge kapibhir-api tadā tvat-priyā saprayāsaiḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.dṛṣṭvā pluṣṭvā ca laṅkāṁ jhaṭiti sa hanu: dṛṣṭvā pluṣṭvā ca laṅkāṁ jhaṭiti sa hanumān mauli-ratnaṁ dadau te||
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.tatproktāṁ śatruvārtāṁ rahasi niśamayan: tat-proktāṁ śatru-vārtāṁ rahasi niśamayan prārthanāpārthya-roṣa-prastāgneyāstra-tejas-trasad-udadhi-girā labdhavān madhya-mārgam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.vyākurvan sānujastvaṁ samarabhuvi paraṁ: vyākurvan sānujastvaṁ samara-bhuvi paraṁ vikramaṁ śakra-jetrā
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.prīto divyābhiṣekairayutasamadhikān vats: prīto divyābhiṣekair-ayuta-samadhikān vatsarān paryaraṁsīmaithilyāṁ pāpa-vācā śiva! śiva! kila tāṁ garbhiṇīm-abhyahāsīḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.sītāṁ tvayyāsukāme kṣitimaviśadasau tvaṁ: sītāṁ tvayy-āsukāme kṣitim-aviśad-asau tvaṁ ca kālārthito'bhūḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.sākaṁ nākaṁ prayāto nijapadamagamo deva: sākaṁ nākaṁ prayāto nija-padam-agamo deva vaikuṇṭham-ādyam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.no cetsvātmānubhūteḥ kva nu tava manaso: no cet-svātmānubhūteḥ kva nu tava manaso vikriyā cakra-pāṇe
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.sa tvaṁ sattvaikamūrte pavanapurapate vy: sa tvaṁ sattvaika-mūrte pavana-pura-pate vyādhunu vyādhi-tāpān||

vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.atreḥ putratayā purā tvamanasūyāyāṁ hi d: atreḥ putratayā purā tvam-anasūyāyāṁ hi dattābhidho
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.dṛṣṭo bhaktatamena haihayamahīpālena tas: dṛṣṭo bhaktatamena haihaya-mahīpālena tasmai varān-aṣṭaiśvarya-mukhān pradāya daditha svenaiva cānte vadham||
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.brahmadveṣi tadākhilaṁ nṛpakulaṁ hantuṁ: brahma-dveṣi tadākhilaṁ nṛpa-kulaṁ hantuṁ ca bhūmer-bharam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.saṁjāto jamadagnito bhṛgukule tvaṁ reṇuk: saṁjāto jamadagnito bhṛgu-kule tvaṁ reṇukāyāṁ hare
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.labdhāmnāyagaṇaścaturdaśavayā gandharvar: labdhāmnāya-gaṇaś-caturdaśa-vayā gandharva-rāje manāg-āsaktāṁ kila mātaraṁ prati pituḥ krodhākulasyājñayā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.tātājñātigasodaraiḥ samamimāṁ chittvātha: tātājñātiga-sodaraiḥ samam-imāṁ chittvātha śāntāt pitus-teṣāṁ jīvana-yogam-āpitha varaṁ mātā ca te'dād-varān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.cakre tvayyatha vaiṣṇave'pi viphale budd: cakre tvayy-atha vaiṣṇave'pi viphale buddhvā hariṁ tvāṁ mudā
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.bhūyo'marṣitahaihayātmajagaṇaistāte hate: bhūyo'marṣita-haihayātmaja-gaṇais-tāte hate reṇukāmāghnānāṁ hṛdayaṁ nirīkṣya bahuśo ghorāṁ pratijñāṁ vahan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.yajñe kṣmāmapi kāśyapādiṣu diśan śālvena: yajñe kṣmām-api kāśyapādiṣu diśan śālvena yudhyan punaḥ
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.dhyāteṣvāsadhṛtānalāstracakitaṁ sindhuṁ: dhyāteṣvāsa-dhṛtānalāstra-cakitaṁ sindhuṁ sruva-kṣepaṇād-utsāryoddhṛta-keralo bhṛgu-pate vāteśa saṁrakṣa mām||

vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.sāndrānandatano hare nanu purā daivāsure: sāndrānanda-tano hare nanu purā daivāsure saṅgare
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.tvatkṛttā api karmaśeṣavaśato ye te na y: tvat-kṛttā api karma-śeṣa-vaśato ye te na yātā gatim|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.hā hā durjanabhūribhāramathitāṁ pāthonid: hā hā durjana-bhūri-bhāra-mathitāṁ pātho-nidhau pātukām-etāṁ pālaya hanta me vivaśatāṁ sampṛccha devān-imān|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.ūce cāmbujabhūramūnayi surāḥ satyaṁ dhar: ūce cāmbuja-bhūr-amūn-ayi surāḥ satyaṁ dharitryā vaco
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.nanvasyā bhavatāṁ ca rakṣaṇavidhau dakṣo: nanv-asyā bhavatāṁ ca rakṣaṇa-vidhau dakṣo hi lakṣmī-patiḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.tvadvācaṁ hṛdaye niśamya sakalānānandaya: tvad-vācaṁ hṛdaye niśamya sakalān-ānandayann-ūcivān-ākhyātaḥ paramātmanā svayam-ahaṁ vākyaṁ tad-ākarṇyatām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.jāne dīnadaśāmahaṁ diviṣadāṁ bhūmeśca bh: jāne dīna-daśām-ahaṁ diviṣadāṁ bhūmeś-ca bhīmair-nṛpais-tat-kṣepāya bhavāmi yādava-kule so'haṁ samagrātmanā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.śrutvā karṇarasāyanaṁ tava vacaḥ sarveṣu: śrutvā karṇa-rasāyanaṁ tava vacaḥ sarveṣu nirvāpita-svānteṣv-īśa gateṣu tāvaka-kṛpā-pīyūṣa-tṛptātmasu|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.udvāhāvasitau tadīyasahajaḥ kaṁso'tha sa: udvāhāvasitau tadīya-sahajaḥ kaṁso'tha sammānayann-etau sūtatayā gataḥ pathi rathe vyomotthayā tvad-girā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.saṁtrāsāt sa tu hantumantikagatāṁ tanvīṁ: saṁtrāsāt sa tu hantum-antika-gatāṁ tanvīṁ kṛpāṇīm-adhāt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.gṛhṇānaścikureṣu tāṁ khalamatiḥ śaureści: gṛhṇānaś-cikureṣu tāṁ khala-matiḥ śaureś-ciraṁ sāntvanainoṁ muñcan punar-ātmajārpaṇa-girā prīto'tha yāto gṛhān|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.duṣṭānāmapi deva puṣṭakaruṇā dṛṣṭā hi dh: duṣṭānām-api deva puṣṭa-karuṇā dṛṣṭā hi dhīr-ekadā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.yūyaṁ nanvasurāḥ surāśca yadavo jānāsi k: yūyaṁ nanv-asurāḥ surāś-ca yadavo jānāsi kiṁ na prabho|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.māyāvī sa harirbhavadvadhakṛte bhāvī sur: māyāvī sa harir-bhavad-vadha-kṛte bhāvī sura-prārthanād-ity-ākarṇya yadūn-adūdhunad-asau śaureś-ca sūnūn-ahan||
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.nīte mādhava rohiṇīṁ tvamapi bhoḥ saccit: nīte mādhava rohiṇīṁ tvam-api bhoḥ saccit-sukhaikātmakaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.sa tvaṁ kṛṣṇa vidhūya rogapaṭalīṁ bhakti: sa tvaṁ kṛṣṇa vidhūya roga-paṭalīṁ bhaktiṁ parāṁ dehi me||

vishnu/narayaniyam/038_dasakam_38_krishn.deva prasīda parapūruṣa tāpavallīnirlūna: deva prasīda para-pūruṣa tāpa-vallī-nirlūna-dātra sama-netra kalā-vilāsin|
vishnu/narayaniyam/038_dasakam_38_krishn.khedānapākuru kṛpāgurubhiḥ kaṭākṣairityā: khedān-apākuru kṛpā-gurubhiḥ kaṭākṣair-ityādi tena muditena ciraṁ nuto'bhūḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/039_dasakam_39_yogama.vimuktacikurotkarastvaritamāpatan bhojar: vimukta-cikurotkaras-tvaritam-āpatan bhoja-rāḍ-atuṣṭa iva dṛṣṭavān bhaginikā-kare kanyakām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/039_dasakam_39_yogama.dhruvaṁ kapaṭaśālino madhuharasya māyā b: dhruvaṁ kapaṭa-śālino madhu-harasya māyā bhaved-asāv-iti kiśorikāṁ bhaginikā-karāliṅgitām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/039_dasakam_39_yogama.adhastalamajagmuṣī vikasadaṣṭabāhusphura: adhastalam-ajagmuṣī vikasad-aṣṭa-bāhu-sphuran-mahāyudham-aho gatā kila vihāyasā didyute||
vishnu/narayaniyam/039_dasakam_39_yogama.babhūva bhavadantakaḥ kvacana cintyatāṁ: babhūva bhavad-antakaḥ kvacana cintyatāṁ te hitam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/039_dasakam_39_yogama.iti tvadanujā vibho khalamudīrya taṁ jag: iti tvad-anujā vibho khalam-udīrya taṁ jagmuṣī
vishnu/narayaniyam/039_dasakam_39_yogama.tataḥ paśupamandire tvayi mukunda nandap: tataḥ paśupa-mandire tvayi mukunda nanda-priyā-prasūti-śayaneśaye rudati kiñcid-añcat-pade|
vishnu/narayaniyam/039_dasakam_39_yogama.punaḥ stanabharaṁ nijaṁ sapadi pāyayanty: punaḥ stana-bharaṁ nijaṁ sapadi pāyayantyā mudā
