vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.yadbhītyodeti sūryo dahati ca dahano vāt: yad-bhītyodeti sūryo dahati ca dahano vāti vāyus-tathānye
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.yenaivāropitāḥ prāṅnijapadamapi te cyāvi: yenaivāropitāḥ prāṅ-nija-padam-api te cyāvitāraś-ca paścāt-tasmai viśvaṁ niyantre vayam-api bhavate kṛṣṇa kurmaḥ praṇāmam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.satyaṁ śuddhaṁ vibuddhaṁ jayati tava vap: satyaṁ śuddhaṁ vibuddhaṁ jayati tava vapur-nitya-muktaṁ nirīhaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.nirmūlaṁ nirmalaṁ tanniravadhimahimollās: nirmūlaṁ nirmalaṁ tan-niravadhi-mahimollāsi nillīnam-antar-nissaṅgānāṁ munīnāṁ nirupama-paramānanda-sāndra-prakāśam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.cakraṁ te kālarūpaṁ vyathayatu na tu māṁ: cakraṁ te kāla-rūpaṁ vyathayatu na tu māṁ tvat-padaikāvalambaṁ

vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.viṣṇorvīryāṇi ko vā kathayatu dharaṇeḥ k: viṣṇor-vīryāṇi ko vā kathayatu dharaṇeḥ kaśca reṇūn-mimīte
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.yo'sau viśvāni dhatte priyamiha paramaṁ: yo'sau viśvāni dhatte priyam-iha paramaṁ dhāma tasyābhiyāyāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.ādyāyāśeṣakartre pratinimiṣanavīnāya bha: ādyāyāśeṣa-kartre pratinimiṣa-navīnāya bhartre vibhūter-bhaktātmā viṣṇave yaḥ pradiśati havir-ādīni yajñārcanādau|
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.kṛṣṇādyaṁ janma yo vā mahadiha mahato va: kṛṣṇādyaṁ janma yo vā mahad-iha mahato varṇayet so'yam-eva
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.prītaḥ pūrṇo yaśobhistvaritamabhisaret p: prītaḥ pūrṇo yaśobhis-tvaritam-abhisaret prāpyam-ante padaṁ tat||
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.he stotāraḥ kavīndrāstamiha khalu yathā: he stotāraḥ kavīndrās-tam-iha khalu yathā cetayadhve tathaiva
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.he viṣṇo kīrtanādyaistava khalu mahatast: he viṣṇo kīrtanādyais-tava khalu mahatas-tattva-bodhaṁ bhajeyam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.yānīndrasyaiṣa bhṛtyaḥ priyasakha iva ca: yānīndrasyaiṣa bhṛtyaḥ priya-sakha iva ca vyātanot kṣema-kārī|
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.deva śreyāṁsi vidvān pratimuhurapi te nā: deva śreyāṁsi vidvān pratimuhur-api te nāma śaṁsāmi viṣṇo|
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.taṁ tvāṁ saṁstaumi nānāvidhanutivacanair: taṁ tvāṁ saṁstaumi nānā-vidha-nuti-vacanair-asya loka-trayasyāpy-ūrdhvaṁ vibhrājamāne viracita-vasatiṁ tatra vaikuṇṭha-loke||
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.āpaḥ sṛṣṭyādijanyāḥ prathamamayi vibho g: āpaḥ sṛṣṭyādi-janyāḥ prathamam-ayi vibho garbha-deśe dadhus-tvāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.yatra tvayyeva jīvā jalaśayana hare saṅg: yatra tvayy-eva jīvā jala-śayana hare saṅgatā aikyam-āpan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.tasyājasya prabho te vinihitamabhavat pa: tasyājasya prabho te vinihitam-abhavat padmam-ekaṁ hi nābhau
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.he lokā viṣṇuretadbhuvanamajanayat tanna: he lokā viṣṇur-etad-bhuvanam-ajanayat tanna jānītha yūyaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.yuṣmākaṁ hyantarasthaṁ kimapi tadaparaṁ: yuṣmākaṁ hy-antara-sthaṁ kimapi tad-aparaṁ vidyate viṣṇu-rūpam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.mūrddhāmakṣṇāṁ padānāṁ vahasi khalu saha: mūrddhām-akṣṇāṁ padānāṁ vahasi khalu sahasrāṇi sampūrya viśvaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ ca sarvaṁ parapuruṣa bhav: bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ ca sarvaṁ para-puruṣa bhavān kiṁ ca dehendriyādiṣv-āviṣṭo hy-udgatatvād-amṛta-sukha-rasaṁ cānubhuṅkṣe tvam-eva||
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.yattu trailokyarūpaṁ dadhadapi ca tato n: yattu trailokya-rūpaṁ dadhad-api ca tato nirgatānanta śuddha-jñānātmā vartase tvaṁ tava khalu mahimā so'pi tāvān kim-anyat|
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.bhūyiṣṭhaṁ sāndramodātmakamupari tato bh: bhūyiṣṭhaṁ sāndra-modātmakam-upari tato bhāti tasmai namaste||
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.avyaktaṁ te svarūpaṁ duradhigamatamaṁ ta: avyaktaṁ te svarūpaṁ duradhigamatamaṁ tattu śuddhaika-sattvaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.mūrtiṁ te saṁśraye'haṁ pavanapurapate pā: mūrtiṁ te saṁśraye'haṁ pavana-pura-pate pāhi māṁ kṛṣṇa rogāt||

vishnu/narayaniyam/100_dasakam_100_kesha.nānāvarṇaprasūnāvalikisalayinīṁ vanyamāl: nānā-varṇa-prasūnāvali-kisalayinīṁ vanya-mālāṁ vilolal-lolambāṁ lambamānām-urasi tava tathā bhāvaye ratna-mālām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/100_dasakam_100_kesha.ūrū cārū tavorū ghanamasṛṇarucau cittaco: ūrū cārū tavorū ghana-masṛṇa-rucau citta-corau ramāyā
vishnu/narayaniyam/100_dasakam_100_kesha.ānamrāṇāṁ purastānnyasanadhṛtasamastārth: ānamrāṇāṁ purastān-nyasana-dhṛta-samastārtha-pālī-samudgacchāyaṁ jānu-dvayaṁ ca krama-pṛthula-manojñe ca jaṅghe niṣeve||
vishnu/narayaniyam/100_dasakam_100_kesha.nityaṁ cittasthitaṁ me pavanapurapate kṛ: nityaṁ citta-sthitaṁ me pavana-pura-pate kṛṣṇa kāruṇya-sindho
